chapters.title: Chapter 3080 Chaos Theory III
paragraphs: The current reality was a profound one as it felt like everything else faded, Noah's eyes dimming and shining ever so often as if clarity came and went.
In the distance, the figure of Sona felt a sense of frustration as she couldn't reach Noah no matter what she tried, and she could see a sense of distance developing that caused her heart to ache!
What was going on?

Far from her, the Martial Emperor Xi of the Imperium arrived with his Legions as they also bathed in the majesty of the Sacred Natal Omniversal Sea of Pompeii, with the eyes of this being and his Legions carefully locked onto Noah's figure and the Omniversal Pillagers in the distance!

They could sense something profound happening to Noah's figure in the distance, but the benefits of the Sacred Natal Omniversal Sea of Pompeii were equally profound and important to them after the cessation of the weavings of their futures that they just experienced.
So Noah's weavings were undisturbed.
Even if others sought to disturb him, it was hard to say whether they would succeed!
So the reality around him continued to unfold.
A storm of murky purple Entropy seethed around his figure with profound chaos, and yet within this chaos, one could see patterns.
One could see repetitions.
It was controlled.
It was determined chaos!
And at this moment, Noah's other weavings arose- almost as if they were in opposition to at least some of the assertions that Entropy had been making.
They stated that were it not for his existence, the Domains of Existence he had passed through would not be better off.
That his existence generated a net benefit regardless of the actions he conducted!
Were he to not exist within the Vitalis and Vacuous Existential Domains, nobody would have risen against the Legacies of Al-Abalem and Ignatius.

They would have continued to live as slaves for the eons to come, with anyone forming an Existential Extremity Authority being erased by the monitoring Dikastes but eventually...Mors Apokalypsis would have not been initiated.
It wouldn't have led to Noah eating up Vitalis and Vacuous with everything else becoming destroyed!
But because he appeared, he eventually brought an Apocalypse as in the process, whether it was his intention or not, he saved countless lives from being enslaved for eons to come.
Which in turn became the spark for his conflict with the Imperium, and now...here he was.
Destroying Legacies. Decimating Martial Kings that had lived for eons.
All of it had...a net benefit?
|Quintessence asserts that the mere premise that were you to not exist, a net benefit would be lost...is a false and faulty premise.|
|You do exist. You deserve to exist.|

|There can be no hypotheticals under the banner of Quintessence as the path you have taken so far has been one where you remained true to yourself, your Fable being a reflection of what you have done.|
WAA!
The intent of Quintessence reverberated as Noah pondered on them.
Existence and non-existence.
There could be no hypotheticals and uncertainties when it came to him as if it was so- he had to control them!
At such a moment Noah felt the eruption of multiple concepts now emanating the majesty of Existential Extremity Authority.
Paradox.
Uncertainty.
Fables.
Brilliance shone within him and around him as at this moment, Manadynamics gushed out with endless waves of Mana all around him.
The purple storm around him became tinted with a deep cerulean hue as another grand intent boomed out.
|Reality is never simply black and white.|
WAA!
|You do not destroy or create anything.|
|You merely act as a conduit to transform.|
It felt like the very concept of time came to a halt.
Noah's figure seated on the silver Sacred Natal Omniversal Sea of Pompeii gazed out before him as his eyes were innumerably bright.
Who he was.
This was a question that may never truly be answered, but the intents of his concepts had shed some light today.
But at the end of the day, they were his concepts.
And he was himself.
He gazed up towards the dazzling purple singularity that was whipping everything into ordered chaos and entropy as he raised his hand and pinched.
And an instant later, this blooming singularity of a Seed appeared in his hands as he stared at it calmly.
He stared at Entropy.
HUUM!
The scene before him changed as he truly came to stare at the weavings of Entropy, finding himself in a sea of chaotic purple brilliance as at its center stood the figure of a single man.
It was an image of himself.
It held a smile at this moment as Noah stared coldly at it, being thankful for the push to understand himself more but at the same time...
|If you ever do something like that again, I will erase you entirely.|
WAA!
His gaze was calm as he uttered these words.
The figure of himself the Manifestation of Entropy...nodded with a smile as it sat down amidst the chaos it orchestrated.
He was himself.
And his concepts were only a part of him.
They did not control him, nor could they steer him towards a route of only chaos and disorder that Entropy just tried to go towards in order to achieve its paramount extreme.
After this warning, Noah blinked as this scene disappeared, his vision returning to the silver sea around him while he grasped onto the Singularity of an utterly pristine Seed.
He came to understand himself a little more as both sides presented by his weavings held some truths.
And he accepted them.
He thought of many things as he knew what he had to change.
So the first thing was...
|You do not create or destroy anything, but you do act as a conduit to transform all lands you arrive in.|
Entropy was gathering concepts of disorder and chaos alone into the Seed before him, but Noah controlled it at this moment to insert Manadynamics, Quintessence, Infinity, and many others.
He did so with intent and purpose to change as...
|The Greater Omniversal Authority of Entropia is coming to fruition from your own distinct design!|

chapters.title: Chapter 3081 Chaos Theory IV
paragraphs: Entropia.
Derived from the weavings of Entropy at its base, but taking on a somewhat different meaning.

Noah felt waves of the Natal Omniversal Source initially gathered by Entropy with all the chaos Noah had already spread across the Omniverse, this essence concealing into the Omniversal Singularity Seed as it began to gain an identity.
|To transform.|
|This is the meaning of Entropia.|
Transformation.
He didn't destroy his home world, but he merely transformed it and assimilated it into the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed.
He didn't destroy the Vitalis and Vacuous Existential Domains- for the most part anyway, and he had transformed them into something else within the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed!
Even the people he killed.
Noah closed his eyes as memories and weavings of every single one flooded across his mind.
They may have been designated as his enemies.
Some conducted actions worthy of him decimating them.
But they still held life that he took away.
A life that he didn't grind down to nothingness and destroy, but instead transformed it to become a part of himself.
He transformed them!
HUUM!
Through weavings of what looked like random chaos.
And yet everything playing out with great organization and order.
The smallest change done initially could propagate and give a complex outcome towards the very end!
Noah utilizing the concept of Infinity to attain a small moment of Infinity.
Enacting the Quintessential Annals of Extremity coincidentally and making it so that his elevation of a concept to the Existential level would not be discovered.
Seemingly small actions that should only affect him, and yet they led to the devouring and assimilation of the Vitalis and Vacuous Existential Domain.
Randomness.
Entropy.
Destruction.
Genesis.
Life.
Order.
In all the Randomness and chaos Noah laid out, he was always there to transform it all as this was the meaning behind the Omniversal Authority of Entropia!
And as soon as its direction was decided, concepts continued to flood into it.
Not just Noah's concepts- he didn't have nearly enough.
But weavings of Extremes around the nearby Domain containing weavings of Pompeii.
Extremes in this small corner of the Omniverse.
If they matched disorder and order in some way, they were recruited.
It would mean that Noah wouldn't be able to say that this forming Omniversal Authority was wholly under his control.

He couldn't say so as a large portion of the complex weavings of Existential Extremity Authorities would not belong to him, but from threads of the Omniverse that the forming Omniversal Singularity Seed was pulling in!
But this was okay.
He was only starting out. There would come a time when the construct of a whole Omniversal Authority could fall under his banner, and even more wonders he could foresee in the future.

Because he had the alteration of Causality under his hands with the influence of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Aitia, and now he would have the tremendous influence of chaos and order- of the very foundational control of the transformation of the cycle of destruction and formation!
He didn't lie to himself.
He wasn't some changed man all of a sudden because of this event that Entropy had sparked, but he had gained a change in his perspective.
On how he could be a better man.
A better father.
A better Protagonist that didn't need to lower others as mere Extras that didn't have their own lives and stories.

He had many things to do and correct with this newly forming perspective, and there were even terrifying things occurring in the background with an enemy that was causing the cessation of an entire Omniversal Authority and Possible weavings of countless beings.
But he would overcome it with everything he held as he began to hold expectations even in the difficult future to come!
So he rose from the dazzling silver sea that was still being devoured by him crazily.
As he transformed the essence of Pompeii and elevated himself.
He turned towards the worried figure of Sona in the distance, and he took a step forward.
Within some of the furthest reaches of the Omniverse.
WUU!
A wail of misery echoed out for light years and only continued to build up, its weavings being extremely unique as after the sound itself passed...it was like it never existed.

A single worm had been moving at rapid speeds based on mere sensation while a whole cluster of dark worms tumbled after it, and after moving for such a long period of time at such a speed, they were bound to come across something or someone!
On top of an Anomalous Existential Domain that formed red crystal spikes that spread outwards valiantly.
The figure of an old man floated above while stroking his golden beard, his hair shining with a brilliant luster of the Teracosm Stage as he held robes depicting the dignity of the Imperium!
|Getting called back for war just as all possible weavings become blank...what a mess.|
This Entity sighed as he finished his exploration of the Domain before him, intending to turn back at this moment when...
WUU!
|Huh?|
He heard the sound first.
And without his knowledge...
WAP!
He came to realize that a pulsing segmented black worm had somehow appeared right in front of him.
But this wasn't the truly terrifying thing.
What was truly terrifying was the fact that it wasn't his will, awareness, or any authority that allowed him to see this creature.
He just saw it in the corner of his eyes as his head was turned to seek the horrid sound.
If his eyes were not on it, he wouldn't even know that it existed!

Extreme dread began to fill him at such a reality as in the next instant, he erupted with a dozen Existential Authorities, a Codex appearing in his hands as the influence of multiple Omniversal Authorities came down.
But...
This actually caused the massive worm that had been before him to pulse in excitement as its upper part just moved forward.
SHAA!
And instantly, all weavings and Authorities were devoured.
|Huh?|
The black worm felt the familiar easing of the sensation it felt as it nodded to itself.
Even though the entity before it only held a glimmer of authority compared to the weavings of Deorcnysse it had swallowed, it still served its purpose.

So in the next moment, the Teracosm Imperium Martial King was the first one to come to an understanding that somehow, no Existential Extremity Authority or Omniversal Authority worked against the horror in front of him.

He was the first one to gain this knowledge...and he would die with this knowledge as in the next moment, his body began to break into glimmers of ash- ash that was drawn towards the worm in front as nothing was left behind!

chapters.title: Chapter 3082 Change I
paragraphs: 3082 Change I
WUUU!
The moment that the massive tenebrous worm devoured the Teracosm Stage Imperium Martial King entirely, the wails of tens of thousands of other worms reached as they also arrived in this space.
The segments of the Source Worm pulsed at this moment as unlike the Greater Omniversal Authority of Deorcnysse it had devoured, this Entity it ate up just now...had weavings of memories.
Memories of other places.
Of other Entities just like it.
And oh were there many!
SKEE!

A screech of joy that was different from the wailing screech emanated from this Source Worm at such a finding as in the next moment, its body gushed out dark radiance as four limbs emerged on the sides of its body.
In the Sacred Natal Omniversal Sea of Pompeii.
Noah came to float before the worried figure of Sona as a storm of purple radiance followed him, his eyes releasing a ray of calmness as Sona asked him.
|Are you okay? You seemed out of it for a second there.|
Was he okay?
He was more than okay!
He just had a change of perspective as there were a few things that he needed to get done from this moment on.

So he nodded towards her with a smile while pointing to the heavy weavings of Entropy behind him that were gradually becoming mixed with thousands of other matching extremes stretched out across the Omniverse.
|A blooming Omniversal Authority showed me a few things. Let's finish up here and delve deeper soon, time is not on our side.|
Time was not on their side.
But ...
|Mmm, you have another body, yes? Let me take that somewhere for a bit.|
He spoke calmly, but Sona's eyes squinted as if she could sense the change and weight of his words.
At the same moment that Noah spoke about time, he also felt the extremes of Chronos among others begin to move as even if time wasn't on their side, they could always influence it!

While such a thing began regarding the weavings of time along with the continued construction of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Entropia, Noah had his other bodies make a move to usher in a few changes.
Far away from the Greater Omniversal Domain of Pompeii.
Within an Existential Domain of the Imperium.

Henry was floating above golden skies as he watched the reality around him be pulled towards a single point of singularity- all of it being devoured by the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed as in the surroundings, sounds of battle still rang out against the remaining Imperium Knights that were stationed within this Domain!
At such a moment...
WAP!
Henry's pupils trembled as he saw the visage of his father appear in front of him, his figure coming to attention as he bowed while calling out.
|Father!|
He kept his head bowed respectfully as many possibilities crossed his mind on why his father would be here.
Had a great enemy they had not foreseen about to appear?

Little Henry's thoughts came to a stop as he saw his father's figure float in front of him until he was inches away, his face showing the same majesty as from the viewpoint of his Will, Henry could see a sense of melancholy within his father's eyes even as he smiled!
Melancholy.
Even traces of sadness!
Had something drastic happened? Had the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed been compromised? Had..?!
As he was raising his head, his thoughts truly had to come to a halt as his father...opened his arms and embraced him.
A simple embrace.
A simple hug!
But even this caused Henry's mind to buzz as he couldn't fathom what was going on!
As for Noah, his mind was filled with his own thoughts as he felt a sense of sadness at the reality that his own Son had to bow to him and not gaze up just because of his Glory.
Even the embrace he put him in right now...when was the last time that he even held his son close?
When did he not impose a heavy and unbearable pressure on his own son for him to improve and be just a fraction as powerful as he was?
He couldn't remember.
So he embraced his son as at this moment, Little Henry was so shocked that he didn't even know what to say.
|I am sorry, my Son.|
WAA!
|For any heavy expectations I placed on you. For any pressure you felt in the months you came to be. I am sorry.|
At such words, Little Henry truly began to panic as he wondered just how bad things were!
Was the erasure of many possible paths he and the others had felt this massive of an issue? Was an apocalypse that even they couldn't escape coming?
He couldn't help but feel the warm embrace of his father as his intent asked lightly.
|Has something happened, father? No matter what it is...|
|Nothing has happened, we just need to take a pause amidst all the chaos and control things at our own pace. Come on.|

With a smile, Noah looked at his son while a rift opened up beside him, beckoning for him to go in as Henry gave a glance at the Domain being devoured before he listened to his father and stepped into the rift.
After reality distorted and stabilized, Henry found himself in one of the more unique locations of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed- a Farm.

Stretches of fields holding multicolored trees budding Fruits of Existence could be seen, while a ranch rearing domesticated winged animals with the Lineage of Dragons and Phoenixes could be seen grazing in the distance.

Near an Orchard of Fruits of Existence, Little Henry finally came to as he saw the figure of his father embracing his grandmother, tears present on Amelia Osmont's face as she brushed Noah's vibrant hair while laughing lightly.
|What's gotten into you now?|
Her words were those filled with the love of a mother towards her son as Noah only smiled while shaking his head at her, his intent ringing out at this moment as he looked upwards.
|Isolate this Domain and impose the weavings of time dilation fully. Take any concepts and Extremes needed to achieve it.|

Within an Existential Domain of the Imperium.

Henry was floating above golden skies as he watched the reality around him be pulled towards a single point of singularity- all of it being devoured by the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed as in the surroundings, sounds of battle still rang out against the remaining Imperium Knights that were stationed within this Domain!
At such a moment...
WAP!
Henry's pupils trembled as he saw the visage of his father appear in front of him, his figure coming to attention as he bowed while calling out.
|Father!|
He kept his head bowed respectfully as many possibilities crossed his mind on why his father would be here.
Had a great enemy they had not foreseen about to appear?

Little Henry's thoughts came to a stop as he saw his father's figure float in front of him until he was inches away, his face showing the same majesty as from the viewpoint of his Will, Henry could see a sense of melancholy within his father's eyes even as he smiled!
Melancholy.
Even traces of sadness!
Had something drastic happened?
Had the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed been compromised?
Had..?!
As he was raising his head, his thoughts truly had to come to a halt as his father...opened his arms and embraced him.
A simple embrace.
A simple hug!
But even this caused Henry's mind to buzz as he couldn't fathom what was going on!
As for Noah, his mind was filled with his own thoughts as he felt a sense of sadness at the reality that his own Son had to bow to him and not gaze up just because of his Glory.
Even the embrace he put him in right now...when was the last time that he even held his son close?
When did he not impose a heavy and unbearable pressure on his own son for him to improve and be just a fraction as powerful as he was?
He couldn't remember.
So he embraced his son as at this moment, Little Henry was so shocked that he didn't even know what to say.
|I am sorry, my Son.|
WAA!
|For any heavy expectations I placed on you.
For any pressure you felt in the months you came to be.
I am sorry.|
At such words, Little Henry truly began to panic as he wondered just how bad things were!
Was the erasure of many possible paths he and the others had felt this massive of an issue?
Was an apocalypse that even they couldn't escape coming?
He couldn't help but feel the warm embrace of his father as his intent asked lightly.
|Has something happened, father?
No matter what it is...|
|Nothing has happened, we just need to take a pause amidst all the chaos and control things at our own pace.
Come on.|

With a smile, Noah looked at his son while a rift opened up beside him, beckoning for him to go in as Henry gave a glance at the Domain being devoured before he listened to his father and stepped into the rift.
After reality distorted and stabilized, Henry found himself in one of the more unique locations of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed- a Farm.

Stretches of fields holding multicolored trees budding Fruits of Existence could be seen, while a ranch rearing domesticated winged animals with the Lineage of Dragons and Phoenixes could be seen grazing in the distance.

Near an Orchard of Fruits of Existence, Little Henry finally came to as he saw the figure of his father embracing his grandmother, tears present on Amelia Osmont's face as she brushed Noah's vibrant hair while laughing lightly.
|What's gotten into you now?|
Her words were those filled with the love of a mother towards her son as Noah only smiled while shaking his head at her, his intent ringing out at this moment as he looked upwards.
|Isolate this Domain and impose the weavings of time dilation fully.
Take any concepts and Extremes needed to achieve it.|

chapters.title: Chapter 3083 Change II
paragraphs: 3083 Change II
HUUM!
Weavings of Continuity and Infinity began to rage.
Weavings of Chronos began to buzz.
Relativity shone brightly!
Time bloomed with fluorescence.

Amidst a time of great chaos and unknown dangers, the Existential Omniversal Emperor sought to take a chunk of time out for those important to him that he had not really given enough time to, and he sought to take the span of a second or even an instant...and stretch this to days or years for himself!
The manipulation of time.
If he could do it sufficiently enough without breaking all bounds of balance and control, the boost to his own power was also bound to be something that took the reins.
But the initiator of all of this...was his family.
As the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed began to churn, Noah waved his hands to adorn an apron as he looked at the ranch in the distance, the Extremity of Cooking rising around him as he spoke.
|We used to microwave canned foods before, so let me cook something containing the lineage of Dragons and Phoenixes dipped into Fruits of Existence right now.|
Why was he doing everything he was doing?
It was all for him and his loved ones- all for him to explore the very end of these wondrous realms of power and mana, with him progressing through the stages of power at great speeds to do so.
Toppling entire Realities and Existential Domains- he did it for himself and for them!
And yet...just how much time did he spend with them?
So here he was.
Spending time, and at the same moment, going to great lengths to stretch out and dilate this time.
As he adorned a white apron with an infinity symbol...
HUUM!

The space above him buzzed as purple blue brilliance of the influence of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Aitia came down, Causality becoming twisted and distorted as many prompts began to cascade down!
|The Existential Extremity Authority of Continuity is being twisted to form a space of temporary non-continuance.|

|The weavings of Vacuous, Isochrinism, Chronos, Relativity, Quantum, Uncertainty, Paradox, Quintessence, and Infinity are among the first to rise and aid the establishment of a space outside of the constraints of time.|
|The Greater Omniversal Authority of Aitia exerts its influence on this endeavor!|
Multiple concepts rose up first.
And even more followed thereafter as Noah's Dominium buzzed, and his Invictus Dominium Wings became even more active!

He reached out towards the ranch and plucked out a massive winged cultivated farm Phoenix, beginning to prepare this creature for a barbecue as above him, a multicolored storm of Existential Extremity Authorities raged.
His son and his mother watched this with bright eyes as behind them, a rift opened that showed the figures of Adelaide, Barbatos, Valentina, Eowyn, and others starting to come through.
The storm above only became more intense as before Noah's eyes...
|The Feature of Existential Omniversal Time Dilation is coming to fruition.|
Existential Omniversal Time Dilation.
Such a wonderful bloomed as while Noah began to prepare a mutated species of a domesticated Phoenix, the space around this Quintessential farm began to change ever so slightly!
At the same time, heavy waves of Existential Extremity Authorities surged as Noah attained more information.
|Requiring heavy usage of Existential Extremity Authority and even the active influence of a Greater Omniversal Authority constantly, a second of time can be stretched out by a factor of 86,400.|
|Currently, a maximum of 3 seconds can be supported within the Omniversal time span of 24 hours.|
WAA!
A terrifying boon.
For three seconds.
Noah could actively stretch out and dilate three seconds within the time span of a single Omniversal day- a limit of his current power as it could always be changed in the future!
As a single second passed across the Omniverse, 86,400 seconds would pass for Noah in this designated domain.

A whole day would be fully experienced where he could theorize and expand on his Existential Extremity Authorities, analyze Omniversal Authorities, alter Causality to produce even more Fruits of Existence, and even more unfathomable wonders.
A whole day within the span of a second!
And he could do this another 2 times as in three seconds, he could experience 3 days!
This was the active form of Existential Omniversal Time Dilation.
Active.
There was also another form that was entirely passive from the weavings Noah was experiencing!

|Under the banner of the Existential Omniversal Time Dilation, a Desecrated Existential Chronos Domain has been born as in this Domain, the active Dilation factor of 1:3 can currently be achieved passively with the rate of Regeneration of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed.|
A passive and constant time dilation supported by the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed.
One to three!
If a day passed across the Omniverse, Noah would be able to experience three days.
If a year passed, he would experience three years!
This was at his current stage of power.
This was what the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed could currently support!
Once it expanded and became even more powerful, there were still bound to be many avenues for change.
Noah nodded at such a wondrous addition of time as right away...
|Existential Omniversal Time Dilation.|
HUUM!
His Dominiums buzzed.
His Invictus Dominium Wings buzzed.
The Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed buzzed!
A second...was about to be stretched out into a day as right before it unfolded...
WAP!

Another rift bloomed with icy brilliance as the figure of none other than the second body of an icy Sanctus Princess appeared in the farm that had now become the Desecrated Existential Chronos Domain.
Noah's eyes came to lock onto her, and then the other women who were looking around with bright eyes, as well as his own Mother and his Son.
As golden flames began to simmer the meat that was being sectioned in front of him, he gave a nod of affirmation as this was it.
The reality he was fighting for.
|Every person has their own story.|
Yes.
Everybody had their own story along with their own individual hopes and dreams.
|You are the Protagonist of your Fable, but it doesn't mean all others have to be put down due to this fact.|
|The Existential Extremity Authority of the Protagonist has advanced tremendously in its authority.|

chapters.title: Chapter 3084 Time
paragraphs: 3084 Time
The Protagonist!
This was one of his major distinctions that warped his very existence and how it related and communicated with the outside world.
He had looked at the outside world before and only seen himself as the only one worth anything, as he was the only Protagonist while all others were mere Extras.
He had reduced everyone and everything to nothingness as if they didn't have their own Wills- their own lives and their own dreams!
When the weavings of the Protagonist went a step further at this point in time and acknowledged that they didn't have to lower others in order to promote themselves...
The very concept of the Protagonist advanced greatly in value.
|The Protagonist is never a perfect Entity- being filled with points of greatness and points of inadequacies.|
|But the points of greatness should always outweigh the inadequacies as they work to correct the few things they are deficient in.|
|A Protagonist doesn't just elevate himself, but acts as a beacon that enriches others around him.|
WAA!
|It is good to be compassionate, disciplined, and persistent, but a Protagonist can also be ruthless, ambitious, and capable of bearing the weight of heavy tasks that others cannot carry.|
Kind, but ruthless!
Noah read the weavings of the Protagonist as at this moment, it was seeking something that didn't even seem to be there.
|The Protagonist seeks an even more unique distinction past that of the Existential Extremity Authority.|

|After an Authority is Existential, it can only weave together with the musings of other Existential Extremes to form an Omniversal Authority, with there currently not being any elevated distinction for Existential Extremity Authorities.|
Once a concept was Existential, that was it.

An Existential Concept of Flames utilized by a Teracosm Stage Entity vs by a Neonate Stage Entity would hold vastly different weight and power, but it was nonetheless still an Existential Extremity Authority. It didn't have another distinction.
The Weavings of the Protagonist sought to bypass this.
|Among the many qualities of the Protagonist, innovativeness and creativity are supposed to be immeasurably high.|
|So the Protagonist innovates and states that it is reaching for an expanded form of power by granting itself and other viable and capable concepts a new distinction.|
|The Protagonist states that when an Extreme reaches such a high level of its meaning and is backed by sufficient power, it can become an Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority.|
WAA!
The Protagonist began to run wild just from Noah's own reflections and change.
It was so daring as to actually randomly design a new distinction within the set groupings of Existential Extremity Authorities!

|Existential Extremes that have culminated to such an unbelievable level can become Ascendant Existential Extremity Authorities that represent a single authority, but carry the weight and power of multiple Existential Extremity Authorities.|

|The Protagonist seeks to design this path of Ascendant Existential Extremity Authorities as a way to have a single Extreme radiate the weavings of multiple extremes, whether it be thousands or tens of thousands- and thus allow the true possibility of forming an Omniversal Authority entirely with your own bound Extremes fully without relying on Natal Existential Extremity Authority around you.|

Even now as the Greater Omniversal Authority of Entropia was being designed, Noah only contributed the core concepts of it as it was being filled with the weavings of tens of thousands of Existential Extremity Authorities that came from the Omniverse itself- things he himself had no bindings to.
The Protagonist wanted to innovate a way past this as it used its elevated authority from Noah's self-actualization to enact...
The distinction of Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority.
|The Protagonist pioneers the way forward and takes the first distinction as an Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority!|
HUUUM!
Innumerable tendrils of radiance erupted within Noah's existence.
Within.
He didn't explode with glorious waves of light outwardly as he didn't want to show off like this before his own family anymore.

To constantly bombard them with the brilliance of his changes as what, so that they look at him in awe? So that he looks further and further out of reach for them as some great being that was no longer human?
No.
He had done this so much to the extent that he could feel the emotions of those he considered his women...to be mixed as some even began to feel emotions of inadequacy.
As if they didn't deserve to be with an Entity like him.
This was an error he didn't want to propagate, even if he was doing it unconsciously.
Whether it was Adelaide all the way from when he was still roaming around Worlds, or even Sona right now who was a Teracosm Stage Entity moving around the Omniverse.
He should never treat them in a way that would ever make them feel inadequate.
He had to elevate not just their power, but also their self worth and Glory.
As he thought of this and as the weavings of the Protagonist exploded with power within him, he stared at the figure of Sona that had appeared and was gazing around curiously, his intent weaving out.
|Sona. This is my Mother, my Son, and...|

He gave a simple introduction as the Sanctus Princess who was an anomaly was not shy, nodding towards everyone while teleporting before Amelia Osmont, taking her hands, and kissing them respectfully while calling out.
|Mother.|
Amelia Osmont nodded with a smile as Sona gazed around and continued.
|I was going to say that as great as it is to meet the family, we may not have time. But...it seems you're playing around with the weavings of time itself.|
She could sense the altered flow of Continuity in this region as she stood beside Noah's Mother while gazing around at everyone else.
At the head burning golden flames that had begun a barbecue, Noah gave a light nod while his own intent weaved out.
|I wanted to have a moment of time with what is most important amidst all the chaos. A moment to breathe.|
A moment of time.
To buy this moment, a great deal of authority was utilized by Noah as right now, he had the next three days for continued growth!

chapters.title: Chapter 3085 Time II
paragraphs: 3085 Time II
Three days to at least gain a grasp and understanding of what was coming, all the while spending time with those who mattered the most!
Besides Noah, the figure of Barbatos came up and smacked her lips as if she were analyzing Sona up and down, her voice succinct as it echoed out.
|Another cute Sister joins us. Little Fish, are you sure you'll be able to make time for all of us?|
Her question was a bold one as Sona raised her brows and looked at the dazzling women around here as she recalled Noah's words before she fell into his embrace.
And even though Barbatos said her words jokingly as always, Noah took them seriously!
He even replied to her while increasing the flames simmering the barbecued Phoenix floating before him.

|We'll make time for the important things now more than ever. The extremes all around us will ensure it. Come, forget about any possible weavings you have all felt or any worries. For now...let's have a feast.|
HUUM!
Glistening golden radiance glinted off the meat he was cooking as with great trust in him, his family stopped worrying about the many paths of futures that were erased.
If Noah said it would be okay, then it would be okay.
Promises were the one thing he never broke!

And even as he took some time to breathe and truly recognize his family, Noah's Existence never stopped utilizing this borrowed time within the Desecrated Existential Chronos Domain where he now had three days.
And just within the first minute of these three days...
The Protagonist designed a new distinction of Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority as after it was brought forth, its boons now fully unfolded.
|The Existential Extremity Authority of Ascension stares at the distinction of Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority.|
His brilliance was hidden, but it continued to burn brightly nonetheless.
|Quintessence burns brilliantly while questioning...if it doesn't hold such a distinction, what else could be deserving of it?|
|The Extremity of Extremity glares at the distinction of Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority.|
|Cheats eyes the newly enacted Distinction!|
|Infinity...|
One concept after another rose at this moment as a dream truly bloomed.
It was a dream that wasn't even possible minutes ago.
But now, it seemed like an inevitability.
A dream of his concepts being able to represent hundreds of thousands or even millions of concepts.
A dream of his concepts alone making up an Omniversal Authority!
Far away from Noah, there was something else with a semblance of a dream.
Barely discernible flashes of darkness.
This was all that they were as the Source Worm was currently organizing all the knowledge of locations it had gained while beginning to go towards them.
Behind it, the massive clusters of tenebrous worms wailing loudly followed ever closer, as if they were afraid of missing out on whatever meal should be waiting for them!
But the Omniverse was vast.
Getting from one place to another was never straightforward as in between, one would more often than not run into something else.
And at this moment...
WUU!
The limbs that had sprouted on the body of the Source Worm wriggled like antennas as it sensed something nearby and turned in a certain direction.
There, it could sense a veiled Domain hiding potent Authorities within!
It instantly warped to this location as behind it, swarms of worms followed suit!
Inside of a certain Nest at this moment.

Murky verdant light swirled to form a poisonous grassland that was filled with thousands of Omniversal Pillagers waiting to move out, and at the very center of these murky verdant grasslands...there was a massive tree shining with stellar brilliance where a terrifying Omniversal Pillager could be seen!

Like all of those within this Nest, it held a physiology most similar to that of a mantis, limbs that seemed like sickles sticking out like jagged blades in its front as an aurora of verdant wings shone brightly behind it.
A golden glow of Teracosm could be seen as it gradually held traces of other colors- its power being so potent as this creature that had lived for eons was tipping past the peak of Teracosm!

It had two crimson eyes much too large for its head as they shone with power and thought, with it currently thinking of the command it had received...as well as the complete cessation of weavings of its future.
What did it all mean?
What-...!
Its crimson eyes blinked in incredulousness the next moment as it noticed the tenebrous form of a worm-like Entity with four dark limbs.
Noticed.
With its own eyesight.
There weren't any fluctuations of authority nor did its Dominium warn it of any danger, but in the next moment...
SQUELCH!

The limbs of the worm like Entity extended and sunk into its body, its defenses being treated as if they didn't even exist as the terrifying glow of a Teracosm Dominium about to enter the next stage acted like it didn't even exist!
And moments after...
Silence.
A terrifying silence that was then followed by a cacophony of wails!
WUUU!
Only wails.

The massive body of the mantis like Omniversal Pillager cracked before becoming absorbed into the massive Source Worm, the physiology of this creature beginning to change as its limbs became sharp and blade-like, with even more of them protruding by its sides.
WUUU!

The cacophony of wails continued as in this nest, there were no more signs of life or bright Dominiums, the thousands of Teleios and Sequor Stage Omniversal Pillagers all decimated within a fraction of a second as most didn't even know enemies had arrived right beside them before they perished.
The bodies of the worms began to change and distort.

The leading Source Worm grew even more blade-like limbs as behind it, tenebrous wings bloomed as terrifically, it now seemed like a worm-like centipede with dazzling wings of oblivion blazing brightly behind it!
WUU!

It let out a screech as in the next moment, even the domain of the Nest it was in began to distort and disappear, its wail carrying somber traces as it also captured the weavings of movements of Omniversal Pillagers only in the memories of particularly powerful ones.
Ones like the Mantis it had just swallowed that was about to step past Teracosm!
With its sharp blade like limbs glinting with brilliance, it turned towards the other Worms and screeched out.
SKEE! SKEE!
Indiscernible screeches echoed out as in the next moment...
the multiplying worms pulsed with acknowledgment.
In the next moment, swarms of them split apart and began to rush out in different directions as at this time, they began to divide and conquer!

|Another cute Sister joins us.
Little Fish, are you sure you'll be able to make time for all of us?|
Her question was a bold one as Sona raised her brows and looked at the dazzling women around here as she recalled Noah's words before she fell into his embrace.

Come, forget about any possible weavings you have all felt or any worries.
For now...let's have a feast.|
HUUM!

If Noah said it would be okay, then it would be okay.
Promises were the one thing he never broke!

The Protagonist designed a new distinction of Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority as after it was brought forth, its boons now fully unfolded.

His brilliance was hidden, but it continued to burn brightly nonetheless.

|The Extremity of Extremity glares at the distinction of Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority.|
|Cheats eyes the newly enacted Distinction!|
|Infinity...|

A dream of his concepts being able to represent hundreds of thousands or even millions of concepts.
A dream of his concepts alone making up an Omniversal Authority!
Far away from Noah, there was something else with a semblance of a dream.
Barely discernible flashes of darkness.

Behind it, the massive clusters of tenebrous worms wailing loudly followed ever closer, as if they were afraid of missing out on whatever meal should be waiting for them!

Getting from one place to another was never straightforward as in between, one would more often than not run into something else.

WUU!

There, it could sense a veiled Domain hiding potent Authorities within!
It instantly warped to this location as behind it, swarms of worms followed suit!
Inside of a certain Nest at this moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 3086 Time III
paragraphs: 3086 Time III
Time.
It was a concept utilized very differently depending on the person.
Those with resources seemed to have an inordinate amount of time to do everything they wished, while those with no resources always felt like they had no time.
The rich could buy and dilate time to their wishes, spending it doing things they loved as a day for them could have the same accomplishments of multiple days for others.
The poor find themselves doing mundane tasks just to come up with enough resources to live and survive as by the time the day ends, maybe they had a single hour or two for themselves!
When it came to time...Noah was currently extravagantly rich.
So rich that he had bought three days to use while only 3 seconds would pass for others!
And in the Desecrated Existential Chronos Domain right now, he was using this time to the fullest.

He had a body surrounded by his family as he cooked a feast for them, allowing Sona and the other women who enriched his life to become familiar with each other as the more social Barbatos was asking questions on where Sona stemmed from- the energy of these two women being on the same wavelength as Sona followed with ease.

She showed much greater care to Noah's Mother as while they talked, Noah called over Little Henry to barbecue with him- the weavings he was utilizing to burn the golden flames being taught as he would even cut a portion of the meat and show how it was still red inside, and for Henry to control the flames a bit more to thoroughly cook it while giving a succulent taste where with every bite, Quintessence would gush out!
As Henry learned this, Noah smiled while he asked in a lowered tone, choosing to take a little bit more interest in his son's affairs.
"I've never asked you before...but is there any girl you've been looking at?"

His words felt foreign even to himself as he would have never found himself saying them not too long ago, and his Son even seemed embarrassed to hear them as he could only turn around his head before he replied hesitantly!

"Just a girl...living in the old region of Atlantis within the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed. I...I didn't know if you'd approve, but I got a chance to know her when I went fishing with Uncle Kazuhiko and the Kraken. She doesn't know who I really am..."
The golden flames burning the meat nearly exploded as Noah looked in shock at his son.
He had just said the question, but there was actually an answer?
There was actually a girl in his son's life that he didn't know about, and his son even had fishing trips on Atlantis?!
He was connected to the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed as he could know everything that happened, and yet he didn't pay enough attention to even bother to know what his own son was doing!
He burned the tinge of pain as he sighed and spoke seriously.
"Talk with her and bring her over soon, be honest with who you are."
It was a unique reality as the Son of Destiny felt like he was living in a whole new world as he nodded.
At the same time, he couldn't help but smile as this new world...didn't feel bad at all!
A reality sectioned off in time.
This was the laid back reality that Noah was living in on this borrowed time.
Actually talking with and doing things with his Son.
But that was only within this Region of the Desecrated Existential Chronos Domain.

A few thousand miles away from where Noah and his family were, a transparent golden veil that blocked off sounds and the expression of Authorities was enacted- another one of Noah's Dominium bodies stationed here as around him...
multicolored brilliance overflowed.

But none moreso than the dazzling murky purple radiance that represented the Singularity of Entropia- the radiance that he had taken from the Sacred Natal Omniversal Sea of Pompeii and brought here where he had three full days to work with!

He still left his Dominium Soul within the Sacred Natal Omniversal Sea of Pompeii along with Sona's other body as silver brilliance from the sea continued to gush into his body, but because it was being drawn into another one of his bodies within a space of dilated time...where he was absorbing and assimilating this authority at a ridiculously faster dilated pace...
It made it so that Noah's pace of devouring the silver sea of Pompeii erupt by thousands of times.
He turned into a black hole that nearly made the sea caved in, absorbing all of this pure Natal authority to feed his own concepts.
And boy did he need the authority to allow his concepts to grow as at this moment, Protagonist was eating up a majority of this authority as it continued its mission to do something grand!
|The boons of the distinction of Ascendant Existential Extremity Authorities are becoming further defined.|
It was defining what this distinction would truly give even as multiple of Noah's concepts were seeking to elevate themselves to this stage.
They also devoured the remaining portion of the silver brilliance gushing in from multiple points like endless waterfalls in this enclosed area where only Noah was in!

|An Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority has three Phases of Ascendancy, with the First Phase making it equivalent to 10,000 Existential Extremity Authorities, the Second Phase increasing this equivalency to 100,000, and the Third Phase making this Equivalency 1,000,000.|
|Going towards the latter phases is dependent on the Authority of the Extreme itself and what it has been able to accomplish.|
A clear definition was given by the weavings of the Protagonist on exactly what it meant to hold the distinction of an Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority!
But this was only part of the work of the Protagonist as it continued.

|Ascendant Existential Extremity Authorities gain a Stele of Ascension within your Existential Dominium, allowing this Stele to act as an anchor that cultivates an Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone that can move outwardly and express its authority at no cost.|

chapters.title: Chapter 3087 Time IV
paragraphs: 3087 Time IV
The second defined boon after understanding the Phases of Ascendancy...was equally as terrifying.
All this time, Noah could manifest the weavings of his Existential Extremity Authorities, but they couldn't outwardly move around as they continued their actions within him.
Now, an Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority would gain a Stele of Ascension that acted as an anchor- an Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone stemming out of this at no cost!
This was how much more powerful an Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority was!

|In addition to a Stele of Ascension forming in your Existential Dominium, another will also form in the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed as two anchors are provided for a single Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority.|

|This allows for the reality that an Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone can never have its weavings disrupted or destroyed unless these two Steles simultaneously shatter- where even if one shatters within your Existential Dominium from meeting an undeniably powerful force, the actual Extremity Clone will not be affected unless the Stele within the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed is simultaneously destroyed.|
|An Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone can further its own extreme by moving within your existence or outside of it, increasing the versatility and range of movements it can carry out.|

|An Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone can tap into and refine Ascendant Existential Extremity Skill Trees with the support of the weavings of Skill Trees, becoming capable of releasing pres-set Quintessential abilities in a shocking fashion.|

|Due to a single Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority being equivalent to 10,000 Extremes just in its First Phase, such an authority is capable of commanding the influence of Lesser Omniversal Authorities at no cost, and may grow to be capable of commanding the influence of Greater Omniversal Authorities at its latter Phases.|
The Protagonist was cooking.
And Noah read its weavings and steered them closely as he let it cook!

While it conducted such a wondrous refinement and elevation of a distinction...there were other concepts within Noah that could no longer wait, and they held their Extremes in such high regard to the extent of being similar to the weavings of the Protagonist if not more.
These concepts now rose.
|In the midst of the defining of the distinction of Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority, Entropy rises.
|Its extreme has affected too many weavings and meets the requirement to advance as an Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority.|
Its Extreme was already there.
It just needed fuel, and even this was there as seas of silver brilliance flooded into Entropy to bring to fruition the reality of...
|Entropy is the second Authority to step into the distinction of the First Phase of Ascendant Existential Extremity Authorities.|
|Its equivalency to other Existential Extremity Authorities is 25,000.|

The weavings of chaos jumped above all others as the purple singularity above Noah buzzed before becoming even more radiant- the core concepts behind it just seemed that much grander as it would allow it to have greater control of the budding Greater Omniversal Authority!
At the same time...
|The Steles of Ascendancy for the Protagonist and Entropy begin actualization within your Dominium and Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed.|
HUUM!
A radiant gold monolith.
A flaming murky purple monolith.

Noah felt such things bloom within the depths of his Dominium as along with this, in the Desecrated Existential Chronos Domain where only he was in, two massive Steles began to form with an air of pristine Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority!

Alongside these Steles, brilliance flourished and began forming into glorious humanoid forms looking exactly like Noah but adorned in different garments, the signature wings on the back and feet being retained as two Ascendant Existential Extremity Clones were coming to fruition.

The Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of the Protagonist had golden hair and white gold robes, his eyes ridiculously shining like halcyon suns as the representation of the Invictus Dominium Wings behind him was a pure aurora of gold.

The Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of Entropy looked exactly like the figure Noah had warned not too long ago that looked exactly like him, his Wings blaring with hues of dark purple chaotic brilliance that tinged his hair and robes the same color.

Uniquely, both on the Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of the Protagonist and Entropy, blazing golden and purple flames of Haki constantly burned around them and warped the reality nearby to what their extremes stood for, these majestic flames making them look extremely otherworldly and menacing!
Effectively, they were Noah's bodies that would never perish out there.

Two Steles of Ascension existed within Noah's Existential Dominium and also within the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed, and unless both were simultaneously destroyed...Noah had just gained the perfect bodies to have running outside in this moment and age of profound unknowns.
His Dominium Soul would be recalled and replaced as he would only have his Ascendant Existential Extremity Clones moving around outside.
|The Weavings of the Protagonist are reaching the end of their definition of the distinction of Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority for its current stage.|
|One final push is made by all supporting Authorities.|
WAA!
From the now fully manifested figure of the Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone.
The Ascendant Protagonist brought his hands together, his golden hair whipping around madly and one final definition was added!

|When Nine Ascendant Existential Extremity Clones are successfully produced, their weavings can flow together to mimic the complex transmutation of an Omniversal Authority, bringing out an Ascendant Existential Omniversal Extremity Form with capabilities that are undefined and undisclosed at this moment.|
Mimicking the weavings of the complex movements of extremes that make up Omniversal Authorities.
In such a manner, his Ascendant Existential Extremity Clones would be capable of bringing out a fused form of themselves that would no doubt be an utterly ridiculous construct!
And even this still had its parameters undefined as Noah could only nod at such a development.
|Good.|
His eyes shone with controlled brightness and regality.
Only seconds had passed within his three day expansion of time, yet things began on an extremely wondrous schedule as he just had to keep it up!

Only seconds had passed within his three day expansion of time, yet things began on an extremely wondrous schedule as he just had to keep it up!

chapters.title: Chapter 3088 Transformation and Cultivation! I
paragraphs: 3088 Transformation and Cultivation! I
The definition of the distinction of Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority came to a slow close for now.
For now.

It could always advance even further in the future as its products were many, ranging from a single concept now being able to stand for 10,000 concepts or even more, the rise of Ascendant Existential Extremity Clones, the formation of the Stele of Ascension within his Dominium and the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed that made it nearly impossible for his Ascendant Existential Extremity Clones to perish, Ascendant Existential Extremity Skill Trees, and lastly...
Ascendant Existential Omniversal Extremity Form when 9 Extremity Clones were brought together!
This was the product of Noah's self actualization that made the weavings of the Protagonist undergo a change.
And so far, the Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of the Protagonist and Entropy had formed, with these merely being the first as many of his other concepts wanted to follow.
But of course, their Extremes had to have reached a sufficient level.
They couldn't just do it because they wanted to!
And which among Noah's extremes had reached a level similar to the Protagonist and Entropy?
Noah didn't have to look far as he looked within himself, already seeing some concepts rising and falling like stellar rivers of brilliance.
They filled his existence with unique sensations that he felt sad others would never be able to experience.

The sensation gave him a sense of power and confidence that he could do anything and survive anything, the weavings of his concepts being so potent that even if he didn't believe it, his existence may have naturally been warped to have this confidence!
And one of the biggest sources of this confidence...
|All actions you have taken so far support one defining concept that makes you.|
|Quintessence shines with brilliance, breaking past the shackles of a normal Existential Extremity Authority.|
The pure Natal authority from a distant silver sea was heavily devoured by a colorless brilliance.
It was the current fuel for Ascension as ever so subtly, something else rose within Noah!
A Colorless Stele of Ascension began to form within his Dominium and within the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed.
|Quintessence claims the distinction of an Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority!|

A Third Concept that was deserving of an elevated distinction came to be, and Noah only felt his other concepts become wider after Quintessence took a step forward to enter the First Phase of an Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority!
|The Weavings of Extremity brood silently as even without lifting a finger, all movements of Extremes are reflected on it.|
|Its distinction is without question.|
A brilliant stellar dark Stele filled with unfathomable weavings bloomed right after the colorless one.
And...
|Extremity claims the distinction of an Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority!|
The Protagonist, Entropy, Quintessence, and Extremity rose to the center stage!
But they wouldn't be left alone as after them, a blazing grandeur of cerulean brilliance overtook everything.
|Infinity is a core concept of who you are, elevating itself and yourself with every step you take.|
|Infinity claims the distinction of an Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority!|
It felt like an immeasurably endless wave had formed.
And in this endlessly blue wave...
|Manadynamics is connected to the alteration and change of all Authorities as it cannot remain without a distinction.|
|Manadynamics claims the distinction of an Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority!|
Infinity and Manadynamics rode on this wave!
And it didn't seem done.
Noah felt like there may still be one or two concepts that met the prerequisites to advance their extremes.
Causality? Fables? Tyranny? Loot? Plot?
He looked within himself for the Existential Extremes that had truly gone above and beyond their concepts as the moment they began to bubble forth, something else came.
Something that actually took their twinkling brilliance for itself!
|Cheats apologizes in advance.|

|The Concept of Cheats gathers a deluge of Authority to go from a normal concept, skip past the distinction of an Existential Extremity Authority, and head directly for the distinction of an Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority.|
A white gold brilliance rose at the depths of Noah's existence, actually taking the brilliance of some concepts that were almost at the precipice and gathering it all for itself!
The Weavings of Noah's other concepts rose in contention at such an action, but Cheats did not even give them a chance.
|Your abnormality is what placed you where you are now.|

|Your Cheats and blatant disregard for the common rules of existence and reality have placed you on your current pedestal, and one concept believes this pedestal can be broken and trashed to enact something else entirely.|
|Cheats claims the distinction of an Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority!|
Noah closed his eyes at this advancement and reveled in it.
Cheats had taken the lead in doing a great deal of things. Even with its blatant actions of whisking away the brilliance of others, it could be accepted for what it had done so far!
And whenever weavings of this concept made a move, it was normally a major one.
Cheats, like all other concepts, were simply part of Noah's Will with a unique autonomy.
But just like Entropy could weave its own intent, so could Cheats and others as part of Noah's Will!

And the reason for Cheats to finally advance at this moment from a concept that wasn't even Existential to become an Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority...Noah could already feel the beginnings of its intention.
They related to nothing else other than what he wanted to do in the next three days.
Growth.
He wanted advancement that didn't depend on him destroying and butchering others as if all of their existence was just somehow made for him to eat and destroy.
His whole existence didn't have to revolve around constant murder and enemies!
|A grand Stele of Ascension forms within your Dominium and Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed.|
|The Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of Cheats is coming to fruition!|
HUUM!
White gold brilliance spread out akin to spinning galaxies as another visage of Noah appeared.
Adorned in white gold robes.
Hair shining white gold and with a calm smile.
He looked towards Noah.
And Noah looked at himself.
Both were one as their weavings resonated, their thoughts singular as a single intent bloomed out!
|It is time.|

chapters.title: Chapter 3089 Transformation and Cultivation! II
paragraphs: 3089 Transformation and Cultivation! II
It was time.
Time for what?
A question like this was a unique one when it related to things the concept of Cheats was undertaking, with every one of its projects being something heavy!
And all prior projects it had taken were grand ones producing wondrous results, so what was in store now? At this moment, it was time for...
|The completion of the weavings of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Entropia first...this will be a required component.|
Noah's voice echoed out from Cheats.
More of his Will left his Dominium, the visage of Cheats blinking as with every blink, his eyes became brighter to show Noah's will as he gazed towards the murky purple singularity far above them!
Beside this singularity, the Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of Entropy was already there as if it didn't have to be told this.
|The Weavings of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Entropia have become increasingly complex.|
|Multiple unique singular Authorities representing tens of thousands of Authorities have mixed into the Seed of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Entropia.|
|An Omniversal Authority containing unique concepts distinguished as Ascendant Existential Extremity Authorities is coming to fruition.|

|The Composition of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Entropia is still concentrated with normal Existential Extremity Authorities with unbound and unclaimed sources from the weavings of the Omniverse itself.|
|The Distinction of the Greater Omniversal Authority remains the same due to this.|
Noah's will buzzed as such a pair of prompts opened a doorway for wondrous possibilities!

If the composition of an Omniversal Authority was made up of unique Existential Extremity Authorities- namely Ascendant ones...this may very well change the distinction of the Omniversal Authority itself.
Even grander possibilities of power waited ahead!
Entropia may not have qualified, but the ones to come afterward would undoubtedly face a different result.
|Even though its distinction wasn't altered, the standing of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Entropia is high amongst Greater Omniversal Authorities.|
|Approximately 9,999,999 Existential Extremity Authorities flow with complex weavings to make up the Greater Omniversal Authority of Entropia!|
|The Greater Omniversal Authority of Entropia has been recorded in the Quintessential Codex of Extremity.|
|As the catalyst who pushed for the design of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Entropia, you gain a unique Quasi-
Architectural Recognition of this Omniversal Authority that grants you a great deal of influence and control.|
HUUM!

What was previously a singularity came together under hundreds of thousands of complex weavings, this singularity blooming and transforming into a massive pillar of murky purple brilliance filled with mixtures of cerulean hues.
Its color uniquely seemed similar to the Omniversal Authority of Aitia, but it seemed to be different shades of purple and blue that at this moment...actually remained stable above Noah.
It never left.
At the center of this blazing Greater Omniversal Authority...the Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone had his arms spread out wide while laughing with booming bursts of chaos.
Quasi-Architectural Recognition.
Noah would have to unravel just what wonders such a distinction granted him as the moment this Greater Omniversal Authority of Entropia was formed...
|The Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority of Cheats pulls upon the influence of Entropia.|
A white gold figure made a move right away.
Entropia.
To change.
To transform amidst chaos and order.
Cheats borrowed such a terrifying tool firsthand as the first thing Noah noticed...was how it didn't cost him anything as of yet.
No Authority of his Omniversal Organ was taken.
No Authority from his Dominium was taken.
The Distinction of Quasi-Architectural Recognition...just how massive were its full boons?!
|Under the influence of a newly born Greater Omniversal Authority, Cheats seeks to answer the question of Cultivation.|
Without needing to constantly murder others and devour them of their brilliance.
What tool could there be for a rapid progression of strength?
By no means was Noah turning into a saint who did not take life, but he wanted an alternative that didn't require him to distort reality to make countless enemies.
He wanted to also be capable of depending on himself for great and rapid rises in power.
All others normally did this by refining their Existential Dominiums and Existential Extremity Authorities with Fruits of Existence and other treasures- but they took a single factor into account.
Time.
They all spent a great deal of time.
Noah couldn't stand cultivating for thousands or millions of years to arrive at a result as all that he had to do...was accelerate this process.
So Cheats began with the very Authority of Transformation amidst innumerable weavings of chaos.
And then...he began his construct.
|The Design of the Ascendant Existential Engine of Cultivation has begun.|
|Your Heart has been chosen as the Source of the Ascendant Existential Engine of Cultivation.|
|An Engine to constantly and passively pump to refine authority at a rate that exceeds what others accomplish in millions of years.|
|Such an Engine would require unending resources to power and keep active.|
Yes.
A Construct of constant and effective Cultivation by Noah's standards.
As for the unending resource to power up such an idea?
Noah looked deep within himself and felt the calm beat of his heart.
It shone with many colors, but a single was utterly radiant.
An endless cerulean radiant.
Noah looked at this and uttered out calmly.
|O Infinite Mana...|
His endless Reserves of Mana.
It was time to put them in a constant use as the moment Noah called out to this source of endless brilliance...
|The Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority of Manadynamics throws in its full support.|
|The Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority of the Protagonist throws in its full support.|
|The Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority of...|
The newly risen Ascendant Existential Extremity Authorities began to flow in with fervor.
Within Noah, as if a plug that was stopping an endless dam had just gotten pulled, a gush of blue radiance erupted out and surged toward his Heart!
BZZT!
And his heart shuddered as if it were about to explode.

But in such a moment of profound wonder, different parts of his heart ruptured and began forming protruding stellar mountainous Passages, accepting all incoming authority as minute changes began to bloom!
|A New Omniversal Organ is blooming within your Existence.|
|The newly forming Organ holds the unique distinction of an Ascendant Omniversal Organ.|
A stupendous surprise.
A product of Noah's brilliance!
He had the Existential Invictus Dominium Wings, and now...
|The Ascendant Existential Engine of Cultivation is forming in the manifestation of the Omniversal Organ- the Ascendant Existential Veritas Dominium Heart!|
