chapters.title: Chapter 3090 Transformation and Cultivation! III
paragraphs: 3090 Transformation and Cultivation! III
Veritas.
An immeasurably strong word that stood for the weavings of truth or reality.
An undeniable and unchanging truth of reality!
Taking on such an identity, the Omniversal Organ sought to bend and transform this truth- this reality...to Noah's will!
Thus, the Ascendant Existential Veritas Dominium Heart was being born.
His Heart was selected to be the Source of the Ascendant Existential Engine of Cultivation- something that passively elevated his power at a rate others couldn't even fathom.

At this moment, it erupted with multiple new mountainous valves that radiated multicolored brilliance, auroras of vessels and arteries forming and gushing waves of authority as at the core of it all...was Mana.
|Your Infinite Mana will keep the cycle of endless turns of the Ascendant Existential Engine of Cultivation.|

|The Ejection Fraction of your heart will always remain above 90% as you constantly pump and refine authority across your existence and Extremes, with this percentage capable of being augmented in the future and even exceeding 100% with the growth of the Ascendant Existential Veritas Dominium Heart.|

|Your Ascendant Existential Veritas Dominium Heart will beat at a rate of 60 beats per minute, with every beat being equivalent to 1 Trillion Beats of an average Entity's rate of refinement of existence at the apex of the Teracosm Stage.|
DUM!
Like an ancient drum.
A heavy and unfathomably strong beat echoed out.
Were it like before, it would have reverberated across the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed as his own family and people would have wondered what was going on.
But Noah didn't have to show off his brilliance.
The heavy beat of his heart boomed out in this isolated space within the Desecrated Existential Chronos Domain, and with a single beat within a second...
HUUM!
His existence felt a radiance flicker around him- and his Extremes felt the same thing!
As if they gained a layer of empowerment that was swiftly absorbed to elevate them.
And as a second passed...
DUM!
Another booming beat echoed out as the same multicolored radiance flashed over Noah's existence and Extremes!
Once more, they felt their Existential Authority taken another notch higher as...
DUM!
DUM!
DUM!
The heavy beats kept on coming.
His existence kept on brimming with brilliance.
The purple gold hue of his Invictus Dominium Wings only became more potent!
And his concepts cheered at their core constructs becoming increasingly elevated!
HUUUM!

Behind all of this, his Infinite Mana churned into the mountainous vessels surrounding his heart and endless waves of authority were processed and transformed, the hue of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Entropia being especially potent at this moment!
|The Ascendant Existential Veritas Dominium Heart has begun running at full capacity.|
Radiance unfurled all around Noah as the very loud and heavy beat became contained within him entirely.
|The Ascendant Existential Engine of Cultivation is now running at full capacity.|
|With every beat of your heart, your Existential Dominium and Extremes face an overwhelming growth and refinement.|
|The boons of the Ascendant Existential Engine of Cultivation encompass everything under your existence!|
Everything under his existence.
His Glory.
His Records.
His Existential Invictus Dominium Wings.
And even the Ascendant Existential Veritas Dominium Heart as well!

Everything received a thorough elevation as while all of this occurred, the figure of the Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of Cheats seemed to raise his head high- almost as if questioning whether that would be all.
And of course, the answer was no!

|The Ascendant Existential Veritas Dominium Heart is the engine that will be constantly refining your existence, and it is not alone in doing so as apart from Mana, another source of enrichment for it is your Infinite Forge providing a constant outflow of Fruits of Existence.|
WAA!
Another part of himself blazed and showed its brilliance.

Within it, the figure of Ruination raised her head with utmost clarity, her eyes blazing gold and crimson as she was at the very center of it all, constantly refining endless seas of Loot light and multiplying them as she served like a catalyst to further exponentially increase the rate that Fruits of Existence formed!
She gazed up as she felt the call of Cheats at this moment.
A variant of her Master.
Wrapped in the weavings of Loot, she only nodded and followed this Will!
Within the Infinite Forge, golden mountains floated gloriously as they gushed out new waves of authority.
They were laden with dripping golden brilliance!

|The Weavings of Cheat modulates and channels the Authority of all newly advanced Ascendant Existential Extremity Authorities through the core of the Existential Extremity Authority of Loot as it seeks the production of Ascendant Quintessential Fruits of Existence.|
|Fruits of Existence are the main resource of advancement utilized by others, but their boons remain limited.|
|Ascendant Quintessential Fruits of Existence are a resource meant to come to fruition a thousand times as fast as even Quintessential Fruits of Existence, with their Efficiency being even greater.|
HUUM!
Efficiency.

One of the Four Components of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Aitia was uttered by the weavings of Cheats as at this stage, the influence of this authority that Noah held the recognition of was also pulled forward.
It was pulled forward to achieve a dream- a dream of the singular concept of Cheats!

The visage of Ruination turned into a massive crimson gold sword to achieve this, delving her sharpest point into the endlessly vast golden sea of Loot below the floating multicolored mountains as the brilliance was further multiplied in quantity and quality.
And from the blazing golden mountains...
BOOM!
There were volcanic eruptions of immense glory.
From these eruptions, incandescent white gold fruits that would make one's mouth water gushed out...by the millions.
Millions.
And this was only with a little of the twisting of Causality put in along with the Greater Omniversal Authority of Aitia and the Component of Efficiency applied further on this process!
It was made even further feasible and potent as the apex of transformation- the weavings of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Entropia...were laid heavily onto it as well.
It caused for the birth of utter undefinable resources!

sentences.text: 3090 Transformation and Cultivation!
III
Veritas.
An immeasurably strong word that stood for the weavings of truth or reality.
An undeniable and unchanging truth of reality!
Taking on such an identity, the Omniversal Organ sought to bend and transform this truth- this reality...to Noah's will!
Thus, the Ascendant Existential Veritas Dominium Heart was being born.
His Heart was selected to be the Source of the Ascendant Existential Engine of Cultivation- something that passively elevated his power at a rate others couldn't even fathom.

At this moment, it erupted with multiple new mountainous valves that radiated multicolored brilliance, auroras of vessels and arteries forming and gushing waves of authority as at the core of it all...was Mana.
|Your Infinite Mana will keep the cycle of endless turns of the Ascendant Existential Engine of Cultivation.|

|The Ejection Fraction of your heart will always remain above 90% as you constantly pump and refine authority across your existence and Extremes, with this percentage capable of being augmented in the future and even exceeding 100% with the growth of the Ascendant Existential Veritas Dominium Heart.|

|Your Ascendant Existential Veritas Dominium Heart will beat at a rate of 60 beats per minute, with every beat being equivalent to 1 Trillion Beats of an average Entity's rate of refinement of existence at the apex of the Teracosm Stage.|
DUM!
Like an ancient drum.
A heavy and unfathomably strong beat echoed out.
Were it like before, it would have reverberated across the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed as his own family and people would have wondered what was going on.
But Noah didn't have to show off his brilliance.
The heavy beat of his heart boomed out in this isolated space within the Desecrated Existential Chronos Domain, and with a single beat within a second...
HUUM!
His existence felt a radiance flicker around him- and his Extremes felt the same thing!
As if they gained a layer of empowerment that was swiftly absorbed to elevate them.
And as a second passed...
DUM!
Another booming beat echoed out as the same multicolored radiance flashed over Noah's existence and Extremes!
Once more, they felt their Existential Authority taken another notch higher as...
DUM!
DUM!
DUM!
The heavy beats kept on coming.
His existence kept on brimming with brilliance.
The purple gold hue of his Invictus Dominium Wings only became more potent!
And his concepts cheered at their core constructs becoming increasingly elevated!
HUUUM!

Behind all of this, his Infinite Mana churned into the mountainous vessels surrounding his heart and endless waves of authority were processed and transformed, the hue of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Entropia being especially potent at this moment!
|The Ascendant Existential Veritas Dominium Heart has begun running at full capacity.|
Radiance unfurled all around Noah as the very loud and heavy beat became contained within him entirely.
|The Ascendant Existential Engine of Cultivation is now running at full capacity.|
|With every beat of your heart, your Existential Dominium and Extremes face an overwhelming growth and refinement.|
|The boons of the Ascendant Existential Engine of Cultivation encompass everything under your existence!|
Everything under his existence.
His Glory.
His Records.
His Existential Invictus Dominium Wings.
And even the Ascendant Existential Veritas Dominium Heart as well!

Everything received a thorough elevation as while all of this occurred, the figure of the Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of Cheats seemed to raise his head high- almost as if questioning whether that would be all.
And of course, the answer was no!

|The Ascendant Existential Veritas Dominium Heart is the engine that will be constantly refining your existence, and it is not alone in doing so as apart from Mana, another source of enrichment for it is your Infinite Forge providing a constant outflow of Fruits of Existence.|
WAA!
Another part of himself blazed and showed its brilliance.

Within it, the figure of Ruination raised her head with utmost clarity, her eyes blazing gold and crimson as she was at the very center of it all, constantly refining endless seas of Loot light and multiplying them as she served like a catalyst to further exponentially increase the rate that Fruits of Existence formed!
She gazed up as she felt the call of Cheats at this moment.
A variant of her Master.
Wrapped in the weavings of Loot, she only nodded and followed this Will!
Within the Infinite Forge, golden mountains floated gloriously as they gushed out new waves of authority.
They were laden with dripping golden brilliance!

|The Weavings of Cheat modulates and channels the Authority of all newly advanced Ascendant Existential Extremity Authorities through the core of the Existential Extremity Authority of Loot as it seeks the production of Ascendant Quintessential Fruits of Existence.|
|Fruits of Existence are the main resource of advancement utilized by others, but their boons remain limited.|
|Ascendant Quintessential Fruits of Existence are a resource meant to come to fruition a thousand times as fast as even Quintessential Fruits of Existence, with their Efficiency being even greater.|
HUUM!
Efficiency.

One of the Four Components of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Aitia was uttered by the weavings of Cheats as at this stage, the influence of this authority that Noah held the recognition of was also pulled forward.
It was pulled forward to achieve a dream- a dream of the singular concept of Cheats!

The visage of Ruination turned into a massive crimson gold sword to achieve this, delving her sharpest point into the endlessly vast golden sea of Loot below the floating multicolored mountains as the brilliance was further multiplied in quantity and quality.
And from the blazing golden mountains...
BOOM!
There were volcanic eruptions of immense glory.
From these eruptions, incandescent white gold fruits that would make one's mouth water gushed out...by the millions.
Millions.
And this was only with a little of the twisting of Causality put in along with the Greater Omniversal Authority of Aitia and the Component of Efficiency applied further on this process!
It was made even further feasible and potent as the apex of transformation- the weavings of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Entropia...were laid heavily onto it as well.
It caused for the birth of utter undefinable resources!

chapters.title: Chapter 3091 Transformation and Cultivation! IV
paragraphs: 3091 Transformation and Cultivation! IV

[Ascendant Quintessential Fruit of Existence]:: An elevated version of the Fruit of Existence that is so profoundly above its old self in value that a direct comparison is hard to make. A single Ascendant Quintessential Fruit of Existence is capable of nudging a concept towards the level of an Existential Extremity Authority, with 10 being capable of elevating one's Aspect of Existence towards the Existential Dominium Realm. Due to their unique nature, they are able to aid in the maturity and advancement of Omniversal Organs, Glory, and even the Distinction that an Existence holds. If an Existence devoured enough authority from the Ascendant Quintessential Fruits of Existence, the budding of a natural Omniversal Organ may even be possible...
A stupendous white gold Fruit.
A Fruit that could do so many things to the extent that if Noah were to list it on the Existential Imperium Exchange, there was no doubt that all eyes would be on it!
And yet it was a resource born just for his usage!
The moment these white gold Fruits were born...
DUM!
A heart beat echoed out.

And thereafter, all the millions of produced Ascendant Quintessential Fruits of Existence disappeared, turning into dazzling white gold lights that were pulled towards a terrifying Engine of Cultivation!
Before a second even passed, all the immeasurable glory contained in these Fruits of Existence was broken down and subsequently spread out across Noah's existence!
HUUM!
And his whole being felt like it had taken many more steps forward.
So much so that...
|The light of Loot illuminates your existence with such brilliance that brings it ever higher.|
|Your body continues to undergo endless rounds of ascensions as much of your identity is gaining the distinction of Ascendant.|
|Loot reaches out and claims the distinction of an Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority!|
|Ascendancy reaches out and claims the distinction of an Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority!|
Two Authorities took the leap right away.
They were bathed with the terrifying light of the Ascendant Quintessential Fruits of Existence in addition to the boons of the Ascendant Existential Engine of Cultivation.
Given the fact that both concepts were also inherently connected with everything currently happening and further elevating their extremes...they took the step as well!
But they wouldn't be the last.
There was a great deal of time ahead of Noah as with the passage of a second...
DUM!
His Ascendant Existential Engine of Cultivation beat like an ancient drum.
HUUM!
And his Infinite Forge pulsed while a crimson gold blade raised wonder all around, mountainous Passages gushing out Ascendant Quintessential Fruits of Existence that were processed right after.
DUM!
And then...
HUUM!
It repeated.
It repeated!
Over and over again. From this point onward!
A well oiled machine began to move and carelessly charge forward as at this point...
|We do not need to do anything else.|
The voice of The Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of Cheats echoed out as all of Noah's will resonated with it.
The visage of his Dominium rose as around him, utterly gorgeous waves of heavy Authority constantly surged.
His Invictus Dominium Wings vibrated with brilliance constantly as the gilded color of gold became even deeper, the purple brilliance slowly becoming faded out!
What was Cultivation?
Others struggled day in and day out, looking for resources or meditating to understand their Existential Extremity Authorities while refining their existence ever so slowly.
Maybe they had epiphanies.
Maybe they became more in tune with Omniversal Authorities.
Maybe they attained enough authority to even develop an Omniversal Organ!
Noah...went able and beyond all of this as what he was doing was true Cultivation!
The moment this thought arrived in his mind, yet another Authority that was already radiating an Existential light after all this...took another step forward.
|Cultivation reaches out and claims the distinction of an Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority!|
Noah's eyes were bright as he knew prompts like these would continue to come in the next three days.
And each one may just provide even grander results as...since Ascendancy and Cultivation attained the distinction of Ascendant...
|Ascendancy seeks to elevate and enhance the advancements you have every second.|
|Cultivation seeks to further define and increase the effectiveness of the Ascendant Existential Engine of Cultivation!|
Some of his recently advanced concepts already sought to enact change as Noah knew when it came to him, nothing would sit still!
But he wasn't alone.

As his other bodies explored and observed the progression of Cultivation here, another body was amidst his family as Noah had finished grilling utterly succulent Phoenix meat, and he laid it out on golden plates atop a pristine white table that was surrounded by his close family.
At this moment, along the center of this white table...
SHAA!
Reality glimmered as dozens of white gold Ascendant Quintessential Fruits of Existence appeared.

Alongside them, golden chalices filled with the silver glow of the compressed liquid of the Sacred Natal Omniversal Sea of Pompeii began to appear- with Noah about to enjoy a feast with his closest family that included boons which would propel them greatly in power!
In a short while, he would extend invitations into this space for Entities like Kazuhiko and Emperor Penguin, and all those who had helped and contributed to getting him where he was right now.
This...would be how Noah spent his borrowed time in the Desecrated Existential Chronos Domain!
Ceaseless getting stronger, and also spending time with the reason why he was getting stronger in the first place.

"Now then..." As he experienced multiple sides with a single Will but multiple bodies, Noah smiled while converging a major part of the power of his Will towards the Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of the Protagonist.
He did so for another reason as to why he enacted this borrowed time.
Another reason to close himself off for three days!
It was, of course, to find out just what was responsible for the cessation of weavings of so many Entities across the Omniverse!
For something so obscene, observing its weavings was bound to be near impossible when Noah had yet to even uncover who the Unknown Source that sought to steer him towards destruction was.
But even this thing...held some strings related to him as he would try nonetheless!

chapters.title: Chapter 3092 Unseen Enemies! I
paragraphs: 3092 Unseen Enemies! I

Obtaining information on something that was causing widespread cessation of possibilities- something that Noah hadn't heard any word from Sona about even though she was one of the most proficient beings in seeing across weavings!
But so long as there were threads of weavings from what this enemy was relating to him...he should be able to pick up something.
DUM!
His heart beat.
DUM!
And an Ascendant Existential Engine of Cultivation churned.
At such a time, Noah uttered out calmly.
|Existential Omniversal Editor.|
He called out to a unique feature.
His Lineage which had begun to get extremely active since minutes ago buzzed while his Distinctions ran rampant!
Immense waves of authority tumbled around Noah as within moments...massive screens of light began to appear all around him.
They showed different regions of the Omniverse.
Some showing hues of darkness.
Others showing auroras of different colored lights.
But uniquely, they never stood still.
The scenes constantly shifted!
And even more uniquely...there was nothing else within these screens of light!
There was no figure of Entities or any lifeforms, or even a glimpse of a dark shadow.
|The Weaver of Existence and Extremity stares forward with perplexity.|
Yes.

There was a basal thread that Noah was able to pull on to try and gain information on his enemies, this basal thread being capable of showing him the multiple screens that were currently shining all around!
Yet these screens held nothing.
Such a reality made way for a few possibilities.

One of the more deadly ones was that even with the weavings of multiple Existential Extremity Authorities and the support of Greater Omniversal Authorities, Noah could glimpse at the image of his Enemies...but he still couldn't see them!
His eyes became immeasurably somber as he gazed at all the screens around him with intensity.
They constantly changed scenery as if something was moving, his threads of weaving following it...and yet they still weren't able to discern them.
This went on for over ten minutes before suddenly, his eyes shifted to lock onto one screen in particular!

This screen had been showing the same constantly changing scenery, but at this moment, it came across an Existential Dominium that when Noah looked at closely- it seemed to be an outpost of the Imperium.
The Imperium was stretched out across the Omniverse more than any other force as when one waded across it, they would come across forces of the Imperium more often than not!
Noah saw many vessels stationed outside of this Existential Domain as within these Vessels, Imperium Knights filled with utmost vigilance were guarding the outpost while looking around.
They were all vigilant after they had just sensed the cessation of all of their weavings, with all Imperium Knights placed on high alert!
Noah fully focused on this illusory screen with such a reality as through this, at least he would get to understand the scope of power of his Enemies and better prepare.
Even if he couldn't see them, the weavings of the Imperium Knights should be able to grasp something!
Even though they were not allies, Noah wouldn't do something as foolish as rush to try and save them before knowing anything about the current enemies.
Even if he had to watch Entities die in front of him...he still had his best interests to protect!
|The weavings of the Protagonist nod in agreement.|
His extremes flowed along with him as Noah watched silently.
And...
The Source of the cessation of weavings across the Omniverse should have appeared right before the vigilant Imperium Knights.
They should have been right ahead of them!
So why...were they continuing to stare vigilantly as if they couldn't see anything?

Noah watched with a sense of foreboding as the scene of the illusory screen shifted right on top of the stationed Imperium Knights that were either within vessels or floating outside of them, and in the next moment...

The eyes of all Imperium Knights in this region bulged out as if in shock and horror, gazing right in front or beside them as if they could finally see whatever culprit Noah was following, and as they tried to react...
SQUELCH!

Their bodies were pierced from different directions as they quickly lost all their Existential brilliance, becoming husks within moments before they cracked and splintered, turning into flickers of ash that subsequently disappeared entirely as if they were swallowed by an unseen black hole!
And then...
WUUUU!
Noah steadied his Will as he heard it.
A terrifyingly horrid wail- a screech that seemed to unsettle everything about his very existence!

A screech that actually destabilized the weavings of existence all around the Desecrated Existential Chronos Domain, causing the stable distortion of spacetime to fluctuate as Noah moved to cut off the threads of weaving connecting sound out from all the illusory screens around him.

He then continued observing the screen ahead of his as the vessels buzzing with Existential Extremity Authorities all around the Existential Domain Outpost of the Imperium...soon lost their light and began to crumble before they disappeared into nothingness, and the Existential Domain ahead that was being protected this whole time...
It began to lose its luster at a ridiculously rapid pace!
Within the next few seconds, the Existential brilliance around this Domain faded rapidly before it also began to crumble, a massive implosion blooming out thereafter due to this instability!
Countless shattered Planes of Existence then became strewn about, the bodies of injured Imperium Knights that were within this outpost roaring out in shock as before they could do anything...

They showed similar eyes of horror as something even their wills couldn't grasp appeared near them, and even as they activated their Existential Extremity Authorities or even grasped the Codexes of Extremity in the hands of a select few of them...none of it mattered.
Their bodies became dried husks as they were pierced by a jagged weapon moments later, and they then turned into glimmers of ash that were devoured entirely.
Noah watched this dreadful scene with somber eyes, observing firsthand how an Existential Domain and forces of the Imperium that were shining brilliantly just moments ago...
had all just disappeared as if they didn't exist!

chapters.title: Chapter 3093 Unseen Enemies! II
paragraphs: 3093 Unseen Enemies! II
He couldn't see them.
And up until the very last moment, even those who were directly in front of them couldn't see them!
It meant that one could not rely on their own Will or sensory Existential Extremity Authorities- with these Entities actually bypassing all of these.
There were too many bundles of information from what Noah had just seen as the smallest details provided the biggest clues.

One of the more dreadful clues was the fact that no matter if it was a Sequor Stage Imperium Knight or a Teleios Stage Imperium Knight, the moment they became aware of the enemy...they died as if their Realm didn't matter.

Another was the fact that even though their Existential Extremity Authorities erupted out, with those holding Codexes of Extremity even causing the descent of the influence of Omniversal Authorities...none of it helped.
When whatever enemy struck, they all died in the next moment regardless!
It meant that the enemies Noah was looking at were those who could theoretically bypass the weavings of Existential Extremity Authorities and to an extent, Lesser Omniversal Authorities!
And if Noah connected the disappearance of the weavings of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Deorcnysse...then an even more horrific reality lay ahead.
Noah watched with a pondering gaze as on the illusory screen he was focused on, he saw that once more...the scenery began to change rapidly at great speeds.
As if the enemy he was focused on was moving yet again.
A lot about them was unknown even now as Noah was mulling over the grandest and most terrifying thing.
He...was the Weaver of Extremity.
He was the Weaver of Existence.
And yet...he couldn't even see these Entities.
What did this mean?
Were they not within the bounds of Extremes and Existence? Were they outside of it entirely?
The antithesis of Existence itself? Was this why they couldn't even be seen by one's senses?
The only thing Noah could affirm was that moments before the Imperium Knights died, they did manage to see their enemies with their own eyes!
With one's own naked eye.
If Noah wanted even a glimpse of these beings, he had to observe them with his own eyes by appearing in any of the locations he could see in these illusory screens before him!
Such a thing came with immense risks when there was still so much that wasn't known regarding these enemies as Noah wouldn't do so just yet.
Even though he had the Ascendant Existential Extremity Clones.
Even though they couldn't die due to the Steles of Ascensions in his Existential Dominium and within the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed!
The risk was still too high as while he kept his eyes on the constantly changing screens in front of him that held unseen enemies, his intent weaved out.
|What have you recorded regarding Non-existence...or Anti-
Existence?|
His weavings were asking none other than the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed itself.
His construct that held grand ideals!
His construct that didn't deny anything that Entropy had uttered out.
Its database of knowledge was constantly expanding as its weavings intricately went out across the Omniverse, and its voice echoed out at this moment straight into Noah's mind.
|Much of it is conjecture and theories, but the very definition of Anti-Existence would not correlate with the same distinctions of life and death, of light and dark, or beginning and ending.|

The voice of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed was filled with immense serenity as it echoed out in Noah's head, his eyes and will locked onto the many Illusory screens around him as he nodded.
And the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed continued.

|If we are currently contained in a System that we consider Existence, then Anti-Existence would reside in another System entirely. There may be the flow of time and space, there may not. Time may flow in reverse or in other directions. Entities within that space would likely consider their System perfectly normal and how things should be, and they could even refer to our system as the one of Anti-
Existence.|
WAA!
Profound words echoed out from the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed as it continued!

|Entities within that System may have an entirely different progression of power, or they may not even have anything alongside the concept of energy, mana, or Authorities. They may simply just...be. They could just be what they are, and if they come across anything from our System- something reliant and cognizant of Existential Extremity Authorities and Omniversal Authorities...this may not mean much to them or affect them in any way.|

|What we find impossible could be the reality in their System, something they consider perfectly normal may be a complete violation of the set reality within our System. This...is just a working theory as it could have many gaps within it.|
Words that forced one to ponder echoed out from the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed as Noah's eyes shone brightly while he asked.
|You believe these enemies we cannot see stem from another type of Existence than us entirely?|
A heavy question.
One that the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed didn't answer right away as after a pause...

|Inconclusive to say with complete confidence. An easy path can be taken to assume this possibility to be the reality and to then plan accordingly. But even then, an impossible task arrives as the question of how we could stand against such Enemies is brought forth. Because even if the systems we stem from are different, why is it so that our authorities can not perceive them? Why are Existential Extremity Authorities and Omniversal Authorities bypassed by these unknown enemies so easily as if they were not even there?|
Heavier and heavier questions were uttered out as the answers were hard to find!

Noah thought about the words of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed as many theories and possibilities rose within his mind as well, with his will currently focused on the wail that he cut off that was destabilizing the weavings of even his Desecrated Existential Chronos Domain.
It all pointed to the Unknown enemy standing directly opposite to everything they understood, and it left behind an even more perplexing question.
How did such enemies even get here?

chapters.title: Chapter 3094 Unseen Enemies! III
paragraphs: It was a question entirely deserving of an answer!

|If they stem from a different System of Existence entirely, the capability to travel is an almost impossible one as this causes the proposal of the question of how and why. Did they arrive here by mistake, or by purpose?|
The sonorous voice of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed reverberated out as Noah continued to state at the many illusory screens.
Under dilated time, what he had just observed on one screen happened in an infinitesimally short period of time as observing something else may take even longer.

But the information he had already obtained was enough to do many things. He needed to understand and theorize more regarding just what these Entities could be, and then when things aligned...come face to face with it to truly get a closer look at how he could counter it!
If he could do so, the cessation of weavings of countless Entities would be reversed while his own path would not be put in jeopardy.
His thoughts were innumerable as while they flowed...
DUM!
His heart beat.
And his skin reflected a constant surge of brilliance as the Ascendant Existential Engine of Cultivation continued to churn.

He thought of where he currently was and how the next three days would pass in the Desecrated Existential Chronos Domain as he peered at the Prophecy the Protagonist had enacted what seemed like forever ago.
{Robbed Honor and glory become commonplace, their process undeniable once in place.
To ends of existence to the beginnings of extremes, a pioneer rises that has never been seen.
Legacies and Enclaves are many in between, but which can stand against an Omniversal engine?
Twist and turn, and turn again, until what is rare becomes all the same.
{Twist and turn, and turn again, all existence and non-existence shall bend all the same.
Twist and turn, and turn again, serfs and kings shall feel the same pain.
Twist and turn, and turn again, till the wheel of existence deviates and shatters from pulsing veins.
Twist and turn, and turn again, till a new Realm resonates with eons reign!}

The first four lines had seemingly all come to fruition, and these were the ones that the Protagonist had a direct control over before any influence of the Unknown Source that Noah had to find the weavings of in addition to the Unknown Enemy causing the cessation of weavings.
He instinctively knew the two parties were separate and distinct, but still kept in mind if there could be any connection!

But in terms of the Prophecy, him robbing glory and existence itself from other Entities, being a pioneer who enacted his own Realm, and even turning the rare Fruits of Existence into things that were commonplace for him...all of these seemed fairly accurate so far.
But the reference of the Omniversal Engine...was this still pertaining to the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed or his Ascendant Existential Engine of Cultivation- or even both?
Regardless of the truth, the first part of this prophecy had seemingly come to fruition as the latter part which had some influence from another party still held weavings that weren't entirely clear!
Existence and non-existence shall bend all the same. Everyone shall feel the same pain. Until the Wheel of Existence deviates and shatters from pulsing veins.
The Wheel of Existence.
Was this something metaphorical, or something entirely real?
For it to deviate and shatter, were the Unknown Enemies he theorized to be stemming from Anti-Existence the ones responsible, or was it the Unknown Source that influenced this Prophecy to begin with?
|Hey man.| Noah turned his head towards the Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of the Protagonist as he asked with sharp eyes.
|You want to shed some more light on this prophecy you made?|
The Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of the Protagonist scratched his head as within it, Noah's will buzzed and pondered.
It held a level of knowledge and control to steer a Prophecy towards a certain direction, but the result wasn't always something it could clearly grasp!
Noah knew this closely as he smiled at the action of talking to himself, his eyes continuing to gaze at and focus on the myriad of Illusory screens ahead of him as he spoke out.
|Alright, let's unleash the new prophecy...this time with no influences of unknown origins and somewhat enough clarity to easily grasp its meaning ourselves...|
WAA!
His intent was clear.
Over the next three days, great advances would be made as within them, a Prophecy would have to unfold from the Protagonist.
His Existential Dominium and Omniversal Organs would continue to be refined with every beat of his heart, and his Extremes would become even more powerful!

He would study the Greater Omniversal Authorities he had gained access to as both Aitia and Entropia were too vast to glean over, and the weavings of the lost Greater Omniversal Authority of Deorcnysse were ones that only he could revive...if he could get his hands on a unique Singularity.
There was much to do.

Noah stretched his hands as he looked over in the distance where after some time, new portals had appeared to show the figures of Kazuhiko, Emperor Penguin, the Blue Slime, Cimmerian Architect, and other renowned figures of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed making their entrance into an already unfolding feast.
It showed all cards that Noah had put into play were conducting their roles smoothly as with his focus on himself and on the screens around him...
|Let's go!|
He declared with a brilliant intent as he fully delved into what needed to be done!
And so...seconds began to pass in the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed.
And these seconds turned into minutes, and the minutes turned into hours!
Gradually, the violated flow of time continued within the Desecrated Existential Chronos Domain!
In a region of space filled with crackling waves of Existential Extremity Authorities and the glow of Omniversal Authorities that seemed ready to erupt at any moment.
The Legions of two forces faced each other with care and caution as they stemmed from the Imperium and the Sanctus Populi!

chapters.title: Chapter 3095 Dialogue! I
paragraphs: From the Sanctus Populi, the Elder Queen Mother of Dignity had an expression that was getting darker and darker as she relayed and relieved information regarding the current flow of weavings within the span of nanoseconds, and by the time that even a single second had passed, she felt an even heavier weight on her shoulder as if she had experienced a whole day! She looked towards the Commander of the opposing Legion as they seemed to have similar dark expressions, a dialogue being opened once more as the Martial Empress Yelena floated towards her again.
In the midst of two massive Legions, these two women gazed at each other as before Yelena could even open her mouth...
|Yes. All weavings for everyone show the exact same result. Complete cessation.|
The Elder Queen Mother of Dignity uttered out coldly as the expression on Yelena became even more unsightly!
She didn't even have to ask this question before she got a reply as she sighed deeply in her heart, gazing at this representative of the Sanctus Populi as she voiced out calmly.

|The Imperium will put all Legions on hold as we gain a better understanding of this situation. I've been given orders to designate this location as an Existential Salvus Domain. A representative among the Pillars of the Imperium will come as the Sanctus Populi and the Imperium share their findings and countermeasures for what is to come.|
HUUM!
Words that were sufficient enough to cause immense shock echoed out from Martial Empress Yelena.
The Imperium said what?
Seeing the eyes of incredulity and distrust from the Elder Queen Mother, Martial Empress Yelena could understand them very well as even she was taken back!
She expected the same pushback and belligerence as before, with those above her remaining staunch on what they wished to do on their glorious view of the Omniverse.
Yet the cessation of all weavings had spooked them much more than even the weavings of Cataclysm that were spreading.
Those weavings were heard about from others.
The complete cessation of all possible paths...all of them felt it!
Regardless of how powerful they were.
It gave them such a shock that they even did the unthinkable- The Great Imperium created a dialogue with another faction and even proposed looking for countermeasures together!
What a change!
What a ridiculous change from the occurrence of a single event.
It was so heavy that due to wanting to protect their own interests or ensure their ineffable longevity, the Imperium actually brought the Sanctus Populi to the table.

Both the Elder Queen Mother of Dignity and Martial Empress Yelena allowed such a reality to settle in their minds as they gazed at each other, the gaze of the Elder Queen Mother remaining difficult and cautious as she replied.
|I will...pass the word.|
Caution.
Uncertainty.
These weavings were buzzing in overabundance at this moment as towards an extremely uncertain future filled with multiple ways on the collapse of reality, an interesting reality began to unfold!
The decisions were made within the span of a second.
And the weavings of existence carried on.
Within the Inner Domain of Pompeii.

Martial Emperor Xi and his Legions absorbed the dazzling glow of the silver sea around them with stern expressions, the gaze of Martial Emperor Xi constantly changing at the last second as he received newer and newer information!

He continued to monitor the figure of the devilishly handsome man with a gorgeous woman along with two Omniversal Pillagers, as well as the large groups of titanic Omniversal Pillagers even further within the depths of the silver sea.
But his gaze couldn't leave the devilishly handsome man who had been seemingly devouring so much of the silver sea at a rate that seemed tens of thousands of times more than them!
The dazzling sea was visibly reducing at a speed visible to the naked eye as this Entity was deemed the most dangerous by Martial Emperor Xi.
And as he studied this being closely...
Within the passing nanoseconds, a group of Omniversal Pillagers led by one with the likeness of a Two-Legged Draconic Crow with blazing black wings began coming towards the direction of this being.
Its visage was mighty and filled with ancientness, its draconic head burning with obsidian flames as it made a beeline straight towards the devilish entity!
Multicolored splendor wrapped around this Two-Legged Draconic Crow as it was on the same stage of power as Martial Emperor Xi- above Teracosm!

Such a being moved rapidly and came to appear in front of this devilish Entity, and shockingly...the Entity merely rose his head up to meet such a massive Omniversal Pillager and its entourage calmly as if he held no ounce of fear.
No preparation. No rush of authority.
Nothing!
He only stared at the Entity directly before him as after the twisting and distortion of reality, the Two-Legged Draconic Crow actually didn't attack, its intent weaving out at this time.

|Our Master sees that you are connected to the Sanctus Populi, Imperium, and even hold sway over some...lesser Omniversal Pillagers. He wishes to meet you for a discussion over the course of recent events.|
The intent was picked up by Martial Emperor Xi as his eyes became ever sharper.
The Master of the Omniversal Pillagers?
A discussion over the course of recent events?!
Martial Emperor Xi reported these words right away across the weavings of his Enclave and Imperium, and he then thought about it deeply.
Even the Omniversal Pillagers were affected by the cessation of weavings as their Master...their Master sought a dialogue with the Sanctus Populi and Imperium!
But...this Entity did not belong to the Imperium, so why would the Master of the Omniversal Pillagers seek this devilish Entity?
This Entity that Martial Emperor Xi did not know the distinction of.
But he was the Weaver of Existence.
And his eyes met the Two-Legged Draconic Crow and the Omniversal Pillagers behind it calmly as he spoke out with calmness.
|Your Master knows where I am if he wishes to meet.|
WAA!

|Our Master sees that you are connected to the Sanctus Populi, Imperium, and even hold sway over some...lesser Omniversal Pillagers.
He wishes to meet you for a discussion over the course of recent events.|
The intent was picked up by Martial Emperor Xi as his eyes became ever sharper.
The Master of the Omniversal Pillagers?
A discussion over the course of recent events?!
Martial Emperor Xi reported these words right away across the weavings of his Enclave and Imperium, and he then thought about it deeply.
Even the Omniversal Pillagers were affected by the cessation of weavings as their Master...their Master sought a dialogue with the Sanctus Populi and Imperium!
But...this Entity did not belong to the Imperium, so why would the Master of the Omniversal Pillagers seek this devilish Entity?
This Entity that Martial Emperor Xi did not know the distinction of.
But he was the Weaver of Existence.
And his eyes met the Two-Legged Draconic Crow and the Omniversal Pillagers behind it calmly as he spoke out with calmness.
|Your Master knows where I am if he wishes to meet.|
WAA!

chapters.title: Chapter 3096 Dialogue! II
paragraphs: It was within the time flow of nanoseconds!

In these nanoseconds, The Weaver of Existence showed complete disregard for the authority of the entity behind the Omniversal Pillagers- uttering out words that even caused Asterias Virgo to gaze at him in shock.
One must know, this was the Master of the Omniversal Pillagers that the Two-Legged Draconic Crow was referring to.
The Eonic Uterra!
Known only by their shocking distinction and secrecy by a select few, even the Imperium did not know too much about this being!
Why had such an Entity taken an interest in Noah at a time like this?
As grand a question as this was, the even grander reality was Noah's response.
His words were so calm and succinct that when heard, everyone was taken aback for an instant.
And within the span of a nanosecond thereafter...
The power of an Entity above the Teracosm Stage spilled out as multicolored brilliance unfolded.
Multicolored.
The weavings of existence after the golden brilliance of Teracosm.
It was a stage known by no other name than the Paracosm Realm!
A Realm taken by Martial Emperors and truly powerful Elder Queens- A realm that most renowned powerful Entities across the Omniverse spent all of their lives in.
Most powerful Entities...not all!

But it was a stage of immeasurable power as after one devoured enough Fruits of Existence or sufficient equivalent resources or a great number of years in elevating their Existential Dominium....they would arrive at Paracosm.
The word itself was unique as it held many meanings, one of the more relevant ones being...an imaginary world.
An imaginary state of existence.
A state of mind that affected how one thought, acted and interacted with their surrounding reality.
It veered more towards an imaginary state of existence, and yet Entities at this stage...what they imagined did not remain imaginary.
Their Existential Extremity Authorities brought it to fruition!
Even as Noah replied to this Two-Legged Draconic Crow before him at the Paracosm Stage of the Existential Dominium Realm, he knew that his current self wouldn't be able to topple or defeat it.
But after the days spent in the Desecrated Existential Chronos Domain that was about to end soon...his weavings also told him he had no cause to run scared before this Entity.
HUUM!
His eyes twinkled as the authority of the Weaver of Existence and Extremity bloomed.
And an array of details appeared before his eyes as he looked at the flaming Draconic Crow before him!

{Two-Legged Draconic Crow- Gavan Idoma}:: Even though their weavings are wrapped tightly by a veil of influence of Lesser Omniversal Authorities constantly and the glow of a Paracosm Existential Dominium, some details about this creature were still able to be discerned. With a heavy focus on power, this Entity forged its Existential Dominium Body to the absolute limit, finally becoming capable of tipping into the Paracosm Stage and forging an Inner Existential Paracosm Omniverse Seed. Their Existential Body would never have its defenses pierced so long as its Inner Existential Paracosm Omniverse Seed is preserved, and could one gain access to it if it is protected by an unconquerable body? It's power is-
WAA!
Noah was unveiling records of this being. He was!
But then his weavings buzzed and went haywire as another was inserted in right away!
|A clue for the rebirth of the lost Greater Omniversal Authority of Deorcnysse has appeared!|

|The death of a Paracosm Stage Entity is nearly an impossibility, but if you manage to achieve it, they will leave behind an Existential Paracosm Omniversal Seed that can be utilized as the singularity to contain the complex weavings of an Omniversal Authority.|
He was only viewing the details of the Two-Legged Draconic Crow.
And yet inadvertently, he gained information on how he could bring back the Greater Omniversal Authority of Deorcnysse that only he held the records of in his Quintessential Codex of Extremity!
All that had to be done...was to achieve the impossible.
To take down a Paracosm Stage Entity when Noah had just gotten the surety of taking down average Teracosm Stage Entities seconds ago.
As for how much his strength had risen in the Desecrated Existential Chronos Domain?
This question couldn't be answered so simply.
HUUM!

The massive Existential Body of the Two-Legged Draconic Crow pulsed as it felt like the influence of a dozen Lesser Omniversal Authorities was instantly deployed and obeying its will, with the glow of a Greater Omniversal Authority also coming down as in front of it- what Existential Extremity Authority could oppose it?!
Common Existential Extremity Authorities of even Teracosm Stage may be bent and dissipated by such a pressure.
Common Authorities.
What Noah had...was in no way common.
|Arise.|
He spoke with shining eyes in the face of the Paracosm Stage Entity who wanted to express its power against him.
It wasn't a true attack. It was merely a pressure to defeat one's Will and bring them in line!

But against such a thing- against an Entity whose Inner Existential Paracosm Omniversal Seed could dream anything and bring it to reality...Noah called out his Existential Extremity Authorities to wrap around him.
Well, he called out his Ascendant Existential Extremity Authorities to weave around him!
WU!
Multiple colors blazed around him as they bloomed out like crackling tendrils of lightning that danced madly.
They were thick and massive, one simmering with a cerulean splendor while another shone deeply gold, while another was a murky purple tendril of thick lightning and another was colorless!

Such thick coilings that looked like massive serpents of Ascendant Existential Extremity Authorities wrapped around Noah as his visage remained...undaunted against the pressure of a Paracosm Stage Entity before him!
It was a scene that caused many pupils to dilate.
Even the visage of Sona beside him opened her red lips in surprise, loosening her battle stance that seemed ready to go at any moment.
All eyes were on Noah's vibrant show of Authorities as everyone felt like they were Existential Extremity Authorities...and yet they also felt foreign at the same time!
What was this? Just what Authority had this Entity unveiled?

chapters.title: Chapter 3097 Dialogue! III
paragraphs: An authority that many didn't recognize!

Even the eyes of the massive Two-Legged Draconic Crow blazed with black flames as it seemed about to erupt with even grander fervor, especially as coilings of its Paracosm Stage Authority was actually being rebuffed against the massive tendrils of serpentine like Authorities.
And yet in the next moment... its eyes glazed crimson.
Its figure came to a stop.
The Authorities raging around it came to a stop.
And in the next moment...
|Interesting.|
A guttural and utterly thick intent boomed out.
It was not an intent belonging to the Two-Legged Draconic.
And yet it came out of the Two-Legged Draconic Crow!
Hearing this intent, the figures of Little CaCuLaTan and Asterias Virgo behind Noah trembled.

The other Omniversal Pillagers behind the Two-Legged Draconic Crow trembled and subsequently bent their bodies with respect and obedience, with such a reality continuing to flow across the Sacred Natal Omniversal Sea of Pompeii in the far distance where other groups of Omniversal Pillagers absorbing the silver waters all seemed to stop what they were doing and pay their respects right away!
To a singular intent.
One they had only heard through the weavings of Greater Omniversal Authorities every now and then!
The intent of the great Eonic Uterra!
Sona's visage was tense as along with Noah's careful eyes, they both gazed at the visage of the Two-Legged Draconic Crow that had changed drastically in aura in just an instant.

The eyes of the Paracosm Stage Entity had now taken a deeply crimson hue, the weavings of authorities fading from it as these eyes came to lock onto Noah's visage, a calm and brutal intent leaking out slowly at this time.
|You hold the last traces of my Deorcnysse, and now you show this...what a unique one you are.|
The words were heavy ones as Noah's eyes became sharp!
His Deorcnysse? It couldn't be his.

At most, maybe this Entity had nearly grasped the majority of the complex weavings of Deorcnysse as Noah saw Omniversal Pillagers utilizing it before, but this Greater Omniversal Authority should not have been theirs entirely!
After this Entity spoke such words, the head of the Two-Legged Draconic Crow turned up and gazed around before they continued.
|I experienced Deorcnysse being eaten up firsthand. I know the enemies that are causing the flies of the Sanctus Populi to tremble and the oh so great Imperium to churn.|
|I experienced Deorcnysse being eaten up firsthand. I know the enemies that are causing the flies of the Sanctus Populi to tremble and the oh so great Imperium to churn.|

His words caused the figures of Martial Kings and the Martial Emperor of the Imperium to blaze with intent, but he paid no attention to them as his intent continued- this time the gaze of the Two-Legged Draconic Crow coming to lock onto Noah again fully.

|Come to me. Since you hold the full threads of Deorcnysse, it can be weaved again. Its resurrection will hold some clues against the Worms that took it from me as after that...we can cleanse everything and go back to the times of controlled perilous destruction.|
WAA!
A call towards Noah.
A call towards the Weaver of Existence!
There was much to unpack regarding what the Intent of the Eonic Uterra had just weaved out, but one of the major things that Noah stuck with was...
'Worms?'
The identity of the Unknown enemies he couldn't even observe on the illusory screens of Existential Omniversal Editor.

The Eonic Uterra had managed to merely glimpse at their figures at least as Noah...he had only seen multiple destructive and horrific scenes in the last three seconds- or really, in the last three days within the Desecrated Existential Chronos Domain!
The scenes constantly shifted, but when they came to a stop, these Unknown Enemies- these entities that the Eonic Uterra had referred to as Worms...would only cause utter and complete destruction.
Two other Imperium Outposts that were filled with Teleios and Sequor Stage Entities, and even the brilliance of a few Teracosm Stage Entities. And yet even they fell without a fight.
Three Nests of Omniversal Pillagers- one led by a terrifying Five Winged Turtle who had nearly grasped the multicolored brilliance of Paracosm.
Noah saw how within a short period of time, an unseen force arrived in these locations as moments thereafter, there was nothing else alive in those regions.
Every ounce of Existential Extremity Authorities was devoured while any form of life was erased!
And towards all of this...a possible answer may lie in the decimated Greater Omniversal Authority of Deorcnysse?
Noah's eyes blazed with ever grander waves of brilliance as he looked at the Two-Legged Draconic Crow and the unfathomable Entity currently taking over its body.

He then remembered the new Prophecy that the Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of the Protagonist had weaved out along with his support in the last three days within the Desecrated Existential Chronos Domain as this molded his answer towards this being.
So when it came to the proposition of the Eonic Uterra...
|I have a lot to do as I won't be going to anyone. As for the Greater Omniversal Authority of Deorcnysse...you must be mistaken!|
He denied the advances of the Eonic Uterra!
And all eyes watched with rapt attention as nobody knew what would happen next.
But uniquely...the figure of the Two-Legged Draconic Crow bathed with obsidian flames and crimson eyes that were sharing the sight of another only looked at Noah calmly in silence.
And the Will within it didn't utter another word as after the passage of a few nanoseconds, it disappeared entirely.
The eyes of the Two-Legged Draconic Crow stared towards Noah again as if it had returned to its old self, its coldness only becoming denser as Noah didn't care for it!
The Prophecy shed the path for him for the future to come.
Trust and cooperation would not be given so easily.
Especially not so towards the Omniversal Pillagers!

If the lost weavings of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Deorcnysse truly held an answer as they were the first things these Unknown Enemies- these Worms devoured, then Noah would bring back Deorcnysse himself and see just what clues it held!

chapters.title: Chapter 3098 Dialogue! IV
paragraphs: As if it had received orders.
The visage of the Two-Legged Draconic Crow and the entourage of Omniversal Pillagers around it retreated from this location and went deeper into the Sacred Natal Omniversal Sea of Pompeii.
An action that Noah looked at calmly as beside him, Sona's figure was even more stern as her voice echoed out.

|The cessation of weavings truly shook everyone up. The Imperium has declared an area where both their Legions and the Legions of the Sanctus Populi occupy as an Existential Salvus Domain. They will soon be having talks and sharing information on what enemy could be the cause of all this...|
An Existential Salvus Domain! It was basically an absolute zone that two sides agreed on, and this safe zone would never be violated!
Noah nodded calmly as even though it wasn't the weaving of reality that many expected, it was only natural after the lives of all of them were put on the line.

|Let's clear out this Greater Omniversal Domain of Pompeii and move on from here first. By that time, any talks should be done as the picture will be clearer. Do you still want to proceed with the Initiative?|
WAA!
The Initiative. It was something Sona was spearheading as it was being built to combat the Omniversal Destroyer!

Now, it was known that an Unknown Source had sought to influence Noah to be the Omniversal Destroyer as Sona kept the forging of the Initiative in order to combat this Unknown Source or if they were to influence another Entity to be the Destroyer.
But now, something even more drastic that was causing complete cessation of weavings arose as...
|Haa...| Sona massaged her forehead at such a dilemma as she thought of all the plans and weavings from before and where they stood at now.

She looked towards Little CaCuLaTan who was the third member of the Initiative and those who were planned to come next, thinking of the twins who had arrived within this same Sacred Natal Omniversal Sea of Pompeii near them as her gaze became firm!
|I'll have another body of mine continue this as a contingency. For now, I'll follow your lead|

The grand Initiative she had begun building and had foreseen for too many years. To let it go so easily wasn't something she could do as she still wanted to follow the weavings of collecting Anomalous Entities to combat what was coming- even if she had to do it on the side!
Beside her, Noah nodded while gazing at the clearly sunk silver sea from his ridiculous absorption.
|Alright, let's go!|
With an intentful glimmer, Noah's figure shot out towards the depths of the Sacred Natal Omniversal Sea of Pompeii!
In the back of his mind, he was thinking of the tremendous progress made in the last three days in the Desecrated Existential Chronos Domain.
He was thinking of a new prophecy that had been unveiled by the Protagonist within that period of time!
{In the midst of a war for existence itself.
Sabotage and subterfuge will unveil itself.
From the hands of those born from destruction, the horn of the end will only serve a single function.
The Wheel of Existence churns and churns again.
Until the day an irreversible choice blooms for the sake of an existential gain.
Endless weavings of Ascension flow unfiltered across Omniversal Veins.
And even this may not be enough to end an endless campaign!}
Yes!
Through the weavings of the Protagonist, Noah enacted another Prophecy with the aid of Greater Omniversal Authorities, and while the product was still grand, it also finished on a heavy tone.

He steered it as best as he could towards brilliance as he sought to understand more of what was coming in the future weavings, and yet the prophecy had still ended up expressing such a somber tone at its very end.
But it did give him a glimpse of what was to come as he didn't jump on the flow of the Eonic Uterra.
{In the midst of a war for existence itself.
Sabotage and subterfuge will unveil itself.
From the hands of those born from destruction, the horn of the end will only serve a single function.}
These words were crucial.

It seemed like under the threat of the cessation of all weavings, multiple groups were seeking to come together and put their differences aside to see how they could survive this, but even within these groups supposedly getting together...sabotage would bloom.
Subterfuge would flow freely!
Across the vast stretches of the Omniverse.
The oddities and wonders stretched out were innumerable to count, and the weavings of Extremes and Existence even more so.
Far away from any colonized and explored Domains of the Omniverse.

Masked within the weavings of existence and uncertainty, and held together by a distortion of space and time, there was a unique point of intersection where the complex weavings of multiple Greater Omniversal Authorities came together.

At this Intersection, immense waves of power flowed as at this moment, a slumbering will was roused after sensing certain changes from parameters it had set long before it had fallen into its slumber!
Akin to an ancient beast awakening.
Akin to an immeasurably powerful Will coming to!
The weavings of multiple Greater Omniversal Authorities intersecting here were roused and burned with activity as...
|What?|
An intent of incredulity echoed out from the waking will.
It had planned for so many things all this time as the weavings it was waking up to were so baffling that they had to pause!
|The war that should have been unfolding...how is it that it has all but disappeared? The Imperium Legions meeting the Legions of the Sanctus Populi?!|
HUUM!
The situation was unprecedentedly different from how it should have been playing out!
For its purpose, for its weavings...
The Imperium had to accelerate conflict!
The Sanctus Populi had to retaliate in kind!
And in the middle of it all, the Omniversal Pillagers would continue their destruction and muddy the waters even more.
They would all pick up the clues it had left behind and antagonize a single Entity.
The finest piece of work with untapped potential it had seen as of yet.
It's Magnum Opus that was just in the beginning stages!
And yet...
And yet...!

sentences.text: As if it had received orders.
The visage of the Two-Legged Draconic Crow and the entourage of Omniversal Pillagers around it retreated from this location and went deeper into the Sacred Natal Omniversal Sea of Pompeii.
An action that Noah looked at calmly as beside him, Sona's figure was even more stern as her voice echoed out.
|The cessation of weavings truly shook everyone up.
The Imperium has declared an area where both their Legions and the Legions of the Sanctus Populi occupy as an Existential Salvus Domain.
They will soon be having talks and sharing information on what enemy could be the cause of all this...|
An Existential Salvus Domain!
It was basically an absolute zone that two sides agreed on, and this safe zone would never be violated!
Noah nodded calmly as even though it wasn't the weaving of reality that many expected, it was only natural after the lives of all of them were put on the line.
|Let's clear out this Greater Omniversal Domain of Pompeii and move on from here first.
By that time, any talks should be done as the picture will be clearer.
Do you still want to proceed with the Initiative?|
WAA!
The Initiative.
It was something Sona was spearheading as it was being built to combat the Omniversal Destroyer!

Now, it was known that an Unknown Source had sought to influence Noah to be the Omniversal Destroyer as Sona kept the forging of the Initiative in order to combat this Unknown Source or if they were to influence another Entity to be the Destroyer.
But now, something even more drastic that was causing complete cessation of weavings arose as...
|Haa...| Sona massaged her forehead at such a dilemma as she thought of all the plans and weavings from before and where they stood at now.

She looked towards Little CaCuLaTan who was the third member of the Initiative and those who were planned to come next, thinking of the twins who had arrived within this same Sacred Natal Omniversal Sea of Pompeii near them as her gaze became firm!
|I'll have another body of mine continue this as a contingency.
For now, I'll follow your lead|
The grand Initiative she had begun building and had foreseen for too many years.
To let it go so easily wasn't something she could do as she still wanted to follow the weavings of collecting Anomalous Entities to combat what was coming- even if she had to do it on the side!
Beside her, Noah nodded while gazing at the clearly sunk silver sea from his ridiculous absorption.
|Alright, let's go!|
With an intentful glimmer, Noah's figure shot out towards the depths of the Sacred Natal Omniversal Sea of Pompeii!
In the back of his mind, he was thinking of the tremendous progress made in the last three days in the Desecrated Existential Chronos Domain.
He was thinking of a new prophecy that had been unveiled by the Protagonist within that period of time!
{In the midst of a war for existence itself.
Sabotage and subterfuge will unveil itself.
From the hands of those born from destruction, the horn of the end will only serve a single function.
The Wheel of Existence churns and churns again.
Until the day an irreversible choice blooms for the sake of an existential gain.
Endless weavings of Ascension flow unfiltered across Omniversal Veins.
And even this may not be enough to end an endless campaign!}
Yes!
Through the weavings of the Protagonist, Noah enacted another Prophecy with the aid of Greater Omniversal Authorities, and while the product was still grand, it also finished on a heavy tone.

He steered it as best as he could towards brilliance as he sought to understand more of what was coming in the future weavings, and yet the prophecy had still ended up expressing such a somber tone at its very end.
But it did give him a glimpse of what was to come as he didn't jump on the flow of the Eonic Uterra.
{In the midst of a war for existence itself.
Sabotage and subterfuge will unveil itself.
From the hands of those born from destruction, the horn of the end will only serve a single function.}
These words were crucial.

It seemed like under the threat of the cessation of all weavings, multiple groups were seeking to come together and put their differences aside to see how they could survive this, but even within these groups supposedly getting together...sabotage would bloom.
Subterfuge would flow freely!
Across the vast stretches of the Omniverse.
The oddities and wonders stretched out were innumerable to count, and the weavings of Extremes and Existence even more so.
Far away from any colonized and explored Domains of the Omniverse.

Masked within the weavings of existence and uncertainty, and held together by a distortion of space and time, there was a unique point of intersection where the complex weavings of multiple Greater Omniversal Authorities came together.

At this Intersection, immense waves of power flowed as at this moment, a slumbering will was roused after sensing certain changes from parameters it had set long before it had fallen into its slumber!
Akin to an ancient beast awakening.
Akin to an immeasurably powerful Will coming to!
The weavings of multiple Greater Omniversal Authorities intersecting here were roused and burned with activity as...
|What?|
An intent of incredulity echoed out from the waking will.
It had planned for so many things all this time as the weavings it was waking up to were so baffling that they had to pause!
|The war that should have been unfolding...how is it that it has all but disappeared?
The Imperium Legions meeting the Legions of the Sanctus Populi?!|
HUUM!
The situation was unprecedentedly different from how it should have been playing out!
For its purpose, for its weavings...
The Imperium had to accelerate conflict!
The Sanctus Populi had to retaliate in kind!
And in the middle of it all, the Omniversal Pillagers would continue their destruction and muddy the waters even more.
They would all pick up the clues it had left behind and antagonize a single Entity.
The finest piece of work with untapped potential it had seen as of yet.
It's Magnum Opus that was just in the beginning stages!
And yet...
And yet...!

chapters.title: Chapter 3099 Dialogue! V
paragraphs: |You were supposed to fight...you were supposed to antagonize him! Kill his family, destroy his home! This...!|
Within the Intersection of multiple Omniversal Authorities.
An intent that had begun to bubble with rage echoed out as it read the current weavings of the Omniverse with its consciousness stretched out across multiple Greater Omniversal Authorities.
The plans it had spent so much of its authority on until it was forced to go back into a slumber seemed to be breaking right before it, and it didn't even know why.
It.
This was the only designation and distinction that it could truly be given.
It was not a being.
It was not a Will.
It was a collection of weavings that had been oppressed and ground down for countless years by the Imperium.
The maddening intent of an Existential Omniversal Lineage flowed through it as its very people were massacred and made slaves by the Imperium to farm Resources eons ago!
Its strongest forces were barely able to leave behind glimmers of their weavings through the Greater Omniversal Authorities they were connected to.
Barely.

But even then, they could barely make any moves as they had to remain within the boundaries of the Greater Omniversal Authorities! And ant moves made came at a huge cost as they had to be moves filled with surety of their purpose.
To utterly decimate those that turned even the remnants of their Omniversal Lineage into Seeds.
The decimation of the Imperium!
But this...
What had happened?
The weavings of an Unknown Source buzzed and attained waves of feedback from the Greater Omniversal Authorities it was connected to.
And moments after...
Space trembled.
|What is this?|
WAA!
|What is that?|
Words that were laced with incredulity.
It was the words of something finding out about the weavings of terrifying anomalies that were spreading out and devouring everything- even the Sources of Greater Omniversal Authorities themselves!
They were the reason why everything had shifted and became the way it currently was.
And yet...the Unknown Source didn't find itself filled with wrath towards them.
Its weavings calmed.

It looked at the small bits of information it had received as its collective consciousness became increasingly bright, recalling some of the ancient weavings of history its people had glimpsed eons ago- long before even the Imperium came to be!
Of times old and grand.
Of times of tales and terrors about the Omniverse that many of them dismissed as sheer fantasy.
Within those immeasurably old times, they had learned stories about certain Entities.
Certain things!
When the collective Will blazing in the intersection of the weavings of multiple Greater Omniversal Authorities thought of this, its brilliance only became more intricate as its intent began to plan!
|If it is them...|
HUUM!
|If it is them, then they should be capable of achieving my dream with ease.|
Its intent stated terrifying words.
But it knew them to be true.

Based on the weavings of the few traces of information it had discovered about what made the Imperium Legions stop their warring, if those entities who somewhat fit the description of the horror stories it knew of from eons past...they truly wouldn't have any problems!

But just in case those stories from the past were truly fantasies to make the citizens of the unified Existential Omniversal Lineage of Lumen scared, it had to ensure that whatever these entities were...would succeed in their purpose.
Thus, it couldn't have the war come to an end.
And when it thought about all the movable pieces, its gaze went towards the one it had influenced before.
Weavings of this being arose as...he had a lot of untapped potential, but it needed true rage to be directed and let loose.
If it didn't have that, its potential was only being wasted!
So the collective consciousness within the intersection of the Greater Omniversal Authorities glanced elsewhere.

A way to achieve the steps it had already laid out for this being to still be influenced to become a Destroyer, and new weavings to break the forming alliances of monsters and those they used to hunt.
New weavings to ensure that the factions of this Omniverse do not begin to be united to stand against this common enemy!
|The Imperium must pay...|
The voice dripped with immeasurable pain and hatred as it spoke.
Its collective consciousness was made up of many beings as they all felt the same way.
There was no dissonance.
|For all that they did, they have to receive the same retribution of destruction...no matter what.|
There was no dissonance within the weavings of Hatred, but they still understood full well what they were supporting here.
To attain the destruction of the Imperium, they would go as far as to damn everything in the Omniverse if they had to.
|For scorching our Omniversal Lineage out of existence...for enslaving our brethrens for eons...We curse you, O Imperium, we curse you!|
WAA!
Their weavings moved across the Omniversal Authorities around the intersection and spread out.
They went out towards the one group that could be ushered into chaos and utilized.
One group that a single Entity was controlling through Omniversal Authorities- the Omniversal Pillagers!

|Turn brazen and numb. Lose your minds in hatred and fervor...imitate, kill, and do what can to ensure no unity. Give these Unknown Devourers the chance to destroy everything if they can, and if they really are from the Fables of Fantasy from eons past...haha, then all of this is worthless as even without lifting a finger, they will all be destroyed with surety.|
It could feel its madness within its endless wrath.
It could feel it, but at this point, it didn't care.
What was left of its weavings would not remain alive and consciousness for even another millennium.
It had done the impossible to even survive this much as with every push and pull of the Omniversal Authorities its weavings were connected to, it died a little bit more.
Since death was predetermined for it and all of its Omniversal Lineage, then what harm was there in letting others follow this path?
|Revel in the coming destruction...twist and turn, and turn again. Until the very Wheel of Existence is shattered...haha!|
Sadness and melancholy flowed amidst the wrath and madness.
But madness and wrath won out in the end!
