chapters.title: Chapter 3100 Fragile Alliances! I
paragraphs: |Haaa...|
It almost felt like wheezing.
Like a laugh, and yet also the last dying breath of something that used to be so complex before!
It was the power of the collection of consciousness within the intersection of multiple Greater Omniversal Authorities constantly being drained out as it laid out its cards for the last time.
It knew full well that after doing such a thing, the slumber it would fall into would be its final one.
It wouldn't even be able to witness the product of its work!
But it knew.
It knew that it had to work!
An immeasurably far distance away from the intersection of the weavings of Greater Omniversal Authorities.
Noah's figures and Ascendant Existential Extremity Clones were still within the Desecrated Existential Chronos Domain even as the three day dilated time came to an end.
DUM!
His heart continued to beat.
WAA!
And brilliance radiated on his body as the Ascendant Existential Engine of Cultivation continued to churn and further drive up his power.
But there was a question of just how much his power had risen.
How could such a thing be quantified?

One could observe his Invictus Dominium Wings at this moment and see an entirely potent hue of blazing gold, without a single purple light visible as around the wings on his feet and back, liquid gold flames constantly fell.
Golden flames of glorious brilliance fell from his Invictus Dominium Wings as they swirled below his feet like a circular platform of flames that followed him wherever he went!
Some tendrils of these liquid gold flames would rotate around his figure as his whole look was something too mesmerizing for others to even glimpse.
This was his look.
But it didn't express too much on just how different he was compared to himself from three days ago as to quantify this...
HUUM!
Deep within himself, he felt weavings churn as his eyes became glazed gold.
His Existential Fidelis Dominium Heart and his Existential Invictus Dominium Wings buzzed!
And moments after, prompts arose before his eyes.
|Your false weavings were glanced upon and reviewed by a possible target of high priority.|
|Your Distinctions as the Weaver of Existence and Extremity have risen from the stage of Adult Weaver and into the stage of Elder Weaver as they can grasp an unfathomable number of things.|
WAA!
Yes.

After the constant beating of his heart every second, and being bathed with a light of strengthening each of these seconds for tens of thousands of times in the last day, everything about his existence was elevated.
His Existential Dominium.
His Extremes.
His Omniversal Organs.
His Lineage.
And his Distinctions.
He had become an Elder Weaver of Existence and Extremity!
And because of such a profound elevation in authority, he could see things that were not privy to him before!
|With a great reduction in its power and an overall elevation of power on your side, the weavings of the Unknown Source that sought to influence your path have been uncovered.|
The weavings of an Unknown Source!
The thing that tried to steer Noah towards the weavings of an Omniversal Destroyer!
Noah's eyes were sharp as he observed a massive illusory screen rise before his eyes, its contents buzzing briefly before they became pristinely clear.
They became clear to show the scene of splendorous multicolored brilliance- all culminating in massive tendrils of light that all converged together towards a single point.
|The weavings of A Greater Omniversal Intersect have been uncovered.|

|A Region rarely found across the Omniverse, but one that at this point in time has been uncovered to be some form of a doorway. It is a point where the weavings of multiple Greater Omniversal Authorities converge, with the weavings of the Unknown Source having been inadvertently connected to this Greater Omniversal Intersect for the last eons.|
A great deal of knowledge flooded into Noah as he watched the multicolored brilliance on the screen in front of him that all came together to a point of a single blazing singularity!
|The authority of the Elder Weaver of Extremity shines brightly.|
|The authority of the Elder Weaver of Existence burns with radiance!|
|The weavings of the Unknown Source that were not even able to be located before are currently being analyzed.|
WAA!
How powerful had Noah become in the last three days?
At this moment, some light was illuminated as Noah began to uncover the weavings of the terrifying Source- even if they were far more weakened at this moment than they ever were before!
It was done.
Its grand mission was complete as something irreversible had been put into play!
But the cost of it was far too high.
What remained of its collective consciousness could not take it any longer.
And such a thing only caused them to sigh in melancholy as they thought back to an immeasurably long time ago.
Their Existential Omniversal Lineage.
How glorious it was in the past. How many innumerable Existential Domains they controlled.
And yet now...it was all about to end.
With nobody here to even witness it!
|I am here to observe it.|
The barely remaining weavings of the Unknown Source trembled as it thought it was hearing things in its throes of death.
But no.
Its last remnants Will spread out and checked.

That was an intent. That was an intent from an unknown distance away as somehow...it had grown weak enough to the point that someone was able to arrive here? To even read the weavings of its emotions?
But the Unknown Source didn't have to ponder too long before the same intent it had heard before continued.
|What did you do just now? What caused the accelerated deterioration of your existence to even allow me to find you?|
You.
The collection of weavings thought of this word as it felt its radiance continue to dim.
You were...
|Noah Osmont. The one with...let's see, what did your weavings think of me? Oh, the one with untapped potential.|

chapters.title: Chapter 3101 Fragile Alliances! II
paragraphs: The fading will of the Unknown Source buzzed in shock at such words.

It came to a realization that this being hadn't just found its location, this being was actually breaking down its weavings and even retroactively going backward to unfurl weavings of its thoughts that had already occurred!
This...was Noah Osmont? The same one it had influenced towards becoming the Omniversal Destroyer? The same one with boundless untapped po-
|The one and the same.|
Even its weavings could be read smoothly and simply.
How had this being managed to do this? The untapped potential...was it actually tapped into?!
|Do not get distracted now, you don't have long.|
Yes.
It didn't have long.
Everything that it was and used to be was about to crumble into the vast weavings of the intersection of Omniversal Authorities.
But this voice.
This being.
How could it reach here?
In this space isolated from space and time, and even existence itself?
|Only my voice could reach here before. But I've analyzed enough weavings of this area right now as...|
CRACK!
From the point of the Intersect, the fading collection of consciousness raised its gaze and saw a cracked open up in space.
The crack was rectangular in nature, almost as if it were a screen of light as behind it, multicolored brilliance could be seen.
At its center, a figure draped in a murky purple Emperor's Robe could be seen, bright golden wings on his back and feet that burned with golden flames that coalesced all around him.
This being reached out from the other end of the rectangular screen and ripped it open from the very center- reality distorting as in the next moment, the film became malleable!
His figure stepped out from it.
And he arrived an immeasurably vast distance away- at a point very few ever knew the location of- and even few stumbled onto it.
At the Intersect of multiple Greater Omniversal Authorities.
At a Greater Omniversal Intersect!
The collective consciousness of what was left of a glorious Existential Omniversal Lineage stared at the figure of a man it had sought to influence.
Noah Osmont.
For him to be here right now...
|Yes, yes. Surprising as it is, but everything about you is fading quickly, so we have to get a move on.|

Noah's figure drew closer and closer to the Intersect as the murky purple brilliance of Entropy was so deep that it caused the surrounding calmness to teeter with even more chaos, his Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of Entropy arriving right before the intersection of multiple Greater Omniversal Authorities as his golden wings on his back and feet surged with gold flames!

As the Weaver of Existence, the very fabric of existence and reality could be discerned by him to simplicity, as the higher his authority and distinction were...the more secrets of existence he could uncover.

As the Weaver of Extremity, the very weavings of concepts taken to the Existential level were laid bare to him- with his capabilities to analyze them and break them down only increasing as this distinction became more powerful, and with him having the power to enact truly insane extremes under his banner.
With these two distinctions elevated to their current levels, his capabilities to analyze and understand had reached an unfathomable level.
To the extent that he could read the weavings of what the weakened collective consciousness was thinking even without it speaking.
To the extent that if he stood in front of any Entity at the Teracosm Stage right now...he could freely know their intent and what lay within the depths of their wills!

So at this moment, he was looking at collective consciousnesses that looked more like an amalgamation of Hatred that was slowly dying out, tightly clutching the authority of Greater Omniversal Authorities as when looking at this thing...thousands of prompts flowed into Noah's mind.
Prompts of pearls of information that he quickly organized, his intent leaking out.
|You...are the remnants of the Omniversal Lineage that the Imperium toppled. What remains of the ancient line of the Existential Omniversal Lineage of Lumen.|
Noah could feel the collective consciousness shake ever so slightly.
How did he know?
How did-
|Don't worry yourself with mysteries about me for now, as I said...you are about to fade away. So all of this was to resolve your Hatred against the Imperium as what did you choose to do?|
Noah's eyes burned brightly with golden flames.
He felt like he could see through everything in front of him.
As if he was breaking it all down piece by piece into weavings of information that he freely controlled!
And at this point as he uncovered many things, the silent intent of the collective consciousness within the intersection weaved out.

|We...chose damnation for everyone else. We chose to do everything we could to ensure that the Imperium does not form any alliances with their old enemies- no matter how fragile these alliances may be. Keep them divided. Keep them separate. So that these Unknown Devourers can keep erasing everything without fail!|
In its last breath.
In its last few seconds, it uttered this out as the calling of an endless slumber drew nearer!
Noah gazed into the Intersect with coldness and apathy as his weavings echoed out.
|You enraged me a great deal before by trying to steer my path. It matters not what fate befall your Lineage-|
|Quintillions fell!| ...!
In its last throes, the voice seemed filled with indignation as it bellowed out.

|Our homes were burnt! Our Lineage was scorched and diluted to nothing! Our reality was stripped from us to be added to others! Anything that remained, they enslaved! This is what the Imperium did! They deserve death! They all deserve death!|
WAA!
It sounded like the wailing of a dying animal.
It was nothing akin to the regality and wonder of an Omniversal Lineage.
Noah looked at the Intersect calmly while shaking his head.
|But you just made a decision to damn everything within this Omniverse, not just them.|
The collection of consciousnesses went silent.
Its remnant gaze went towards Noah before it croaked out.

|I made a move to keep everyone divided. But even this may have not been required as if those Unknown Devourers are what I believe they are...then our only regret is that we will not witness the Imperium burnt to ashes.|
Its words were enough to scare others.
But for Noah who had been reading its weavings...
|Oh yeah.|
HUUM!
His right hand reached out and plunged into the intersection of weavings of multiple Greater Omniversal Authorities.
His left hand showed the unfurling of a glorious Codex of Extremity.

|You seem to hold a great deal of knowledge. Of eons of time even before the Imperium. Just how did you all manage to fall? What did the Omniverse used to look like then? Before you go on and perish, let me Devourer what little is left of you, O Weavings of Lumen.|
His voice was of utter majesty.
And his golden wings dripping with flames blazed like an eonic torch as he reached out and grasped something at the depths of the Intersect!

This...was Noah Osmont?
The same one it had influenced towards becoming the Omniversal Destroyer?
The same one with boundless untapped po-
|The one and the same.|
Even its weavings could be read smoothly and simply.
How had this being managed to do this?
The untapped potential...was it actually tapped into?!
|Do not get distracted now, you don't have long.|
Yes.
It didn't have long.
Everything that it was and used to be was about to crumble into the vast weavings of the intersection of Omniversal Authorities.

This being.

In this space isolated from space and time, and even existence itself?

At the Intersect of multiple Greater Omniversal Authorities.
At a Greater Omniversal Intersect!

chapters.title: Chapter 3102 Fragile Alliances! III
paragraphs: Lumen.
It was a word closely related to light as the Existential Omniversal Lineage of Lumen...was a race of beings made of pure light.
Their blood flowed with waves of brilliance and majesty.
Their physiology was one that was closely attuned to existence itself as they were truly experts in traversing across the Realms of Existence.
|How did you all manage to fall...|
Noah's voice couldn't help but echo out as the last remnants of what used to be Lumen stared at him.
At him who held behind the last of its remains in the weavings of the intersection ahead of him, and he now breathed life into these weavings while devouring everything within their memories!
It was a terrifying thing as while he did so...
|The weavings of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Aitia are altering the flow of Causality in this area.|
|The First Component of Efficiency is burning with brilliance it further enhances the process you are carrying out.|
|The weavings of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Entropia are altering the flow of order and chaos in this area.|
A great deal of capabilities erupted with Noah at the helm as of them resulted in a single thing.
|Droves of weavings from the Existential Omniversal Lineage of Lumen are being grasped by you.|
He was extracting and attaining something that was about to be lost entirely in the river of existence!
So to his question.
Towards him asking how such a Lineage that had been around for eons could have possibly fallen.
What remained of the collective consciousness before utterly being ground down to nothing spoke calmly for the last time.

|Division and fracturing of our Royals kept our power apart and easier for enemies to rise. The wars each faction carried out. The hunger for more resources. Once divided, we were broken and conquered over time. Just like you all, just like us. History...will just repeat itself, Noah Osmont. Take whatever knowledge you can, and we would wish you the best of luck but...if those Unknown Devourers truly are what we think they may be...haha! Then all of you can simply say your goodbyes to this very Omniverse right now. Even the knowledge of those things was what caused our Existential Omniversal Emperor of Lumen to fall and start a cascade of events! Lumen shone brightly for eons, Noah Osmont. Your light...may not flicker for even a single year, much less a millennium.|
HUUUM!
With such a glimmer of brilliance and last words, what remained of the collective consciousness shattered.
It couldn't hold on any longer as the Unknown Source that had sought to influence Noah to become the Omniversal Destroyer faded.
Noah was silent at such a reality as felt the continuing inflow of weavings.
|The Infrastructure of the Existential Omniversal Lineage of Lumen is being broken down and categorized.|
|The Hierarchy of the Existential Omniversal Lineage of Lumen is being broken down and categorized.|
|The qualities of the bloodline of the Existential Omniversal Lineage of Lumen are being analyzed.|

|The Greater Omniversal Authority of Entropia blazes of brilliance, allowing a much greater influence to be taken from it as the transformation of the strongest qualities of the Existential Omniversal Lineage of Lumen can be extracted and added to your Existential Omniversal Emperor Lineage!|
In the death of the collective consciousness of the Unknown Source, Noah was making tremendous waves of gains.
Gains that could add fundamental changes to himself and his people if he deemed them consequential enough to incorporate them!
|The weavings of the Vessels, Forging, Farming, Cooking, Alchemy, and a myriad of other facets of the Existential Omniversal Lineage of Lumen are being extracted.|
The flow of information was not a simple one.
It was immeasurably dense as before everything faded about the dead collection within the Intersect, Noah devoured everything he could from it.
Alongside these waves of information, there was also the meaning of this location he was in, as well as what the remnants of the Omniversal Lineage of Lumen had done.
The location where multiple Greater Omniversal Authorities converged was known as a Greater Omniversal Intersect- a type of doorway. So, where did it lead exactly?
And as for what the remnants of the Existential Omniversal Lineage of Lumen had done?
Noah's head turned to a certain direction bathed with a multicolored light as if he could already sense the chaos that was about to unfold from it.
It was an overall negative for the Omniverse, but it was a positive for Noah.
This was because it opened up avenues of possibilities.
Possibilities that were about to unfold somewhere else as he...had to be at that location.
|Protagonist.|
So he called out.
Towards the Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of the Protagonist within the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed!
Within the bounds of the Salvus Domain set up between the Imperium and the Sanctus Populi.

Verdant and golden brilliance of auroras encircled this whole area as more and more Legions of both sides arrived, with the Elder Queen Mother of Life arriving beside the Elder Queen Mother of Dignity as opposite them, another Paracosm Martial Emperor who looked like a teenager arrived beside Martial Empress Yelena!
His gaze was cold and mighty as if everything here was beneath him- even in this situation.
He was only a glimmer of an Existential Omniversal Doppelganger that was already following close behind to eradicate those who had killed Reperiel and Archon Basileus Alderon.
One of the 81 Pillars of the Imperium.
A fraction of his power was here- this mere fraction expressing the heavy brilliance of Paracosm!
The two sides were staring at each other when all of a sudden, the face of the Elder Queen Mother of Dignity lit up as she received weavings from none other than a girl she was greatly worried about.
A certain Sanctus Princess Sona that had overheard the weavings that the Will of the Eonic Uterra was emanating in front of Noah!
|The Unknown Force behind the possible cessation of all weavings...their physiology is that of Worms!|
Worms.
This word spread around as the Doppelganger of a certain pillar of the Imperium made his eyes sharp, while Martial Empress Yelena replied succinctly.
|Worms? Where did thi-|
BOOM!
Her words didn't finish.

In the periphery of the newly enacted Salvus Domain, the influence of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Kataklysmos rained down as the last move of the remnant will of the Existential Omniversal Lineage of Lumen was initiated!

chapters.title: Chapter 3103 Fragile Alliances! IV
paragraphs: Kataklysmos.
A terrifying Greater Omniversal Authority that destroyed everything in its path.
And one that the top generals of the Eonic Uterra utilized apart from Deorcnysse.
The remnant will of the Existential Omniversal Lineage of Lumen was restricted and weakened after all of these eons, but the last shred of their power was not something to underestimate!
For their dying breath, they triggered unique means to remove the limiters of destruction certain Entities had.
They were already destructive.
They always lived and thrived in destruction.
The weavings of the collective consciousness simply enhanced this destructiveness while directing it in a certain direction!
And so...
BOOM!
Space above fractured as a heavy bombardment of Greater Omniversal Authorities swung down, all of them directed towards the Imperium Legions as the Source of these attacks didn't reveal itself.
|Daring to violate the grace of the Imperium?! Of the Salvus Domain?!|
The bellow of the Doppelganger of one of the Pillars of the Imperium boomed out coldly as the harrumph of the Elder Queen Mother of Dignity rang out calmly in reply.
|Such a vile Authority does not stem from us and you know it!|
WAA!
The space above splintered open.
The golden authority of Dignity shot out like an immeasurably fast sword as the space above became illuminated!
And there, past the veils of authorities, the figures of tens of thousands of massive Omniversal Pillagers could be seen.
At the forefront were three of the most terrifying ones of all, the first and foremost being a Nine-Headed Winged Omniversal Turtle!
Nine Heads shining with their own multicolored brilliance. A pair of massive wings blazing with poisonous verdant radiance.

Each head swirled with multiple destructive Existential Extremity Authorities and the Influence of multiple Lesser Omniversal Authorities, with the centermost head buzzing with the brilliance of the influence of three Greater Omniversal Authorities, with Kataklysmos being at the very forefront.
The moment that this beast alone was illuminated, the gazes of Martial Empress Yelena and the Elder Queen Mothers of Dignity and Life became somber.
Even the Paracosm Stage Doppelganger of a certain renowned entity became stern!
They knew of this turtle.
It had come and gone in the past eons freely across the Omniverse carrying out a tremendous death toll of Entities and Existential Domains.
The Existential Devouring Turtur.
The Nine Headed Terror!
The Omniversal Pillager of Oblivion.
Why...had it appeared here?
It always stood powerfully at the Paracosm Stage since it first arose under the radar, and who knew how much more ridiculously powerful it was at this time!
But it wasn't alone.

Its blazing aura at the Paracosm Stage was heavy, but it was felt to its left and right as a Tri-Winged Omniversal Serpent floated with mad brilliance could be seen to its right, obsidian scales reflecting its exterior as black lava like substance circled around it!

To the left of the Existential Devouring Turtur, there was a massive Existential Carrion Golem whose body seemed like an amalgamation of humanoid terror, stones that seemed as heavy as planes of existence circling around it as an unfathomable Existential Dominium Body at the Paracosm Stage gloriously made itself apparent.
Three utterly horror inducing Omniversal Pillagers at the Paracosm Stage. Ones that far outstripped others at this Realm!
But behind them, there were hundreds of Teracosm Stage Omniversal Pillagers and thousands at the Teleios Stage moving with interminable splendor.

The eyes of the three Paracosm Stage Omniversal Pillagers gazed down towards the Legions of the Imperium mainly as if they were their only targets, a heavy pressure descending in this whole region as this became readily apparent.
These terrifying Omniversal Pillagers were here for the Imperium forces.
The Legions of the Sanctus Populi saw this and instinctively, they moved back.
The move of the collective consciousness of the eradicated Omniversal Lineage of Lumen was a deadly one.
A fragile alliance was barely forming between two sides that had always been at war.
And just before they could test the waters of moving together against a terrifying Unknown enemy, such a fragile alliance was tested where only one side was targeted by a heavy force!
Would the Sanctus Populi that had its Legions massacred over the years truly move out of their own volition to aid the Imperium Legions?
Would the Imperium Legions sit still when Authorities blazed from the Legions of Sanctus Populi and simply believe they were allies?!
It was a complex and simple move at the same time that cast doubt and began breaking down the beginnings of a fragile alliance before it ever solidified!

ROAAAR! The Existential Devouring Turtur bellowed out as the Greater Omniversal Authority of Kataklysmos vibrated with unfathomable power, beginning to gush down from above like an endless sea as its influence was powered by its Paracosm Soul.
Whatever horrors it was formulating within its Existential Paracosm, within its Inner Existential Paracosm Omniverse Seed...they were all about to experience its full terror.
|Ready!|
The bellow from a stern Martial Empress Yelena boomed at such a time as the Imperium Legions steadied.
But at such a time...
RIIP!

Space fizzled and tore as a rectangular screen of light bloomed at the very center of all of this, flashing very briefly before a hand tore through it and ruptured space, allowing two figures to appear in the next moment!
The rift behind them closed just as quickly as it had appeared as the two figures came under the scrutiny of all. |Sister!|
From the Legions of the Sanctus Populi, the shocked cry from Sanctus Princess Emilliana rang out with incredulity.

It was followed by a simultaneous shout of recognition by a single word from the Imperium Legions- coming from none other than Martial Empress Yelena who recognized the figure of Sona from the weavings she had seen this whole time!
Even more so, she turned towards the man beside her.
Devilish handsomeness.
Golden wings of pure brilliance that dripped with golden flames on his feet and back.
Golden robes that showed him emanating boundless majesty!
Was this Noah Osmont? The one that had decimated Archon Basileus Alderon and Reperiel?
In her wonders and affirmations, the voice of the first representative of the Imperium to arrive here- his Doppelganger at least, rang out in her mind.
|Do you know them? Are they our first intended targets?|
The tone was heavy and domineering as it sought an answer, but before this answer could be given...

|Pull back, Sona!| The roar of the Elder Queen Mother of Dignity boomed towards Sona who had appeared directly in the line of fire, the weavings of heavy Authorities from the Omniversal Pillagers about to arrive before them as the golden flash of Dignity moved out instinctively!
Along with it, the Legions of the Sanctus Populi under her control moved.
On the other side, Martial Empress Yelena grit her teeth as she pointed forward commandingly.
|Advance!|
Part of the Legions of the Sanctus Populi and the Imperium moved simultaneously.
All it took was the appearance of a single man and woman.

Noah's Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of the Protagonist gazed over the terrifying armies around him as the reality of appearing and beginning to alter the very weavings of reality only made his distinction more profound.
But his purpose for appearing here right now was a simple one.
He gazed up.
Towards the terrifying Paracosm Stage Entities he would not be able to kill yet after only undergoing three days of grueling Cultivation.
Especially ones that were this powerful.
The last move made by the remnants of the Existential Omniversal Lineage of Lumen!

He would accept this move gladly and not put it to waste as his goal here was...against all possible challenges- he had to kill a Paracosm Stage Entity and attain its Inner Existential Paracosm Omniverse Seed!

sentences.text: Kataklysmos.
A terrifying Greater Omniversal Authority that destroyed everything in its path.
And one that the top generals of the Eonic Uterra utilized apart from Deorcnysse.
The remnant will of the Existential Omniversal Lineage of Lumen was restricted and weakened after all of these eons, but the last shred of their power was not something to underestimate!
For their dying breath, they triggered unique means to remove the limiters of destruction certain Entities had.
They were already destructive.
They always lived and thrived in destruction.
The weavings of the collective consciousness simply enhanced this destructiveness while directing it in a certain direction!
And so...
BOOM!
Space above fractured as a heavy bombardment of Greater Omniversal Authorities swung down, all of them directed towards the Imperium Legions as the Source of these attacks didn't reveal itself.
|Daring to violate the grace of the Imperium?!
Of the Salvus Domain?!|
The bellow of the Doppelganger of one of the Pillars of the Imperium boomed out coldly as the harrumph of the Elder Queen Mother of Dignity rang out calmly in reply.
|Such a vile Authority does not stem from us and you know it!|
WAA!
The space above splintered open.
The golden authority of Dignity shot out like an immeasurably fast sword as the space above became illuminated!
And there, past the veils of authorities, the figures of tens of thousands of massive Omniversal Pillagers could be seen.
At the forefront were three of the most terrifying ones of all, the first and foremost being a Nine-Headed Winged Omniversal Turtle!
Nine Heads shining with their own multicolored brilliance.
A pair of massive wings blazing with poisonous verdant radiance.

Each head swirled with multiple destructive Existential Extremity Authorities and the Influence of multiple Lesser Omniversal Authorities, with the centermost head buzzing with the brilliance of the influence of three Greater Omniversal Authorities, with Kataklysmos being at the very forefront.
The moment that this beast alone was illuminated, the gazes of Martial Empress Yelena and the Elder Queen Mothers of Dignity and Life became somber.
Even the Paracosm Stage Doppelganger of a certain renowned entity became stern!
They knew of this turtle.
It had come and gone in the past eons freely across the Omniverse carrying out a tremendous death toll of Entities and Existential Domains.
The Existential Devouring Turtur.
The Nine Headed Terror!
The Omniversal Pillager of Oblivion.
Why...had it appeared here?
It always stood powerfully at the Paracosm Stage since it first arose under the radar, and who knew how much more ridiculously powerful it was at this time!
But it wasn't alone.

Its blazing aura at the Paracosm Stage was heavy, but it was felt to its left and right as a Tri-Winged Omniversal Serpent floated with mad brilliance could be seen to its right, obsidian scales reflecting its exterior as black lava like substance circled around it!

To the left of the Existential Devouring Turtur, there was a massive Existential Carrion Golem whose body seemed like an amalgamation of humanoid terror, stones that seemed as heavy as planes of existence circling around it as an unfathomable Existential Dominium Body at the Paracosm Stage gloriously made itself apparent.
Three utterly horror inducing Omniversal Pillagers at the Paracosm Stage.
Ones that far outstripped others at this Realm!
But behind them, there were hundreds of Teracosm Stage Omniversal Pillagers and thousands at the Teleios Stage moving with interminable splendor.

The eyes of the three Paracosm Stage Omniversal Pillagers gazed down towards the Legions of the Imperium mainly as if they were their only targets, a heavy pressure descending in this whole region as this became readily apparent.
These terrifying Omniversal Pillagers were here for the Imperium forces.
The Legions of the Sanctus Populi saw this and instinctively, they moved back.
The move of the collective consciousness of the eradicated Omniversal Lineage of Lumen was a deadly one.
A fragile alliance was barely forming between two sides that had always been at war.
And just before they could test the waters of moving together against a terrifying Unknown enemy, such a fragile alliance was tested where only one side was targeted by a heavy force!
Would the Sanctus Populi that had its Legions massacred over the years truly move out of their own volition to aid the Imperium Legions?
Would the Imperium Legions sit still when Authorities blazed from the Legions of Sanctus Populi and simply believe they were allies?!
It was a complex and simple move at the same time that cast doubt and began breaking down the beginnings of a fragile alliance before it ever solidified!
ROAAAR!

The Existential Devouring Turtur bellowed out as the Greater Omniversal Authority of Kataklysmos vibrated with unfathomable power, beginning to gush down from above like an endless sea as its influence was powered by its Paracosm Soul.
Whatever horrors it was formulating within its Existential Paracosm, within its Inner Existential Paracosm Omniverse Seed...they were all about to experience its full terror.
|Ready!|
The bellow from a stern Martial Empress Yelena boomed at such a time as the Imperium Legions steadied.
But at such a time...
RIIP!

Space fizzled and tore as a rectangular screen of light bloomed at the very center of all of this, flashing very briefly before a hand tore through it and ruptured space, allowing two figures to appear in the next moment!
The rift behind them closed just as quickly as it had appeared as the two figures came under the scrutiny of all. |Sister!|
From the Legions of the Sanctus Populi, the shocked cry from Sanctus Princess Emilliana rang out with incredulity.

It was followed by a simultaneous shout of recognition by a single word from the Imperium Legions- coming from none other than Martial Empress Yelena who recognized the figure of Sona from the weavings she had seen this whole time!
Even more so, she turned towards the man beside her.
Devilish handsomeness.
Golden wings of pure brilliance that dripped with golden flames on his feet and back.
Golden robes that showed him emanating boundless majesty!
Was this Noah Osmont?
The one that had decimated Archon Basileus Alderon and Reperiel?
In her wonders and affirmations, the voice of the first representative of the Imperium to arrive here- his Doppelganger at least, rang out in her mind.
|Do you know them?
Are they our first intended targets?|
The tone was heavy and domineering as it sought an answer, but before this answer could be given...

|Pull back, Sona!| The roar of the Elder Queen Mother of Dignity boomed towards Sona who had appeared directly in the line of fire, the weavings of heavy Authorities from the Omniversal Pillagers about to arrive before them as the golden flash of Dignity moved out instinctively!
Along with it, the Legions of the Sanctus Populi under her control moved.
On the other side, Martial Empress Yelena grit her teeth as she pointed forward commandingly.
|Advance!|
Part of the Legions of the Sanctus Populi and the Imperium moved simultaneously.
All it took was the appearance of a single man and woman.

Noah's Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of the Protagonist gazed over the terrifying armies around him as the reality of appearing and beginning to alter the very weavings of reality only made his distinction more profound.
But his purpose for appearing here right now was a simple one.
He gazed up.
Towards the terrifying Paracosm Stage Entities he would not be able to kill yet after only undergoing three days of grueling Cultivation.
Especially ones that were this powerful.
The last move made by the remnants of the Existential Omniversal Lineage of Lumen!

He would accept this move gladly and not put it to waste as his goal here was...against all possible challenges- he had to kill a Paracosm Stage Entity and attain its Inner Existential Paracosm Omniverse Seed!

chapters.title: Chapter 3104 What is Paracosm? I
paragraphs: Paracosm.
An immeasurably detailed imaginary reality that when paired up with Existential Extremity Authorities...allowed for unfathomable possibilities to bloom outwardly.
Above, the Existential Devouring Turtur gazed down coldly as its Inner Existential Paracosm Omniverse Seed spun with glory.
The weavings of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Kataklysmos took the forefront as it missed the wonders of Deorcnysse that were taken away, but Kataklysmos was even more terrifying!
Its weavings imagined something within its Inner Domain.
And multicolored brilliance shone over its Nine Heads and brilliant wings as its intent echoed out.
|Nine Hells of Kataklysmos.|
WAA!
Within the span of an instant.
Millions of obsidian spiked Pillars radiating penetrative power bloomed, chains weaving across all of them as they blanketed the space above the Imperium Legions like another sky.

The Pillars and chains formed into countless halls and rooms of torment and destruction, their Influence blanketing downwards as they imposed whatever reality the Paracosm Stage Entity above envisioned onto those below!
|The thoughts of an extremely powerful Entity are being imposed on the surrounding Omniverse.|

|The Nine Hells of Kataklysmos have descended as within them and in all close proximity of 1 million light years, enemy targets face a constant barrage of 10,000 Existential Extremity Authorities stemming from Kataklysmos.|

|This reality is deemed to norm as if any target resists this, they will be further focused on as the barrage of 100,000 Existential Extremity Authorities stemming from Kataklysmos will descend unto them.|
|Any targets not blessed by the Mark of Kataklysmos will not be able to move or circulate 99% of their Authority.|

|Those designated as part of the Imperium Legions will be assaulted by constant Chains of Kataklysmos, their very Dominiums set to be skewered and burned for at least a full second before they can be granted death.|
|The Probability of retaliating against the weavings of the Nine Hells of Kataklysmos is reduced by 70%.|
|If any other weaving tries to impose itself against the Nine Hells of Kataklysmos, the cost of doing so is increased 10 times more than normal.|

|If the targets within the Nine Hells of Kataklysmos reach less than 30% of their overall Existential Vitality, Causality will be twisted as they will instantly have their Dominiums claimed to fuel further propagation of the Nine Hells of Kataklysmos.|
Noah interpreted most of what imaginary reality this Entity at the Paracosm Stage thought of...and then proceeded to make it into a true reality all around them!
This was the weaving of the Existential Devouring Turtur. What its Inner Existential Paracosm Omniverse Seed laid out, and its effects.
Trying to negate it...another Paracosm with an equal or much greater weight was required!
Or, some other unique exceptions and oddities could possibly counter such terrifying capabilities.
The question was...would such oddities so easily come to fruition?
|YAA!|

Like a golden flash of light, the Elder Queen Mother of Dignity was the first to appear beside Sona, glancing at this young girl who held two icy gold swords in her hands while pointing them towards the weavings of a Paracosm Stage Entity as if she could actually stand against it.
She had seen her grow up as she watched her since the day she almost took the Source of Dignity from her, and she would never sit back while her Existence was ground to nothing!
Multicolored brilliance flourished.
She was also a Paracosm Stage expert as she could impose her own rulings to affect the surrounding omniverse.
|Unbreakable Dignity.|
HUUM!
Unbreakable.

Her dream was a unique one. Her vision and Paracosm was one filled with resplendence as with her at the center and covering Sona and Noah, a blooming of golden lotuses covered every gaze as they came with their own ideas of the surrounding Omniverse!
|Any authority designated as antagonistic cannot pass through the Lotuses of Dignity in the surroundings.|

|Any authority designated as antagonistic will be measured on a scale of Dignity. If its Dignity is deemed less, this authority will be devoured to empower the proliferation of even more Lotuses of Dignity.|

|Any authority stemming from one designated as an ally will gain the support of a Lotus of Dignity below them, granting them the influence of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Praestigiae with every attack they unleash.|
|Any Authority...|
These prompts rose before Noah's eyes as another Entity threw out their own idealized form of what the Omniverse around them would be!
The figure of Martial Empress Yelena was right behind the Elder Queen Mother of Dignity with her Legion as she raised a dazzling transparent Codex of Extremity in her hands.
Its pages unfurled with brilliance as her unblemished voice bloomed.
|Bastion of Monarkhos!|

A golden light of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Monarkhos shot out from below and flowed across the Codex of Extremity in her hands, her own Paracosm Stage powering up this light as it was covered with dense regality!
Monarkhos.
A terrifying Greater Omniversal Authority that closely related to royalty.
To those with regality and Majesty!
Under the banner of the Martial Empress Yelena...
|All those designated as Royalty will be granted the protection of 100,000 Existential Extremity Authorities within the weavings of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Monarkhos.|
|Any authority inventing to stand against Royalty will face the constant barrage of 10,000 Existential Extremity Authorities within the weavings of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Monarkhos...|
Utter brilliance unfurled all around.

Noah...observed all of these alterations of the surrounding Omniverse itself due to the Paracosms of others- due to the imaginations of others. And his Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of the Protagonist calmly placed his hands behind his back as he weaved out a single authority.
|The Ascendant Existential Extremity of the Protagonist is being put to the test.|
Golden flames of brilliance raged around him as his Invictus Dominium Wings flashed.
|A distinction of the Protagonist has been actualized and brought forward to be tested.|
|A Protagonist always overcomes and breaks through the obstacles on his path, either undergoing a false death and undergoing a rebirth, or simply becoming stronger during the challenge.|
|The Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority of the Protagonist puts this distinction to the test against the weavings of a Paracosm Stage Existential Dominium Realm Enemy!|

chapters.title: Chapter 3105 What is Paracosm? II
paragraphs: The Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of the Protagonist was putting himself to the test.
What his concept truly stood for.
Whenever a Protagonist of a Fable was knocked down, they somehow always stood up.

The very will of reality seemed to be aligned with them and their being as they would never perish, with this meaning the end of the Story- they would at most undergo a false death and come back stronger than ever.
There were even those who made breakthroughs during battle and grew strong enough to overcome it, or other tools that made up the Protagonist came into play!
Other tools.

When it came to this, the eyes of Noah's Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of the Protagonist became sharp as it shot out from its position and towards the engulfing obsidian crimson Nine Hells of Kataklysmos!
|The Protagonist is pulling on the tools under its banner to unleash its true brilliance- the tools that were expanded by it and should be under its control.|
A defiant weaving boomed out that caused many of Noah's extremes to buzz.
Didn't that mean...
|The Protagonist calls upon Plot.|
|The Protagonist calls upon Ascension!|
|The Protagonist calls upon Cheats!|
HUUUM!
The concepts it enacted and brought towards Extremity. It actually called upon some of them right now to be under its Banner even though it knew some were far too independent!
|The weavings of Plot flow smoothly across the Protagonist.|
|After a slight hesitation, The weavings of Ascension flow smoothly across the Protagonist!|
Two of the three that were called upon let their weavings flow freely.
But the last one was a particularly independent one. One with its own distinct personality!
Would it truly allow itself to come under the banner and control of the Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority of the Protagonist?
|Cheats smiles at the need for control of the Protagonist.|
WAA!
|Cheats freely allows its weavings to flow across the Protagonist.|
An unexpected reaction bloomed as the expected defiance from Cheats didn't show.
Instead, this weaving allowed its authority to flow across the Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of the Protagonist as in the next moment...
|The Ascendant Existential Protagonist Aura has awoken.|
HUUM!
His wings flared.
Around his body, multicolored brilliance unfurled with indomitable scrutiny as...
DUM DUM DUM! DUM-DUM-DUM-DUM!
A heavy beat began.
A beat as if the main character had arrived and things were about to get serious!
It was followed by a heavy symphony of drums and guitars that caused the weavings of Existential Extremity Authorities and Lesser Omniversal Authorities to vibrate with instability!
Wills began to buzz to localize exactly where this symphony was coming from.
At such a time, the three way power clash between the Existential Devouring Turtur, the Elder Queen Mother of Dignity, and Martial Empress Yelena occurred!
BOOOM!
It was as if multiple Realities were trying to overlap with each other.

The Nine Hells of Kataklysmos were vast and unquenching as they covered an extremely wide area, smashing into both the Unbreakable Dignity and Bastion of Monarkhos at the same time as...its obsidian crimson Pillars and chains crushed the Lotuses of Dignity and the crowns and thrones of royalty rising from Martial Empress Yelena!
When the thoughts of multiple Paracosm Stage Entities clashed and sought to establish Dominium, the stronger one would express its effects while weakening all others.
At this time, it was made clear what was weak and what was strong.
CRACK!
The Pillars and chains of the Nine Hells of Kataklysmos were intricately connected together as the weight of one seemingly carried the weight of all others!
It crushed apart many of the rising lotuses and thrones of regality trying to put its descent as it continued!
And to make matters worse...
|Serpentine Apocalypto.|
The Tri-Winged Omniversal Serpent beside the Existential Devouring Turtur spoke out as obsidian brilliance exploded out.
|Stygian Carrion Swamp.|
The Existential Carrion Golem also beside the Existential Devouring Turtur erupted with its own weavings of the Paracosm Stage!
Yes.
The Turtur wasn't alone.

Even as they barely gained a brief instant of respite, two more omniverse altering attacks descended as the gazes of Martial Empress Yelena and the Elder Queen Mother of Dignity was somber, their figures burning with even more authority to rebuff the oncoming undeniable Authorities!
|Sona!| The Queen Mother bellowed out as she saw the chains and Pillars of the Nine Hells of Kataklysmos were directly above Sona and Noah.
She was powerful, yes, but she could stand against a Paracosm Stage Enti-
Her pupils dilated.
She saw the man beside her fly out as his hand reached to the unfathomably powerful chains crashing down, and in the next moment...
BZZT!
The unstoppable chains that even crushed countless Lotuses of Dignity...buzzed and deviated from their original descent.
Around the visage of Noah and Sona right below him, obsidian flames instantly surged as they seemed to resonate with the descending Nine Hells of Kataklysmos!
As for why?
|The Ascendant Existential Protagonist Aura has triggered a complex weaving of Plot to ensure your livelihood.|
|Your Distinctions seem to be in line with it as instantly, you have gained the recognition of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Kataklysmos.|
|The Recognition just so happened to change your distinction as a target of the Nine Hells of Kataklysmos.|
A maddening reality bloomed.
A reality where an Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority began to express itself truly!
|Your Fable is not one that can be extinguished so easily.|
|Plot Armor begins to burn around you and seek for any solutions to help you achieve what you want in your Fable.|
|Cheats burns with brilliance and sees a possibility from the countless weavings of the Existential Omniversal Lineage of Lumen recently obtained.|
|Cheats triggers an Existential Deus Ex Machina, calling upon the weavings of the last standing guardian of Lumen-Piety.|
Things began to turn up a whole octave.

Above Noah's Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of the Protagonist, the Nine Hells of Kataklysmos were torn apart as a crimson rift with blazing crimson radiance instantly tore this region of the Omniverse open!

Even as they barely gained a brief instant of respite, two more omniverse altering attacks descended as the gazes of Martial Empress Yelena and the Elder Queen Mother of Dignity was somber, their figures burning with even more authority to rebuff the oncoming undeniable Authorities!
|Sona!| The Queen Mother bellowed out as she saw the chains and Pillars of the Nine Hells of Kataklysmos were directly above Sona and Noah.
She was powerful, yes, but she could stand against a Paracosm Stage Enti-
Her pupils dilated.
She saw the man beside her fly out as his hand reached to the unfathomably powerful chains crashing down, and in the next moment...
BZZT!
The unstoppable chains that even crushed countless Lotuses of Dignity...buzzed and deviated from their original descent.
Around the visage of Noah and Sona right below him, obsidian flames instantly surged as they seemed to resonate with the descending Nine Hells of Kataklysmos!
As for why?
|The Ascendant Existential Protagonist Aura has triggered a complex weaving of Plot to ensure your livelihood.|
|Your Distinctions seem to be in line with it as instantly, you have gained the recognition of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Kataklysmos.|
|The Recognition just so happened to change your distinction as a target of the Nine Hells of Kataklysmos.|
A maddening reality bloomed.
A reality where an Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority began to express itself truly!
|Your Fable is not one that can be extinguished so easily.|
|Plot Armor begins to burn around you and seek for any solutions to help you achieve what you want in your Fable.|
|Cheats burns with brilliance and sees a possibility from the countless weavings of the Existential Omniversal Lineage of Lumen recently obtained.|
|Cheats triggers an Existential Deus Ex Machina, calling upon the weavings of the last standing guardian of Lumen-Piety.|
Things began to turn up a whole octave.

Above Noah's Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of the Protagonist, the Nine Hells of Kataklysmos were torn apart as a crimson rift with blazing crimson radiance instantly tore this region of the Omniverse open!

chapters.title: Chapter 3106 The Indomitable Protagonist! I
paragraphs: Battles of the Entities at the Paracosm Stage were high-paced as they analyzed and reacted to all changes rapidly.
Some changes were within their expectations and grasp as they altered their attacks a little, while other changes didn't even deserve any alterations.
Then, there was what occurred at this moment.

As all three Paracosm Stage Omniversal Pillagers fully delved into battle with the Elder Queen Mother of Dignity and Martial Empress Yelena retaliating, and the Elder Queen Mother of Life appearing at this moment as with her as the center, an illusory verdant tree that covered all the Legions of Sanctus Populi bloomed.
Green and sparkling with stellar seas of life.
Its Paracosm was a simple one.
The Tree of Life.
|Under the shade of the Tree of Life, you cannot die.|
A single Paracosm.
A single ideal turned into reality!

It was unfathomably powerful as this single truth covered all those from the Sanctus Populi, including Noah- and this was the exact time that the weavings of the Protagonist spearheaded by Noah did trigger something even he didn't know the full result of!
An Existential Deus Ex Machina that was geared towards helping him achieve his aims.
|The Last Guardian of Lumen, Piety, is being reconstructed based on the weavings of its past Existence.|
HUUM!
From the massive crimson flaming right radiating stupendous light.
Hands bathed in crimson gold light and flames stretched this rift open ever further as in a blink...
SHAA!
These hands pulled and squeezed out a massive Entity!
The rift, as if it never should have been opened, closed up extremely quickly as an Entity bathed in crimson gold flames appeared in the center of the Nine Hells of Kataklysmos.
An expanse of wings of light behind it. A burly humanoid body that suddenly manifested a long crimson spear and a golden shield that at its very center...had the branding of an eye.
An eye whose pupil held within it the scripture of |LUMEN|!
Light.
A record of an Entity eons past was brought out to fruition due to the weavings of the Protagonist.
|Under the effects of the Protagonist, the Existential Extremity Authority of Summoning has come to fruition.|
|An Unbreakable Existential Bond has formed between you and the temporarily summoned Last Guardian of Lumen- Piety.|
|The directive of the Piety is a clear one.|
HUUM!
Crimson gold flames unfolded.
The visage of the Entity named Piety was fully armored in a white gold Armament, its face entirely covered with a helm made of pure light as even its eyes couldn't be seen.
But uniquely...one couldn't sense the familiar aura of Existential Dominium on it.
|With your current Realm, the summoned record of Piety is closely equivalent to an entry-level Paracosm Stage Entity.|
Equivalent.
But the words didn't say it stood at the Paracosm Stage of the Existential Dominium Realm.
What did this mean?
ZZING!
The spear of Piety let out a dazzling noise as it began to move, its sharp point slashing and weaving all around it at an immeasurably fast pace that didn't fit its body!
And in the next instant...
PAH!
Like glass shattering, the intricate weavings of the Pillars and chains of the Nine Hells of Kataklysmos were torn and burnt in pure light.
A light that once it faded, only the brilliance of the armored Last Guardian of Lumen- Piety, remained!
Its spear didn't move with any influence of Greater Omniversal Authorities.
There wasn't an overabundance of thousands or tens of thousands of Existential Extremity Authorities around him!
There was only...
Light.
Lumen!
|The Realms of the Existential Omniversal Lineage of Lumen were starkly different in their progression as they contained everything within their Lineage- Lumen.|
|All possible weavings they grasped were fully weaved into Lumen. All complexities of weavings of tens or thousands of Existential Extremity Authorities were all contained within Lumen.|
|When a true Champion of Lumen moved, pure light scattered, and the unfathomable brilliance of Lumen spread.|
Their Realms of power were all based on light.
|The Last Guardian of Lumen- Piety, stood powerfully at the Omnivo-8 Existential Realm of Lumen before he fell.|
BOOM!
Its presence was made clear.

The Protagonist had brought it forth with Deus Ex Machina as its first action was to destroy the terrifying Nine Hells of Kataklysmos, its massive illusory figure disappearing soon after as it instantly arrived before the Nine Heads of the Existential Devouring Turtur!

It seemed like absolutely pure light was cascading across the battlefield as the spear of Piety swung down, the right most head of the Existential Devouring Turtur moving back speedily as it roared in rage.
And even then, obsidian blood gushed out as nearly half of the head of the Existential Devouring Turtur was severed.

The light contained within the speedy moving spear seemed to break and deteriorate the weavings of tens of thousands of Existential Extremity Authorities protecting the Existential Devouring Turtur constantly, its brilliance continuing even as millions of obsidian chains bloomed in front of it!

It was so astounding that an instant later, the massive shield in the left hand of Piety glowed- a binding light released from it that flowed rapidly to shine on the whole figure of the Existential Devouring Turtur- all of its countless layers of protection becoming erased by this flash of light as...
SAAA!
A sharp and concise spear swung down.
And Five of the Nine Heads of the massive Terror of an Omniversal Pillager gushed with blood as they were cleaved cleanly off!
WAA!
It was a shocking scene.
One that threw the battle off its rhythm as if this continued...
|The duration of the summoning of the Last Guardian of Lumen- Piety, is coming to an end.|
A great power like this could not be brought out and kept out so easily.
Or so it should be this way.
But at such a moment, Noah's figure watching all of this from below brightened as...
|Lumen!|
A sharp shout of disbelief rang out across the battlefield from a certain Doppelganger.
From a Representative of the Imperium.
And the moment this shout rang out...the massive illusory figure of Piety that had stopped began to buzz.
|The record of Piety senses something deeply ingrained within its existence- a trace of a signature of a Lineage from eons past.|
HUUM!
|An Existential Obsession is being born within Piety.|
|The weavings of the Last Guardian of Lumen-Piety, should have burned brightly for a single second before disappearing.|

|The Fortune and Luck of the Protagonist were triggered as Piety sensed the trace Lineage of the ones that burnt the lands of Lumen eons ago, its cognition further awakening as it begins to pull on the surrounding authority to anchor itself onto the present weavings!|

chapters.title: Chapter 3107 The Indomitable Protagonist! II
paragraphs: All the tools of the Protagonist were fully at work!

Sudden bursts of fortune, luck, plot armor, Deus Ex Machina...everything was erupting all at once around the Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of the Protagonist as it all applied a corrective effect to ensure the future he was looking for occurred.
As of right now, even the Causality of Death could not be utilized as everything was still up in the air!
Probability had not yet entirely twisted towards his favor.
But if the tools of the Protagonist continued to unfold as the terrifying reality of the Last Guardian of Lumen was currently unfolding...
BOOOM!
The illusory figure of the Last Guardian of Lumen burned with a white gold light as its haziness...began to gain a hint of solidity.
|The Existential Obsession born within Piety seeks any possibilities to fully anchor itself onto the current weavings of reality.|
HUUM!
The figure of Piety buzzed.
It wanted an anchor.
Something to keep it here!
So its existence filled with brilliance once more turned to Lumen.
But...this light was bright, but it was of eons past.
It existed back then, and not now. Piety could not see a way to use Lumen as an anchor even as the idea that even in this current weaving of reality, there was always light!
The Lumen with it was already dispersing and falling back into its records.
It needed a jump start to first remain here. It needed a true anchor.
So in its last moments, Piety searched.
Piety traced.
It traced back the only Source that was bound to it- the one it currently listened to the commands of.
In the span of an instant, Noah felt blazing eyes of light stare at his existence as he stared back calmly.
|The Last Guardian of Lumen pleads to your Existence and asks if there is anything capable of being utilized as an Existential Omniversal Anchor.|
WAA!
It was a long shot.
As wondrous as it was that Piety was brought here, it could see the entity controlling the last weavings of its source had not even formed his Paracosm.
How could he have anything that could possibly act as an Existential Omniversal Anchor?
OOM!
Piety could feel a somber sigh of regret at not even being able to embark on its obsession as it felt its existence slipping away once more.
But not before...
|The Protagonist reaches out to the weavings of Piety.|
|The Protagonist provides a possible Existential Omniversal Anchor for the Last Guardian of Lumen.|
What?
Was it actually possible?
Even with doubts swirling in its mind, Piety reached out and accepted this possible anchor.
Of course, it didn't come without a cost.
|Piety crosses the irreversible bridge of existence and the absolute bindings of the Protagonist.|
Piety traversed a far distance and became even further bound unto Noah's existence. And at the end of it all...
|The Weavings of Piety are being connected to an immeasurably vast resource as an Anchor to its Existence.|
|The Weavings of Piety are being bound to the Mana of the Protagonist.|
HUUM!
An utterly gorgeous cerulean hue flashed within the white-gold luminescence of Piety.
Piety didn't even get a chance to doubt and question why Mana- a single aspect of one's existence...could possibly be used as an Anchor.
Because the moment it was connected...
BOOM!
Its illusory brilliance instantly became solid.
That was how potent the Anchor it had become bound to was!
|An Unfathomable Action!|
|Something that cannot easily be done even with the complex weavings of Greater Omniversal Authorities!|
|The Weavings of an Existence entirely lost and eradicated across all records have been brought back through a trace of memories from a remnant collective consciousness.|
|The Entity that is the Last Guardian of Lumen, Piety, has jumped across eons of history and eradication itself to appear in the currently unfolding reality.|
|The Existential Extremity Authority of Summoning has attained the Ascendant Distinction.|
|The First Ascendant Existential Summon- Piety, has come to fruition!|
|Immeasurably stable Omniversal Authorities exceeding the Greater Distinctions gaze at your actions.|
An array of results.
This was how powerful and ridiculous an action Noah had taken was.
This was how indomitable the Protagonist was as he caused such a nonsensical thing to happen at this moment!
And the first, but indubitably not the last product...was the Last Guardian of Lumen- -Piety.
The First Ascendant Existential Summon- Piety!

His massive armored body solidified as his spear and shield became white gold pure light, a hint of blue leaking from it as it bodaciously turned its back on the roaring Turtur who had multiple heads cut off.

It turned and gazed down towards the Legions of the Imperium- more so towards the Doppelganger of a shocking personage as from him, Piety could even more closely sense threads of the Lineage that burnt everything it knew! And...
OOOH!
The spear of light wielded by Piety began to buzz as if calling for Blood, but at such a time, Noah's voice echoed out.
|Not yet. Not now.|
A voice that buzzed within Piety's very core.
A voice that Piery didn't question, believing it at this moment as it staved off its Existential Obsession!
Momentarily.
For now!
Because what the Owner of the Existential Omniversal Anchor was commanding it to currently do...was to achieve his dream for today.
WU! WU! WU!
The spear of Light in the hands of Piety buzzed and stabbed upwards trillions of times in an instant.
And right after, the dark space of the Omniverse became lit up with trillions of white suns of light- Light so blinding as if announcing the resurgence of something heavy!
Of something that should have never been lost!
ROAAAR!

The beheaded visage of the Turtur bellowed out as its five heads reattached themselves with waves of obsidian darkness, its Paracosm raging angrily as the Tri-Winged Omniversal Serpent and Carrion Golem beside it all turned their focus on Piety.
What this Entity expressed was sheer power!
What Piety stood for on this battlefield...was something else entirely.
When the word Lumen was uttered, the vast majority of the Imperium Legions froze in shock.
The Sanctus Populi didn't show any less shock!
This was how terrifying a Lineage that Lumen was.
With the power of the Last Guardian of Lumen being expressed just now, one had to question how a lineage that had Entities like this fell!
All extremes they knew were weaved into their Lineage.
They never expressed anything but Lumen as this alone allowed them to dominate for eons.
So how did the Imperium topple them?
The answer lay in their weavings.
And the answer was a particularly deadly one.
Noah knew this.
Piety knew this.
After all, it was the base of its obsession.
So its massive armored body pulsed as its spear pointed towards the Omniversal Pillager Legions spearheaded by the Existential Devouring Turtur, its voice echoing out.
|As the Master wishes.|
The Master? What Master?!
Such questions only barely arose as right after...
Trillions of white gold suns of pure light cascaded down like drops of rain!

chapters.title: Chapter 3108 The Indomitable Protagonist! III
paragraphs: An advent of something that threw off the balance of the whole battlefield!
On the shield of a certain newly appearing Entity, the ecriture of |LUMEN| shone brightly as such an Entity had voiced out the word Master.
Just what could be the Master of a combatant of a Lineage lost throughout history?
WAA!
There was no answer.
Only the descent of trillions of white gold suns that made it seem like in this region of the Omniverse, there was a white gold downpour of stellar rain.
ROAAR!

The Paracosm Stage Omniversal Pillagers bellowed out as at the forefront, The Existential Devouring Turtur fully annealing its heads as obsidian serpentine tendrils of Kataklysmos began to cover everything around it!
The two Paracosm Stage Omniversal Pillagers beside it seemed to resonate with it and layer on their power, feeling the threat of this newly appearing creature as they had to eradicate it first.
These thoughts were buzzing within their minds, but there was another group that was shockingly forced to have similar thoughts simply based on their designations.
The Imperium Legions and the Commanders at their forefront felt a sense of somberness and trepidation at the distinction of Lumen.
A Lineage they had decimated far too long ago and cleansed everything about it!

The face of Martial Empress Yelena was ashen as she looked above at the visage of Piety, the figure of the Representative Pillar Doppelganger appearing beside her with immeasurably cold eyes as his voice seemed to echo out with a sense of unwillingness.
|Secure the perimeter across a billion light years around us. Others are coming. Even a glimpse of Lumen had to be investigated and contained...even at the cost of many lives.|
The words were cold as Martial Empress Yelena could not help but feel a sense of rising dread.
Her intent was whispered out in the lowest possible tone as she replied.
|But...the cessation of weavings, the Unknown Devouring Worms we've just uncovered the identity of-|

|The cessation of weavings won't matter if any trace of Lumen is before us, there will be cessation with their very return that will be even more painful! Follow every fucking order without question at this moment as we are in an extremely precarious position. None of you from the current generation know the terror of Lumen...and you do not want to know it!|
HUUM!
The words were inviolable ones as Yelena grit her teeth while waving her hands- sending out commands for the Imperium Legions to spread out and cover this whole perimeter!
The somber voice of the man beside her continued in the midst of such a development.
|Our main purpose right now is support and observation until the major force of the Imperium arrives. And...the identity of the one this Peon of Lumen called Master!|
It was a rapidly deteriorating situation, and they had to move fast!
As for the Master of the Last Guardian of Lumen they were all looking for...
|Causality has still not tipped in the favor of the Protagonist.|
He was reading an increasing number of prompts as the Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of the Protagonist continued to seek a profound expression of its power.
|Under the banner of the main character, there is always strength in numbers where they do not have to do everything themselves.|

|But unlike the Last Guardian of Lumen, all other Records are too scattered to be brought back as they are.|
|Supplemental Weavings of Existence are required to bring forth any other records of Lumen.|
His pure gold flaming wings radiated even more splendorous flames even as beside Sona, the figure of the Elder Queen Mother of Dignity appeared protectively and began talking with her.

Bot Noah's focus was fully on the weavings of the Protagonist and the other Ascendant Existential Extremity Authorities currently flowing through it, the Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority of Summoning blaring forth at this moment!
|The counterparts to complete the scattered weavings of Lumen have been ascertained.|
WUU!
The moment this prompt arrived.
It was as if the weavings of the Protagonist had gotten a pass to do whatever they wanted.
|Deus Ex Machina has been triggered once more.|
|The Records of the Commander of the 77th Battalion of Lumen are being brought across the weavings of existence itself.|
|They pulse with instability as unless something supports and completes their scattered weavings, their weavings will dissipate!|

And the Ascendant Existential Extremity Authority of Summoning moved.
|The Summon, Blue Slime, has been brought forth to complete the Commander of the 77th Battalion of Lumen and act as part of the Anchor of its existence.|
Brilliance flourished.

And soon after, the visage of a bouncing blue slime pulsing with excitement appeared, looking around with sparkling eyes as an instant later, a rift opened above it as white gold light boomed out and landed on the Blue Slime!
Within this light, the figure of a winged humanoid creature could barely be seen before its form sublimated into the Blue Slime.
|The Commander of the 77th Battalion of Lumen has successfully been stabilized by the Existence of the Blue Slime.|
|To maintain its weavings, an Unbreakable Bond has been formed with the Protagonist as Mana is utilized as its Existential Omniversal Anchor!|
The form congealed and became clear.
Simmering with radiance, the eyes of the Blue Slime protruded behind a circular white gold Armament that blazed with an aurora of white gold wings behind it.
Its eyes held the same playfulness, but one could distinctly feel an ancient will rising behind them and gazing around at everything!
|Standing at Omnivo-7 Existential Realm of Lumen, The Blue Slime of Lumen- Bubbles, has been successfully retrieved from eons of lost records.|
|The Second Ascendant Existential Summon- Bubbles, has come to fruition!|

chapters.title: Chapter 3109 The Indomitable Protagonist! IV
paragraphs: A second blinding white gold light of Lumen erupted after the Last Guardian of Lumen, this one looking like a ball of light with wings!
Its aura wasn't as sharp as it stood at Omnivo-7 Existential Realm of Lumen, compared to the Omnivo-8 Existential Realm of Lumen of Piety.
But its appearance was grand and grave one at the same time.
The expression on Martial Empress Yelena became ashen while the Representative beside her had his fists trembling, his expression immeasurably somber at this moment!
A single Entity of Lumen was a problem.
Two was a catastrophe!
It wasn't in terms of power.
It was all in terms of what it represented!
A second Entity of Lumen meant they were inexplicably experiencing the resurgence of this Existential Omniversal!
|Haa!|
Their thoughts only heard the yell of the second Entity of Lumen as if it were a thunderclap.
An instant later, the white gold wings of the Blue Slime of Lumen- Bubbles, flashed and it disappeared.
It only reappeared opposite the three Paracosm Stage Omniversal Pillagers currently facing Piety and a rain of white gold suns as their own weavings of Realities were constantly born and destroyed.

Bubbles appeared on top and began to bounce on the armored head of Piety, the front of its round armor opening to show a small mouth that began to act akin to an endlessly devouring singularity at this moment!

The complex weaving of Kataklysmos and any other Omniversal Authorities emanating from the Omniversal Pillagers began to be sucked towards the small mouth of Bubbles uncontrollably as the battlefield was further disrupted.
But goodness...this was just the beginning.
|Causality has still not tipped in the favor of the Protagonist.|
|Deus Ex Machina has been triggered once more.|
|Deus Ex Machina has been triggered once more.|
|Deus Ex Machina has been triggered...|
The weavings of the Protagonist went utterly wild in order to achieve their aim!
One record after another was pulled up.
And an equivalent Summon to anchor them onto the weavings of existence was prepared!
|The Records of the Commander of the 69th Battalion of Lumen are being brought across the weavings of existence itself.|
|The Records of the Commander of the 55th Battalion of Lumen are being brought across the weavings of existence itself.|
|The Records of the Commander of the 48th Battalion of Lumen...|
One Record after another that held some form of preservation and wasn't entirely eradicated by the Imperium was pulled out.
All of it taken out for the usage of the Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of the Protagonist!
|All excavated records pulse with instability as unless something supports and completes their scattered weavings, their weavings will dissipate.|
|The Summon, Black Panther, has been brought forth to complete the Commander of the 69th Battalion of Lumen and act as part of the Anchor of its existence.|
|The Summon, Jormungandr, has been brought forth to complete the Commander of the 55th Battalion of Lumen and act as part of the Anchor of its existence.|

|The Summon, Tiamat, has been brought forth to complete the Commander of the 48th Battalion of Lumen...| |To maintain their weavings, an Unbreakable Bond has been formed with the Protagonist as Mana is utilized as its Existential Omniversal Anchor!|
Three blinding points of brilliance appeared nearly simultaneously.

Their white gold brilliance became overlaid by a dazzling obsidian panther, a massive multicolored Serpent, and the glorious visage of a Nine Headed Dragon whose Dignity as the Progenitor of Dragons was unmatched!
From just these three...a transformation bloomed as their bodies soon burned with the white gold brilliance of Lumen.
|Standing at Omnivo-7 Existential Realm of Lumen, The Panthera Wulfaz of Lumen- Fenrir, has been successfully retrieved from eons of lost records.|

|Standing at Omnivo-7 Existential Realm of Lumen, The Serpentem of Lumen- Nagarius, has been successfully retrieved from eons of lost records.| |Standing at Omnivo-7 Existential Realm of Lumen, The Omniverse Drakon- Tiamatherion, has been successfully retrieved from eons of lost records.| ...!
The Third, Fourth, and Fifth Ascendant Existential Summons came to be under the eyes of all.
Fenris geld lustrous white gold fur filled with obsidian stripes, a crown of pure white gold light rotating above its head as its eyes radiated a pure gold light.
Light.
Such a thing crackled around its body maddeningly with immeasurable velocity as its gold eyes shone brightly before they came to focus on the distant Legions of Omniversal Pillagers.
And then...only its Intent could be heard as it already disappeared, its massive figure not even being visible to the naked eye!
|I...am...SPEED!|
BOOOM!
The only thing barely discerned was a flash of white gold light already above the Paracosm Stage Omniversal Pillagers even before this intent spread out.
Nagarius looked like a massive white gold Winged Omniversal Serpent, its jaws opening wide at this moment as perilous seas of white gold light raged out of it.
Meanwhile, Omniverse Drakon, Tiamatherion...burned with glorious brilliance as its Nine Heads stared coldly at the Existential Devouring Turtur.

It seemed that it was about to make a move as well- one that intended to utterly finish the Existential Devouring Turtur with the concentrated force of all newly appearing Ascendant Existential Summons!
The Paracosm Carrion Golem and Tri-Winged Omniversal Serpent saw this as a vast amount of their Authority gathered protectively around the Nine Headed Turtle.
The Existential Devouring Turtur could not die!
And just as a shocking reality bloomed...
|Speed...|
A single intent bloomed out again as wondrously, the visage of Fenrir materialized behind the Tri-Winged Omniversal Serpent.
At the same instant, Piety, Bubbles, Nagarius, and Tiamatherion suddenly appeared around this Paracosm Stage Omniversal Pillager whose vast authority was cascading towards the Turtur to aid it!
Its weavings.
Its power.

The vast majority of it was going towards the support of its strongest ally who was carrying the weight of attacks of all of these newly appearing beings who didn't even have the influence of Omniversal Authorities around them.
And yet...
And yet...!
Its eyes opened wide with dread as the true target of the Ascendant Existential Summons was actually much different than what many had believed!
