chapters.title: Chapter 3120 Black and White I
paragraphs: The entirely different system of power portrayed by the weavings of their Entities.
The fact that they somehow took everything under the banner of Lumen and nothing else!
It was not the flow of power those in this Omniverse followed!

|The Imperium Autarch found out about this from the Lumen Emperor. About an enemy he could not run away from that would eventually find him. So to rectify this...The Imperium Autarch carried out a cleansing to wipe out Lumen entirely and make sure not even a trace of it survived. To ensure the safety of this Omniverse. But ultimately...he seems to have failed.|
Yes!
These were the Records Noah was actively unveiling as his Lineage coursed with greater and greater volumes of Lumen!
The knowledge that the remaining shreds of the Lumen Emperor did not share with him.
The shame this Entity wanted to bury!
The Sanctus Empress listened to Noah's words as her eyes trembled further, disbelief apparent within them as she thought about her War with the Imperium!
|This...all this...!|
A complex mixture of emotions buzzed in her mind.
Noah looked at her calmly as he continued.
|Even such a truth doesn't make the complete genocide carried out by the Imperium okay. It was a solution- one of the worst ones, but not the only solution.|
|Then...|
His words caused the figure of the Sanctus Empress whose main body was being chased by Devouring Worms at this very moment to appear directly in front of him.
|...Do you have a solution?|
Did Noah have a solution?
Looking at the eyes filled with light and hope, he didn't lie as he shrugged his shoulders!
|Maybe. I'm not too sure yet as I am discovering all of this in real time.|
The Lumen Emperor.
The Imperium Autarch!
Why the Imperium was so afraid of Lumen resurfacing.
This fear was ingrained in them from records of history and caution from the Imperium Autarch!
But it was all for naught.
Even before Noah began to unearth the weavings of Lumen, the Devouring Worms had appeared.
Whether it was due to the actions of the Remnant Collective Consciousness.
Or the terrifying capabilities of these Devouring Worms.
Or by another stroke of weavings entirely.
They had located this place and arrived, and now...the terror the Lumen Emperor was afraid of ran rampant!
All of this was cause for introspection as it showed not everything was black and white.
There was never just good and evil!
At the end of the day, all things were made up by a series of choices.
The Lumen Emperor made a choice.
The Imperium Autarch made a choice.
The Sanctus Populi made a choice.
And now, Noah would also make a choice!
His gaze was firm as he looked at the manifestation of the Sanctus Empress.
|You are being chased by these Devouring Worms this whole time with no direction...how about you give them a direction?|
The buzzing eyes of the Sanctus Empress steeled and calmed.
After all, she was an Entity that had somehow managed to take her Dominium past Paracosm.
To have her Existence shine with a colorless brilliance!
What had happened in the past and what was happening now were all reconciled as her eyes became filled with determination as she asked.
|What direction? These things will devour everything they touch as no authorities are effective against them.|
Her words showed a grim coming future.
If all they had were Existential Extremity Authorities and Omniversal Authorities, and none of them were effective against their enemies- only a bloodbath would come!
Noah knew this very well as his voice echoed out calmly.
|The source began with Lumen, the solution may lie there as well. Come towards the location of the current battlefield. Let me experience these Devouring Worms first hand.|
Noah calculated many things and came to a decision.
The Sanctus Empress stared at him after such crazy words as her voice came out calmly.
|My people are there with you. Without a solution, you would delegate them to certain death.|
Her biggest worry and purpose.
The people.
Her people!
Yet towards such a worry...Noah spoke with immeasurable conviction.
|Not a single Dragon Knight or Sanctus Princess or Elder Queen will be lost under my watch- you have my promise.|
WAA!
A promise.
But what was a promise from someone like Noah to someone like the Sanctus Empress when both sides had just met each other?
The weavings of the Populi shone with brilliance around them as a moment passed.
And then...
|Very well.|
The deadly agreement from the Sanctus Empress came!
BOOM!
Three Imperium Exarchs worked hand in hand as they released waves of power at the Paracosm Stage, the weavings of a Sentinel of Lumen being shredded apart within moments.
An engulfing explosion of light bloomed from such an action as at the center of this explosion, a twinkling white gold singularity flashed and disappeared.
And before Noah's eyes...
|The First Sentinel of Lumen has been laid to rest.|
|As the initiator of the DLC of Lumen Omniverse Expansion, you automatically gain the only possible randomized Loot dropped from the Sentinels of Lumen.|
|You have gained one of three parts of the Var-El Existential Omniversal Map Fragment.|

|Collecting all three Parts of the Var-El Existential Omniversal Map Fragment will grant you the capability to open up the Var-El Omniversal Intersect Portal and into this Eonic Omniverse Record. Clear this Eonic Omniverse Record to obtain unknown weavings that will allow the Protagonist to tip the scales of Causality towards his favor.|
|Enemies within the Var-El Eonic Omniverse Record are immune to Lesser Omniversal Authorities.|
|Enemies within the Var-El Eonic Omniverse Record have 1,000% more Existence Perception.|
|Enemies within the Var-El Eonic Omniverse Record have an Anti-Existence Energy Shield equivalent to their total value of Existence.|
An array of dazzling prompts cascaded over Noah's eyes as they seemed to only be beginning!
And each one introduced a heavy array of concepts that may cause lesser minds to go mad!

paragraphs: It was all in the form of a single dazzling singularity.

The Exarchs of the Imperium took down the Sentinel of Lumen, and the reward for it was instantly sent to Noah as by the time ybe blanket of Prompts regarding it began to fade, he looked at what had appeared within his Existence.
It looked similar to a piece of parchment- a part that belonged to a whole as the parchment shone with a white gold hue that only magnified the undefinable ecritures etched throughout it!
Noah looked at this parchment closely as the answer he was seeking...may be in any of the gates that could form when Map Fragments like these were put together.
More of them were needed.
Luckily, the Sentinels rushed towards the Imperium Legions and the Omniversal Pillagers as soon enough, a few more would perish and more Map Fragments would be obtained!
But in the midst of all of this...
|The Complex Weavings of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Deorcnysse seek to make their return and look for a place to designate as their Source.|
His Quintessential Codex of Extremity had the code laid down.
The Existential Paracosm Omniversal Seed made it possible to reawaken this devoured code- the weavings of the Greater Omniversal Authority of Deorcnysse!
But now, it needed to be housed somewhere.
It needed to be placed somewhere.
Noah didn't have to think about it too much before he made his choice.
|Your Eyes have been designated as the system to contain Deorcnysse.|
|The level of your eyes is far too low to be the Source of a Greater Omniversal Authority as they are pulled towards a more unique Distinction by the weavings of Deorcnysse.|
|The Distinction of An Ascendant Existential Omniversal Organ is granted to your eyes.|
|The Ascendant Existential Vincere Dominium Eyes are coming to fruition!|
WAA!
His eyes.

They burned with a blinding obsidian light as his nine pupils rotated like volatile suns, their borders becoming tainted black as inside the rims of the pupils...glorious stellar obsidian wings were carved in!

They melded together in such a unique way that if one were to look at Noah, one would only see each eye showing Nine pupils of brilliant darkness, with each pupil seeming like its own singularity that one could get lost in!
Within the depths of these eyes, the Existential Paracosm Omniversal Seed containing the weavings of Deorcnysse lay.
|The Eyes of Deorcnysse have been born.|
|Under the distinction of Ascendant Existential Vincere Dominium Eyes, the Eyes of Deorcnysse carry with them the full influence of a Greater Omniversal Authority.|
|Mobilizing the full weavings of Deorcnysse and its complex influence comes at no cost to you.|
|Countless probabilities in the usage of the Eyes of Deorcnysse lie in your understanding of the complete obscurity of this Greater Omniversal Authority.|
Such prompts came as if they were telling him to give it a go.
And so...
|Piety.|
He called out to Piety and the other Ascendant Existential Summons.

And simultaneously, all of their bodies flashed with white gold radiance as the potency of the weavings of Lumen....were currently greatest within Noah than Piety or anyone else as his figure appeared above a flaming Sentinel of Lumen that was making its way towards Legions of the Imperium.
Piety and the other Ascendant Existential Summons surrounded the Sentinel as it roared out in rage due to their obstruction, its eyes shooting out to beams of white gold lasers as at such a moment...
BZZZT!
Noah's Eyes of Deorcnysse flashed.
And it was like in this whole area, night had come.

The bright white gold laser shooting out of the Sentinel of Lumen was forcefully pushed back as its brilliance was being covered, the flames of light around the Sentinel immeasurably weakening as if they were being turned off!

If one looked closely, they would notice that even with the increased resistance against Existential Extremity Authorities, there was the influence of a few million of them wrapping around the Sentinel and causing everything about its existence to enter a state of darkness.
And when such a time came...
BOOM!
The spear of Piety swung down and cut the dimmed body in half.
The breath of Tiamatherion burned to a crisp one side of the dimmed body.
And Fenrir roared as his howl released a Shockwave that cut apart and dissolved what remained of the other half of the body!
Within an instant...
|The Second Sentinel of Lumen has been laid to rest.|
|You have gained one of three parts of the Wasser Existential Omniversal Map Fragment.|
With his Ascendant Existential Summons, Noah actually put to rest a Sentinel of Lumen within the span of an instant!

It was an action that caused Sona's pupils to constrict while others gazed on in somberness, the Omniversal Pillagers and Imperium forces in the distance even questioning why he would target Entities of Lumen he called out himself!
But none of this mattered to Noah.
What did matter was the randomized drop chance of the Maps from the Sentinels of Lumen.
He needed three of the same as getting different ones with every fall of a Sentinel would not help him now!
So...
|The Fortune of the Protagonist is immeasurable.|
|Somehow, things always seem to turn out in your favor as you receive what you need the most in a timely manner.|
|The randomization of dropped Loot has been altered.|
The moment these prompts came.
BOOM!
The Existential Devouring Turtur and Carrion Golem decimated a Sentinel of Lumen.
And a glorious prompt arose in front of Noah's eyes right after.
|The Third Sentinel of Lumen has been laid to rest.|
|You have gained the Third Fragment of the Var-El Existential Omniversal Map Fragments.|
Two prompts came in kind.
And since the Imperium Exarchs surrounded by Existential Paracosm Dikastes of Extremity were working hard...another Sentinel of Lumen fell not too long after.
|The Fourth Sentinel of Lumen has been laid to rest.|
|You have gained the Second Fragment of the Var-El Existential Omniversal Map Fragments.|
|You have gathered all the Fragments of the Var-El Existential Omniversal Map, and can now access its Eonic Omniverse Record.|
A glorious result was brought to fruition.
And it came at a time when a colorless light flashed, with the center of the battlefield still lined with the Pillars and archways of white gold brilliance...had another visitor.
With a weary gaze and insurmountable beauty, the Sanctus Empress appeared.
Now, following her...were other things entirely!

chapters.title: Chapter 3122 What is Existence? I
paragraphs: The weary visage of the Sanctus Empress.

Her appearance was not something expected by anyone apart from a single being on this battlefield, with her unfathomable colorless brilliance being locked onto by all wills here apart from the Sentinels of Lumen!
The Elder Queen Mothers gazed forward with visible shock as even Sona and other Sanctus Princesses wondered if they were seeing correctly!
In the distance, the Existential Devouring Turtur and Carrion Golem paused with grave weavings as they sensed the profound sense of oppression.
Meanwhile, the Imperium Exarch became immeasurably stern as they instantly began to group up together!
The Leader of the Sanctus Populi blatantly showing herself here?

What strategic value was there for her to do this? Her appearance would prompt the most powerful forces of the Imperium to come to this location very soon as all that she cared for could be eradicated!
So why?
Why come here?
The question only hung around momentarily.
An instant later, the visage of the Sanctus Empress paused right where it stood as she gazed around everything occurring on this battlefield, her gaze coming to pause on none other than Noah!
She looked at him with calm eyes that others didn't know the meaning of.
Eyes that between her and him seemed to say- I hope you know what you're doing!
At such a moment, Noah crushed something in his hands.
And at the same moment...
ROAR!
A bellow of shock and horror rang out above- at the region where the Omniversal Pillagers were as many wills honed in towards this bellow.
And there...
|Huh?|
Everyone blinked to make sure they were seeing right.
They didn't know when.
But suddenly, the Legions of Omniversal Pillagers had around them and amidst them...segmented worms with many legs and an aurora of obsidian wings.

And in the span of a nanosecond, by the time their eyes and wills turned over to this location...half of all Omniversal Pillagers silently turned to ash that was absorbed in the bodies of the massive segmented worms!
|WHO!|

A bellow of shock that didn't veil its fear boomed out as the Existential Devouring Turtur released countless threads of Kataklysmos over, but in the next moment, cracks rang out above its turtle shells as horrifically, the sickle-like legs of multiple worms pierced through its thick defenses as if they were nothing!

But astoundingly, the power of a Paracosm still retained its Hegemony as the Existential Devouring Turtur didn't have everything about its existence devoured and turned to ash, its figure miniaturizing while it roared out with fear!
The gazes of the Imperium Exarchs rapidly changed at such a scene as Exarch Shavronne spoke with somberness.
|Devouring Worms! Restrict the usage of your power and grasp as much about them as you can! We will-|
Her intent stopped.
It had to.
This was because suddenly, in the corner of her eyes...she could swear that she was seeing the carapace of these segmented worms beside Exarch Maligaro.
And at the same moment, she noticed it...
|Motherfuc-|
BOOM!
Exarch Maligaro's body exploded with a swirling rune of multicolored brilliance that blocked the sharp sickles of the Worm that had somehow gotten near him!
Yet this design and defense of a Paracosm Stage Entity...
CRACK!
Was splintering apart as if it were glass in front of the sickles of the obsidian worm.

It was a shocking turn of events that made the expressions of the Imperium forces ashen, Exarch Shavronne turning around to see that somehow, there were hundreds of Devouring Worms that had appeared around and within the Imperium Legions as only now did the screams of Entities start to spread in shock and horror!
|Steady! Remain together!|
Her Paracosm surged as the unfathomable light of The Imperium spread from her.
With a belly full of rage, she turned towards the forces of the Sanctus Populi and the Sanctus Empress.
She arrived here and these things instantly appeared?
She must have brought them with her! Or she was their target that was dragged here!
With rising rage, she turned towards the other side where...
|Huh?|
Immeasurably empty.
The forces of the Sanctus Populi had all but disappeared as the only ones still present...were only the figures of the Master of Lumen and the Sanctus Empress who had appeared beside him!
Only these two remained as around them, Devouring Worms began to surge towards their direction as it was only at this time that wailing screams reverberated across the battlefield.
WU! WU! WU!

The cries destabilized all Existential Extremity Authorities as Exarch Shavronne felt the horrific threats all around, ignoring the happenings of the Sanctus Populi and focusing on their own survival!
Moments ago.
Right after the appearance of the Sanctus Empress, Noah crushed a singularity in his hands.
It was nothing else other than the Var-El Existential Omniversal Map!
|The Var-El Existential Omniversal Map has been utilized.|
|You can select an unlimited number of Lifeforms to enter this Eonic Omniverse Record with you.|
|The maximum amount of time that will pass within the Var-El Eonic Omniverse Record is 1 Month.|
|Only a Nanosecond will have passed in the outside System of Existence you utilized the Var-El Existential Omniversal Map on.|
Yes.
The possible solution Noah's existence was looking up with every ounce of his power.

The ridiculous capabilities of the Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of the Protagonist continued to exceed all expectations and make unfathomable things possible as Noah made his choice while his voice traveled to Sona and all the others.
|Do not resist.|
A calm voice that even held a hint of command.
Around the same time, it reverberated within towards the weavings of the Sanctus Populi here; the affirmation of the Sanctus Empress came as she appeared beside Noah!

Thereafter, a white gold light wrapped around Sona who turned to stare at Noah carefully before she nodded, her figure flashing away along with tens of thousands of others as if they were fading stars.
They weren't the only people Noah selected for entry into the Var-El Eonic Omniverse Record as at the same time...
|The Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed as well.|
His voice astoundingly traversed across the weavings of spacetime to pull his own home into an Eonic Omniverse Record!
He was doing all of this to prepare before he himself went in.
But first...he had to get a grasp on the horror of these Devouring Worms and how he could counter them!

chapters.title: Chapter 3123 What is Existence? II
paragraphs: The memories Noah was obtaining from the Lineage of Lumen were scattered.
He knew of the Devouring Worms from the even more scattered weavings of the Lumen Emperor as still, there were many missing pieces.
|Existential Extremity Authority is ineffective against them, and becomes even more ineffective as they seem to adapt to it after Devouring.|
The voice of the Sanctus Empress echoed out as her current figure was burning with colorless brilliance.
Her hair was burning with colorless flames as even the robes she was adorned in held a colorless glare!
Deep within him, Noah's weavings of Quintessence looked at this color silently as its extreme rose.
He nodded at the words of the Sanctus Empress as he continued to monitor how the Imperium Exarchs and the Omniversal Pillagers were dealing with the Devouring Worms as the answer...was abysmal!
Those below the Teracosm Stage didn't even survive the first strike.
Those at the Teracosm Stage could exchange a few moves and block the sickles of these Devouring Worms, but eventually, they fell as a second or third Worm joined in!
Only the Paracosm Stage Entities seemed to be putting up a fight, but even in such a fight, the winner was clear.

Everything they threw out was withstood and devoured as the strikes of these Devouring Worms were barely stood against- their defenses gradually becoming worn down as it was clear what would happen once time passed!
Then...there were the Devouring Worms that currently surrounded Sentinels of Lumen.
A fantastical scene was present.
Unlike the Imperium Exarchs and Omniversal Pillagers at the Paracosm Stage, the blazing flames of the Sentinels of Lumen had their bright light...surviving longer.
|What?|
Noah wasn't the only one who saw this as the eyes of the Sanctus Empress became immeasurably sharp!
But the words that the brilliance of Lumen was surviving longer weren't too apt.
It was more correct to say....they actually had more effectiveness against the Devouring Worms!
Noah's eyes lit up.
This was what he wanted to test.
This was a possibility he was looking into!
The blazing flames of the Sentinels were pushing the Devouring Worms back with a little bit more force, but they still devoured even these Flames as when that happened...
SKEE!
Their wails seemed to buzz with excitement.
As if something they had been missing this whole time...had finally been found.
SKEE!
With fervor, swarms of Devouring Worms began to gather around Sentinels of Lumen as even though their flames had a bit more effectiveness...
|The Fifth Sentinel of Lumen has been laid to rest.|
|The Sixth Sentinel of Lumen has been laid to rest.|
|You have gained the Third Fragment of the Wasser Existential Omniversal Map Fragments.|
|You have gained the First Fragment of the Toxicum Existential Omniversal Map Fragments.|
Even though they seemed to be able to withstand The Devouring Worms more.
Tens of them gathered towards Sentinels of Lumen as if they were attracted to a great tonic, and these Sentinels were eventually overwhelmed as they only focused on attacking!
So the why to all this came.
And Noah needed to confirm himself as at this moment, he gazed at three Worms that came towards himself.
He breathed out as his eyes blinked, Nine Pupils within rotating as the Eyes of Deorcnysse turned everything dark!
WUU!

And surprise buzzed within the Devouring Worms as heavy chains of Greater Omniversal Authority of Deorcnysse wrapped around them- chains they then broke as dark tongues erupted from their segmented bodies that licked and began to devour these chains as if they recognized them.
After all, such an authority was the first thing they devoured when they arrived!
How come it was here again now?
These thoughts of theirs only flashed briefly before they destroyed all weavings of Deorcnysse that Noah had imposed on them and neared his figure.

Noah observed the result of his attack as he didn't run from the terrifying figures of the Devouring Worms that now added up to 9, his brilliant Invictus Dominium Wings radiating a bright luster of Lumen as they folded and wrapped around his body as if they were a blanket.
Lumen wrapped around him with potent as the rings of the benefits of the DLC of Lumen Omniverse Expansion still circled him!
And the sickles of the Devouring Worms came down.
BZZZT!
As if metal was grating against metal.
A heavy resistance actually occurred ever so briefly before...
CRACK!
The Innate defenses swirling around Noah were shattered.
The glimmer of white gold brilliance of Lumen slowly became pierced!
Even though there was Resistance, it ultimately meant nothing to these enemies!
But Noah was smiling deeply at this moment as he confirmed the root cause why the Sentinels of Lumen and now himself- why they showed Greater resiliency.
One of the boons granted from the DLC of Lumen Omniverse Expansion.
He brought up the prompt swiftly as his existence began to distort.
|You have gained 1% Absolute Omniversal Resistance to all Existence Based Attacks.|
1% Resistance to all Existence Based Attacks.
A prompt that he didn't give too much attention to when the Lumen Omniverse Expansion was laid down before!
But now, it seemed he had to look at it with immense attention.
HUUM!
Just as the sickles of the Devouring Worms were about to reach his Omniversal Organ.
His figure distorted and disappeared.

Behind him, the visage of the Sanctus Empress felt the white gold light of Lumen that had wrapped around her, not denying it after the words of the man that had just disappeared as she allowed this light to take her away!
As for where, she and all the others did not yet know.
Before Noah's eyes.
Waves of white gold brilliance came and went as eventually...
|You are entering the Var-El Eonic Omniverse Record.|
|Your current entry point is the safe zone free of any other influences, and will only retain its usage as a Safe Zone for a day.|
Noah blinked as in the next moment, he arrived in skies bathed with calm crimson flames.
Near him, a miniaturized Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed that took on the size of a few thousand miles- akin to a small world, could be seen.
Even further nearby, the figures of the Legions of Sanctus Populi could be seen along with Piety and others!
Seeing such a scene, Noah let out a deep breath of calmness.
He now had 30 days to understand.
30 days to adapt within this Eonic Omniverse Record as outside of it, only a nanosecond would pass!
As these thoughts swirled, dozens of prompts introducing the Var-El Eonic Omniverse Record swarmed down!

sentences.text: The memories Noah was obtaining from the Lineage of Lumen were scattered.
He knew of the Devouring Worms from the even more scattered weavings of the Lumen Emperor as still, there were many missing pieces.
|Existential Extremity Authority is ineffective against them, and becomes even more ineffective as they seem to adapt to it after Devouring.|
The voice of the Sanctus Empress echoed out as her current figure was burning with colorless brilliance.
Her hair was burning with colorless flames as even the robes she was adorned in held a colorless glare!
Deep within him, Noah's weavings of Quintessence looked at this color silently as its extreme rose.
He nodded at the words of the Sanctus Empress as he continued to monitor how the Imperium Exarchs and the Omniversal Pillagers were dealing with the Devouring Worms as the answer...was abysmal!
Those below the Teracosm Stage didn't even survive the first strike.
Those at the Teracosm Stage could exchange a few moves and block the sickles of these Devouring Worms, but eventually, they fell as a second or third Worm joined in!
Only the Paracosm Stage Entities seemed to be putting up a fight, but even in such a fight, the winner was clear.

Everything they threw out was withstood and devoured as the strikes of these Devouring Worms were barely stood against- their defenses gradually becoming worn down as it was clear what would happen once time passed!
Then...there were the Devouring Worms that currently surrounded Sentinels of Lumen.
A fantastical scene was present.
Unlike the Imperium Exarchs and Omniversal Pillagers at the Paracosm Stage, the blazing flames of the Sentinels of Lumen had their bright light...surviving longer.
|What?|
Noah wasn't the only one who saw this as the eyes of the Sanctus Empress became immeasurably sharp!
But the words that the brilliance of Lumen was surviving longer weren't too apt.
It was more correct to say....they actually had more effectiveness against the Devouring Worms!
Noah's eyes lit up.
This was what he wanted to test.
This was a possibility he was looking into!
The blazing flames of the Sentinels were pushing the Devouring Worms back with a little bit more force, but they still devoured even these Flames as when that happened...
SKEE!
Their wails seemed to buzz with excitement.
As if something they had been missing this whole time...had finally been found.
SKEE!
With fervor, swarms of Devouring Worms began to gather around Sentinels of Lumen as even though their flames had a bit more effectiveness...
|The Fifth Sentinel of Lumen has been laid to rest.|
|The Sixth Sentinel of Lumen has been laid to rest.|
|You have gained the Third Fragment of the Wasser Existential Omniversal Map Fragments.|
|You have gained the First Fragment of the Toxicum Existential Omniversal Map Fragments.|
Even though they seemed to be able to withstand The Devouring Worms more.
Tens of them gathered towards Sentinels of Lumen as if they were attracted to a great tonic, and these Sentinels were eventually overwhelmed as they only focused on attacking!
So the why to all this came.
And Noah needed to confirm himself as at this moment, he gazed at three Worms that came towards himself.
He breathed out as his eyes blinked, Nine Pupils within rotating as the Eyes of Deorcnysse turned everything dark!
WUU!

And surprise buzzed within the Devouring Worms as heavy chains of Greater Omniversal Authority of Deorcnysse wrapped around them- chains they then broke as dark tongues erupted from their segmented bodies that licked and began to devour these chains as if they recognized them.
After all, such an authority was the first thing they devoured when they arrived!
How come it was here again now?
These thoughts of theirs only flashed briefly before they destroyed all weavings of Deorcnysse that Noah had imposed on them and neared his figure.

Noah observed the result of his attack as he didn't run from the terrifying figures of the Devouring Worms that now added up to 9, his brilliant Invictus Dominium Wings radiating a bright luster of Lumen as they folded and wrapped around his body as if they were a blanket.
Lumen wrapped around him with potent as the rings of the benefits of the DLC of Lumen Omniverse Expansion still circled him!
And the sickles of the Devouring Worms came down.
BZZZT!
As if metal was grating against metal.
A heavy resistance actually occurred ever so briefly before...
CRACK!
The Innate defenses swirling around Noah were shattered.
The glimmer of white gold brilliance of Lumen slowly became pierced!
Even though there was Resistance, it ultimately meant nothing to these enemies!
But Noah was smiling deeply at this moment as he confirmed the root cause why the Sentinels of Lumen and now himself- why they showed Greater resiliency.
One of the boons granted from the DLC of Lumen Omniverse Expansion.
He brought up the prompt swiftly as his existence began to distort.
|You have gained 1% Absolute Omniversal Resistance to all Existence Based Attacks.|
1% Resistance to all Existence Based Attacks.
A prompt that he didn't give too much attention to when the Lumen Omniverse Expansion was laid down before!
But now, it seemed he had to look at it with immense attention.
HUUM!
Just as the sickles of the Devouring Worms were about to reach his Omniversal Organ.
His figure distorted and disappeared.

Behind him, the visage of the Sanctus Empress felt the white gold light of Lumen that had wrapped around her, not denying it after the words of the man that had just disappeared as she allowed this light to take her away!
As for where, she and all the others did not yet know.
Before Noah's eyes.
Waves of white gold brilliance came and went as eventually...
|You are entering the Var-El Eonic Omniverse Record.|
|Your current entry point is the safe zone free of any other influences, and will only retain its usage as a Safe Zone for a day.|
Noah blinked as in the next moment, he arrived in skies bathed with calm crimson flames.
Near him, a miniaturized Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed that took on the size of a few thousand miles- akin to a small world, could be seen.
Even further nearby, the figures of the Legions of Sanctus Populi could be seen along with Piety and others!
Seeing such a scene, Noah let out a deep breath of calmness.

As these thoughts swirled, dozens of prompts introducing the Var-El Eonic Omniverse Record swarmed down!

chapters.title: Chapter 3124 What is Existence? III
paragraphs: |Enemies within the Var-El Eonic Omniverse Record are immune to Lesser Omniversal Authorities.|
|Enemies within the Var-El Eonic Omniverse Record have 1,000% more Existence Perception.|
|Enemies within the Var-El Eonic Omniverse Record have an Anti-Existence Energy Shield equivalent to their total value of Existence.|

Prompts regarding the Eonic Omniverse Record he had entered played out before his eyes as he acclimated to his surroundings, his figure drawing in the eyes of all Entities here at this moment as before any buzzing noises arose, his voice echoed out calmly.
"Take a breather. We are in a small segment of time with nothing chasing after us."
His words were telling the vast array of Entities to relax.
To take a moment to breathe and reset from their tense weavings of battle!
As he said these words, the visage of the Sanctus Empress also arrived as she looked around her and behind her carefully.
Almost as if she was waiting for enemies to follow!
Noah shook his head while grasping the weavings of everything around him, the crimson flames of the red tinted skies fading in the background.
|All Enemies Leech 1% of Existence upon any successful attack.|
|Enemies strewn across the Var-El Eonic Omniverse Record move in packs, and are able to revive the Records of any of their fallen brethren if given the space and time.|

|The Var-El Eonic Omniverse Record has a total of three Eonic Anchors of Existence that have to be defeated in order to successfully clear this Eonic Omniverse Record and fully attain what can aid the Protagonist in tipping the scales of Causality.|
The background of the rules of Existence of this unique Eonic Omniverse Record were established as Noah carefully went through them.
Rules of Existence!
How differently this place operated compared to the Omniverse he and the others knew of!
It was all in the manner of Existence.
And seeing the scattered records of the Devouring Worms as well as meeting them for the first time caused Noah to question Existence itself.
Existence. Anti-Existence.
While he and others referred to the Devouring Worms as those that may be Anti-Existence, those Devouring Worms could look at Noah and the others as if they were the ones that were Anti-Existence!
It was only something given to refer to another side that lived on a different scope of Existence.

In his time here, Noah had to gain a better understanding of what Existence actually was, as understanding the Existence or Anti-Existence of the Devouring Worms would be the key to being able to withstand and defeat them!
|A Place to take a breather, you say?|
Beside his figure that was fully in thought, Sona appeared as she looked all around them.
At the distant rising golden mountains of flames.
At the massive red trees forming wide and endless forests that could be seen stretching out towards the horizon.
Within those trees, she could feel powerful auras blazing out as they seemed to only be waiting for something before they moved!
Noah nodded at Sona as she came close to him and breathed.
|We'll have 30 days uninterrupted here to prepare. Only a Nanosecond will pass outside of this Eonic Omniverse Record.|
Fantastical words.
Words that any other Entity would have laughed off incredulously, but Sona only nodded as she radiated immense coldness and dignity.
|Good, enough time for me to attain Paracosm and take my Omniversal Organ to the next level.|
Her heart that she gave to Noah.
The longer she didn't have her own Heart in her body, the more pronounced the effect would be when it returned to her.
Especially of the person who had been keeping it held great strength and elevated his own Existence in the meantime!
And who among the Entities out there elevated themselves at the pace Noah had in the last day?
The inclusion of Lumen to his Lineage. The burst of Deorcnysse within his very eyes. His constant elevation that occurred with the beat of his heart!
With all the advancements Noah made, Sona's Omniversal Organ within him was only that much more enriched as when it returned to her again...
She nodded as in her thoughts, she didn't notice the Sanctus Empress had been staring at her and Noah this whole time as she turned towards her now.
|Granny.|
WAA!

The Elder Queen Mothers who revered the Sanctus Empress buzzed and looked admonishingly towards Sona, and yet the utterly gorgeous figure of the Sanctus Empress who overwhelmingly exceeded all of them in power here only nodded back towards Sona as her focus came to Noah.
|If what you say stands to be true, we have 30 days in here to figure out how to counter the Devouring Worms. What solution did you find?|
Austere colorless brilliance surged around her.
Noah turned towards this Entity that exceeded the Paracosm Stage and smiled as his voice echoed out.
|Existence.|

|The capability to resist attacks regardless of their Source- whether it be Existential Extremity Authority or Omniversal Authority, or the weavings of something like Lumen, or the weavings of the Existence Based Attacks of the Devouring Worms. The capability to resist all these different weavings of Existence- that is the key.|
It dealt with Existence!

It was such a profound topic that it was something those exceeding the Paracosm Stage were grappling with, and yet Noah was stepping on the path of understanding Existence itself and the different forms it could come in.
The Sanctus Empress nodded at Noah's words thoughtfully as her immense will then spread out into the surroundings.
|And this Record...holds things that will further that goal?|
Noah smiled at this question while nodding.

|Yes, think of everything within this Record apart from us as enemies out for our Blood. And they are particularly dangerous ones as Existential Extremity Authorities...won't be too effective on them!|
Yes.
The prompts regarding just what Eonic Omniverse Record they were in continued to stream towards Noah's mind.
And those designated as enemies here...seemed as terrifying as any enemy they had faced so far!

chapters.title: Chapter 3125 What is Existence? IV
paragraphs: |The enemies within the Var-El Eonic Omniverse Record are of unknown origins of Existence, but seem to derive their Source of Existence from light and flames.|

|The Faeburned Existences are tinged by the weavings of unique light and flames, capable of breaking down the mental defenses of their targets at the speed of light as they make them question the root of their Existence. A weak Source of Existence unable to combat them will fall easily and join the ranks of their Legions.|
|All Faeburned follow the Banner of the Faesinged Queen- and Entity with such a potent Source of Existence that you should hope you do not meet first.|

|Under the Banner of the Sunwinged Leprachanus, the Leprachanus Existences seek nothing but the core Source of Existence of their targets- wishing to mix it with alchemical concoctions to form the Ultimate Panacea of Existence for them to enjoy. Do not be caught by them as your fate will not be a kind one.|

|All Leprachanus Existence cultivate a type of Existence that grants them more strength depending on the level of wealth and resources they acquire, with the Leprachanus attaining the highest levels of riches attaining the distinction of the Sunwinged Leprachanus.|
A shocking amount of information flowed into Noah's mind regarding the Var-El Eonic Omniverse Record and what enemies could be found within it!
Faeburned Existences.
Leprachanus Existences!
All of them were different types of Existences entirely that didn't rely on the same system of Power as Noah.
As terrifying as Faeburned Existences were, the Leprachanus Existences were so astounding that their level of power was determined by their level of wealth and resources.
Could Noah incorporate such a System of Existence himself and scale up his power based on the amount of Loot he had?
And how would this aid in the resistance against the inviolable power of the Devouring Worms?
There were many questions to go along with the flow of information as it began to end while introducing the third and final type of Existence one may run across in the Var-El Eonic Omniverse Record.
|One of the more dangerous Entities to come across in the Var-El Eonic Omniverse Record are the Satyrus Existences.|

|Through the corruption of life and Existence, the Satyrus follow the Banner of the Satyrus Nymph, their Existence thriving on the manipulation and accumulation of life force to relegate their power. An Existence full of life could be drained of their Existence before knowing full well what just occurred, the blanket of complete darkness enveloping them soon after. Since the Satyrus Existences base everything on Vitality, they are unconsciously drawn towards any source nearby as you may not have to even seek for them.|
The last introduced type of Existence was a terrifying one as Noah nodded with somberness.
There was a day left within this safe area surrounded by flaming skies and rising mountains in the distance that danced with vegetation surrounded by sparkling flames.
A day for them to prepare to clear the Var-El Eonic Omniverse Record!

Thinking of this, Noah gave a light nod while raising his head towards the multicolored sparkling Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed that seemed like a small world ahead, light flashing on its thin boundary as figures with his likeness began to appear with a flash of brilliance.
His Ascendant Existential Extremity Clones.

They spread out into the surroundings to canvas how wide the safe zone was and what could happen with a preliminary exploration even before the time of the safe zone ended, his Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of the Protagonist turning towards the Sanctus Empress as he spoke.

|We have a day before things get really busy. How about I invite you to my home for us to prepare?| Noah's eyes shone as they also gazed at the tens of thousands that made up the Sanctus Legions- the many Dragon Knights and Sanctus Princesses.

|Have the Sanctus Legions reorganize themselves as I share the information on the enemies we will soon face. Understanding and learning about their System of Existence may be extremely useful in understanding ourselves and our enemies.|
He spoke to the Sanctus Empress in a whole different stage of power calmly as he had his own assurances.
The Sanctus Empress looked between him and Sona before staring at the Elder Queen Mothers and giving them commands before ultimately turning back to them and nodding.
|Lead the way.|
Towards the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed.
Noah's figure disappeared into it as alongside him, Sona, the Sanctus Empress, and a few other Elder Queen Mothers along with Sanctus Princess Emilliana also went in!
Amidst the flicker of brilliance and wonder, their figures appeared inside of the object that looked as tiny as a small world only extending a few thousand miles.
Yet inside of it...
|What is this?|
The eyes of the Sanctus Empress became surrounded by unfathomably bright colorless light as she looked at the utterly massive Aletheian Havens rotating around an even more massive Extremity Vein.

This wasn't to mention the potent light of unique Existential Extremity Authorities permeation everything- much less the changes brought about by Noah's introduction of Lumen into his Lineage and into the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed as at this very moment...changes and advancements were taking place!
Towards such a question, Noah smiled as he went towards the Desecrated Existential Chronos Domain while answering calmly.
|My home.|
As this occurred, Noah's Ascendant Existential Extremity Clones spread out across the safe zone of the Var-El Eonic Omniverse Record outside of the Infinite Existential Omniversal Seed.

In a certain direction, the Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of Cheats floated in front of a transparent barrier of flames that demarcated the safe zone, his fingers twirling around it as Noah smiled.
There were three different types of Systems of Existence just in this Var-El Eonic Omniverse Record alone.
What would he be able to grasp by understanding them? How much more would he be able to bend Existence?

He truly wanted to know as before he allowed his people and the Sanctus Populi to roam free against these Unknown enemies with their own Systems of Existence- he wanted to experience for himself just how deadly they were!
So, without further ado...he stepped out of the boundary of the safe zone and entered a different landscape entirely...!

chapters.title: Chapter 3126 What is Existence? V
paragraphs: Space twisted and fluctuated.
In front of Noah, the stretch of crimson-colored skies continued as below, the forest aflame with brilliance actually saw an ending in the distance as the landscape turned into a desert.
The Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of Cheats flew across this landscape while carefully spreading his aura out, his eyes emanating waves of Deorcnysse as his pupils constantly spun.

He was still understanding more and more of this Greater Omniversal Authority that was revived due to his Quintessential Codex of Extremity, with its power under him only becoming more potent as while he delved deeper into it, one of his main objectives was how to utilize it and keep the effectiveness of all Omniversal Authorities in a reality where many Existences were resistant to them!
One of the methodologies he was theorizing about incorporating was the weavings of Lumen.
They didn't abandon Existential Extremity Authorities, but simply incorporated them fully into Lumen itself.
A single weaving carrying the banner of all!
Through it, Noah even gained the Absolute Omniversal Resistance against Existence Based Attacks as this was the track to follow and expand on, with all others supplementing it.
These supplements to fill in the gaps of his understanding...were none other than the different types of Existences that may be in this Var-El Eonic Omniverse Record and other Records out there!
HUUM!
He shot out across the crimson skies like a meteor and crossed into the vast desert, rising dunes and sandy mountains stretching out all around him with no signs of life until...
|Hmm?|
His eyes turned in a certain direction.
There, the scattered flames in the skies above seemed to be swirling with direction as a gold hue flashed!
His Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of Cheats changed directions.
He neared the gold hue as fantastically, the barren earth lost its scorching heat to show the beginnings of vegetation- the scene ahead of him showing a rare oasis in the desert!
Within the center of this oasis, a body of water shimmering with a golden hue could be seen, and on the edges of this body of water, lush trees arose.
What was unique was the vibrant life force on top of some of these trees and inside the body of water.

The figures of Entities with fair complexions gazed up to look at him curiously, their bodies humanoid as a skirt of golden leaves covered their lower bodies, with their upper bodies being laid bare as the abundant blessings of some could clearly be seen.
Beauty emanated from them as wings of crimson brilliance extended from their backs, the figures on the trees and around the body of water smiling while beckoning Noah forward!

Two female winged Entities even floated up and came beside Noah serenely as their heads flowed with long crimson locks of hair that twirled around their blessed breasts, their eyes sparkling with pupils as bright as suns as they spoke towards Noah.
|Sweet friend, what brings you to our little Oasis? You seem tired and tense...maybe we can help you with that?|
They held tremendous beauty. Their eyes were big as their ears were elongated and pointy, with their fair bodies screaming of their delicacy and uniqueness.
As they spoke, they grabbed Noah's arms and pushed them in between their vibrant breasts while leading him toward the water!
Noah's brows raised as he asked.
|Oh? How exactly can you all help?|
His eyes seemed to be twinkling with curiosity.

And the winged Entities around Noah smiled further while staring at each other with devious smiles, one coming in front of Noah and beginning to unfurl his white gold robes while the other got on her knees, her eyes blinking sweetly!
Noah looked at this scene and nodded while voicing out, his Eyes of Deorcnysse flashing with brilliance at this moment.
|I am fully on board, but why have your friends surrounded me entirely?|
A flare of darkness flashed.
The scene Noah observed distorted as the vibrant oasis faded to reveal the outline of ruins.
In Noah's immediate surroundings, dozens of winged entities surrounded him- some with their bows drawn while others held flaming halberds and spears!
Their eyes burned with malice and fervor as they were meters away from skewering Noah's figure!
It was a camp of none other than Faeburned Existences.
Entities who followed the Banner of the Faesinged Queen and could heavily manipulate the weavings of one's mental state- the very flow of their soul, before they even knew what was going on!
|What are you talking about, friend? Let us share the joys of life before anything else.|
The Faeburned on her knees before Noah reached into his robes still as if nothing was wrong, her eyes spinning like shining suns as the imaginary scene around them began to restore itself!
The Faeburned Existences were a terrifying type.
One could still find themselves living in an entirely different reality while their very existence was being skewered and drained.
Noah's Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of Cheats nodded at this terrifying scene while putting his hand on the chin of the terrifying Faeburned Existence below him.
|I'm all for it, but you see...I'm also not alone. I've got a few friends as I wonder if you can help them too?|
HUUM!
Above the domain of a False Oasis.
Space distorted as the massive figures of Piety, Tiamatherion, Fenrir, Nagarius, and Bubbles appeared.
They weren't alone as alongside them, a dazzling Three-Legged Golden Crow could be seen as atop it, Noah's Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of Entropy burned with brilliance.
Nearby, his Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of Quintessence rose with a colorless brilliance!
Many things had occurred in the three days within the Desecrated Existential Chronos Domain.
And even more things would change from here on out as the moment more of Noah was revealed, the illusion in the surroundings shattered like glass as the heavy weavings of Faeburned Existences blared!

In the fair hands of the Faeburned Existence on her knees before Noah, a molten spear burned and shot up to scorch Noah while beside him, the other Faeburned Existence opened her jaws wide to reveal immeasurably sharp teeth that went to rip apart his neck!

chapters.title: Chapter 3127 What is Existence? VI
paragraphs: |Lesser men would have fallen here.|
In the terrifying unfolding situation, Noah's voice echoed out as he smiled.
|But I am no lesser man.|
BOOM!
The brightness of the surroundings dimmed as everything lost all light.
It wasn't because darkness descended- but all light was entirely devoured!
It was something caused by the Eyes of Deorcnysse, yes- but it was also something far more fundamental than that.
|The Light of Lumen is being etched into the Eyes of Deorcnysse.|
Yes.
He knew the answer lay in Lumen as he sought to incorporate it even further into his own strength.

So at this moment, he put together light and darkness to see what effect could be produced when the weavings of a Greater Omniversal Authority he controlled became even further concentrated with Lumen!
His dark pupils spun, but a heavy white gold light seemed to be at their very core.
This rotation and brilliance of light didn't simply cause things to go dark- but it absorbed all forms of light nearby!
|All Sources of Light have been devoured into the Eye of Deorcnysse.|
|The Light-Based Mental Attacks from enemy targets have all been devoured and lost their luster.|
|The light allowing for sight has been devoured and lost its luster.|
It was a horrific sight that affected all Entities but Noah.
Even Piety and the other Ascendant Existential Summons experienced the same thing!
In this whole area, all Entities felt like they had gone blind.
There was no light.
Nothing could be seen.
The only way to see was to spread one's aura and will as even this seemed foggy in the absence of light!
But that wasn't all.
A glacial drop in temperature occurred that wasn't as simple as it becoming 'cold'.
It was a coldness that seemed capable of freezing existence itself!
|The domain affected has become a Restrictive Domain of Existence that slows down the workings of existence itself.|
|After your Existence absorbed all Light nearby, it has been filled with tremendous light and heat that can now be released in a single concentrated output.|
His pupils were the only bright points of brilliance.
The dark rims shone with a heavy white gold luminosity as at this moment, Noah truly walked on the path of understanding Existence and how to alter it!
|An Astounding Achievement!|
|The Existence Based Attack- Existential Eclipse has been designed, its initiation requiring the weavings of a Greater Omniversal Authority to be mobilized in addition to the weavings of Lumen.|
|Your Distinction as the Weaver of Existence is vastly beginning to outstrip Your Distinction as the Weaver of Extremity.|
WAA!
Yes.
He was the Weaver of Extremity.
But he was also the Weaver of Existence.
And currently, Existence seemed to be taking centerpoint.
As Noah understood and manipulated Existence more and more...wasn't this distinction bound to exceed others?!
HUUM!
As the profound methodology he had tried yielded results, Noah utilized the other side of his newly designed Existence Based Attack.
|Release.|
All the light he absorbed.
It was focused and concentrated.
And it was then released at specific points and vectors as from Noah, what seemed like lasers of white gold brilliance flashed!
Thereafter, light began to descend from the outside space and fill up this area with brilliance again.

Noah looked down and held the face of the Faeburned Existence on her knees whose hands were frozen, her entire Existence having been pierced through by one of the scorching rays Noah released that contained the light and power she had released, and the light and power of the few dozen Faeburned Existences in this False Oasis!
Noah had effectively devoured their potent attacks, processed them as light through his eyes, and redirected them.
The simple fact that these existences were releasing a Light Based Mental Attack that was then redirected meant their souls received a tremendous shock!
|The Faesinged Queen now knows of you, O Intruder.|
As her body began to shatter into glimmers of light, the Faeburned Existence smiled and spoke such words.

Besides Noah, the Faeburned Existence that had been trying to devour his neck and head also collapsed into flickers of light- both of these entities being on their own scales of power even as Noah designated them to be on the upper-tier equivalent of Teracosm!

|You have gained a Faeburned Source of Existence. Collecting these and understanding how the Faeburned Existences relegate their Aspects of Existence will be useful in allowing the Protagonist to further tip the scales.|
|You have gained a Faeburned Source of Existence...|

Such prompts began to rise as eight more Faeburned Existences fell under Noah's concentrated attacks, the others roaring out a melody from their mouths at this moment that caused all authorities to flicker and begin disintegrating!
But at such a time...
SAA!
The Spear of the Last Guardian of Lumen moved.

Piety and all others unleashed their power while using Lumen alone to withstand The mental waves of attacks by the Faeburned Existences, Noah's Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of Entropy going towards the depths of the False Oasis where a massive Faeburned Existence holding a blade of pure mental light was rising- his aura equivalent to Paracosm!
This was a single outpost of the Faeburned Existences as at its center, there was a terrifying Entity equivalent to the Paracosm Stage.
Just how ridiculous would the Faesinged Queen be, and her level of power?
The answer was a heavy one as Noah grasped the Faeburned Source of Existence while his Will delved into it.
And he saw...the complex weavings of a certain type of Existence.
One whose Pillars were built on light, flames, and the weavings of Existence through the soul- through the mind alone!
|You've gained a preliminary understanding of the physiology and Existence of the Faeburned Existences.|
More information on how different and how much the Faeburned Existences were the same flowed into Noah's mind.
Noah perused it as he made his first major gain in the Var-El Eonic Omniverse Record- the fusion of the weavings of Lumen as one of his Omniversal Organs that gave birth to an Existence Based Attack!

chapters.title: Chapter 3128 Integration! I
paragraphs: A glimpse of understanding regarding the physiology of Existence of the Faeburned Existences.

This was what Noah attained so far as his forged dug deeper into the False Oasis for the last enemy here, his own Existence getting a gauge on how powerful these Entities were and whether his forces would be okay to face them.

As he observed the unique changes of Existence that the Faeburned Existences held with their Source, Noah's mind wandered as he thought about another Existence he knew of that mainly dealt with the mind and soul.
An Existence he hadn't checked in on, but from their faint connection that still stood strong, he knew that they were still alive and kicking if not even more robust than ever before!
An infection was something that spread fast.
And it spread even faster when there was a deluge of chaos blooming, with the undercurrents going unseen for a long time!
A certain infection and corruption was using this time of increased Entropy to rapidly spread across the Imperium forces as its centerpoint...was Cappadocia.
Within the last minutes before the initiation of the DLC of Lumen Omniverse Expansion.
A young man floated serenely while surrounded by countless sparkling tendrils of light.

His eyes radiated even more of these cerulean tendrils of light as he was at the center of Cappadocia, with Legions of the Imperium surrounding him on all sides as his mind perused through a great deal of information!
He was the Great Usurper, and he delved and lived within the throngs of information.
Information from hundreds of thousands of Imperium Knights at the Neonate, Sequor, and Teleios Stages of the Existential Dominium Realm.
Information from the dozens of Teracosm Stage Martial Kings that he had gotten under his banner!
There had been a mobilization of Imperium Legions all around due to a threat that Eckert was now delving into deeply, and many of these Legions crossed through Cappadocia.
They came in with their own minds.
But when they left...these minds were dominated by someone else entirely.

Gaining access to hundreds of thousands of powerful Imperium Knights across the Stages allowed the Great Usurper to have multiple parts of his consciousness spread within each of these Entities...learn and grasp the usage of their Existential Extremity Authorities.
With it, he could form a Lesser Omniversal Authority by mimicking the complexities of other Omniversal Authorities he could already influence through a few of the Teracosm Stage Martial Kings.
But his aim was higher than this.
His consciousness was hungry for more!
His Existence had become distorted and unique long ago, and it was becoming even more so now as he didn't truly have a physical form.
It had been destroyed too many times!
He was mainly a collection of a massive consciousness of an Existence that stretched its tendrils out across the many Entities he subjugated.
He himself didn't have a set stage within the Existential Dominium Realm.

After all, he never truly annealed his Existence with loads of Fruits of Existence or eons of hard work- he constantly morphed his Existence and made it stronger the moment it was able to successfully infiltrate the Source of another and bind it under his control.
With every new addition of an Entity under his banner, his Existence further exploded in its power.
He didn't have to do anything apart from spreading his consciousness out further, and he could remain idle while all those he subjugated went on to work for him in elevating his own power.

It was a unique methodology to rising in strength as Eckert smiled at this moment, the auras of a few women talking amongst themselves behind him making him acknowledge that all he had done was worth it!
He had retrieved those he had to put away before his Existence was nearly eradicated within the Vacuous Existential Domain as now, he had to make sure to keep them safe.
And-
|Oh?|
His mind buzzed.
It felt something unique as his consciousness instantly magnified a Legion of the Imperium that had set off after passing through Cappadocia.
This Legion kept their predetermined path as ordered by the Imperium as at this moment, Eckert felt a prickly sensation of destruction he had felt with his consciousness too many times before!
They were all about to die? How?
|Is it the supposed Worms that have all the Martial Kings on edge?|
His voice echoed out from the mouth of the Imperium Knight Commander of this Legion as he turned his gaze around when...

His pupils constricted at the scene of a segmented worm beside him, an aurora of obsidian wings behind its back and sickles with extreme sharpness all over its body! Sickles that came down to skewer the body of this Imperium Martial King he was taking over as they ignored the golden authority blazing around him.
And...
SQUELCH!
A sound he was all too familiar with echoed out, but it was what occurred next that caused his mind to buzz with fascination.
The thick obsidian spear like limbs dug deeply into the body of the Martial King, but they more so entrenched themselves into his existence as an instant after, they began to suck away everything.
The Existence of this Martial King.
His Records. His Extremes. And even...the consciousness that had been controlling him this whole time.
Eckert felt the small part of himself within this body get sucked into the Devouring Worm along with the rest of his Existence, and what he saw thereafter...
|What is this?|
His conciseness buzzed as it felt like it sank into an extremely foreign and complex existence.

The moment his consciousness arrived, it was already being broken down along with the rest of the Existence of the Martial King as before it was ground down to nothing, Eckert got a glimpse of the Existence he was swallowed into!
It was something entirely different from everything he knew before.
Something that seemed entirely opposite of the weavings of Existence that he had begun to grasp this whole time as it was terrifying to even face it like this!

This Legion kept their predetermined path as ordered by the Imperium as at this moment, Eckert felt a prickly sensation of destruction he had felt with his consciousness too many times before!
They were all about to die?
How?
|Is it the supposed Worms that have all the Martial Kings on edge?|
His voice echoed out from the mouth of the Imperium Knight Commander of this Legion as he turned his gaze around when...
His pupils constricted at the scene of a segmented worm beside him, an aurora of obsidian wings behind its back and sickles with extreme sharpness all over its body!
Sickles that came down to skewer the body of this Imperium Martial King he was taking over as they ignored the golden authority blazing around him.
And...
SQUELCH!
A sound he was all too familiar with echoed out, but it was what occurred next that caused his mind to buzz with fascination.
The thick obsidian spear like limbs dug deeply into the body of the Martial King, but they more so entrenched themselves into his existence as an instant after, they began to suck away everything.
The Existence of this Martial King.
His Records.
His Extremes.
And even...the consciousness that had been controlling him this whole time.
Eckert felt the small part of himself within this body get sucked into the Devouring Worm along with the rest of his Existence, and what he saw thereafter...
|What is this?|
His conciseness buzzed as it felt like it sank into an extremely foreign and complex existence.

The moment his consciousness arrived, it was already being broken down along with the rest of the Existence of the Martial King as before it was ground down to nothing, Eckert got a glimpse of the Existence he was swallowed into!
It was something entirely different from everything he knew before.
Something that seemed entirely opposite of the weavings of Existence that he had begun to grasp this whole time as it was terrifying to even face it like this!

chapters.title: Chapter 3129 Integration! II
paragraphs: And even as he just caught a glimpse of it, his consciousness was ground down to nothingness as everything turned dark.
But...
SQUELCH!

Across the Legion this Martial King led, Eckert gazed around with the bodies he controlled and observed that a whole swarm of Worms surrounded them and was Devouring them as if they were made of paper, their defenses utterly useless!
But the more of them that were devoured, the more glimpses Eckert saw of what was Devouring them.
And the only conclusion he could arrive at as parts of his consciousness collapsed unfathomably quickly after being devoured was...
|What the fuck?|
Amazement and incredulity.
He was shocked to find that every time before death, he was staring at a glimpse of a physiology of Existence he had never come across before.
A physiology that was far too foreign!
|These are the enemies responsible for the cessation of weavings?|
His mind buzzed with possibilities as he put together the memories of all the Imperium Legions he controlled.
A little while ago, many of his possible paths had closed off, but there were still many more to take.
Death was not coming for him, but it was coming for many others.

Seeing the enemies responsible for it, Eckert felt like he understood why as the glimpses of what he was seeing...it wasn't something others could withstand as it was too fundamentally different from them!
To combat it...
To combat it...
Eckert's mind buzzed.

As an entire Imperium Legion was getting destroyed, one of the few remaining Imperium Knights seemed resigned to his fate as he turned around and stared in the distance, his lips moving as his voice echoed out calmly.
|Noah Osmont...where are you now?|
The burning will of the Great Usurper echoed out into nothingness as above one of the many bodies he controlled, an inescapable obsidian spear thundered down!
Inside the Var-El Eonic Omniverse Record.

Noah's Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of Cheats watched as the Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of Entropy backed by his Ascendant Existential Summons surrounded a particularly terrifying Faeburned Existence.
His winged figure was massive as he hoisted multiple flaming weapons around him, with his hands burning along with crimson flaming swords as his visage stared at them closely.
The figure of Piety had struck forward with his massive spear, and yet as if it were stuck in a quagmire, it didn't make it even a few meters close to the body of this Paracosm Equivalent Faeburned!
| An Existence Based Defensive Ability surrounds the Paracosm Equivalent Faeburned designated as Faeburned X-1165.|

|The weavings of pure Existential Extremity Authorities are not enough to bypass it unless a bombardment of the weavings of millions of Existential Extremity Authorities comes together through a Greater Omniversal Authority.|
Noah's thoughts were affirmed more and more when it came to higher levels of existence and how they defended themselves.

The Weavings of Greater Omniversal Authorities worked as a brute force to break down a specialized Existence, and Noah did not doubt that whatever stood above the |Greater| distinction of Omniversal Authorities would be even more effective in dealing with unique Sources of Existence that they may refer to as Anti-Existence.
What one could do...was look for unique means to integrate the weavings of Existential Concepts with the different manipulations of Existences out there.
Against the same Source of Existence, attacking and defending worked smoothly.
When facing different Sources of Existence, one may find their means of power are entirely nullified or much lesser in effectiveness.
So if one was proficient in the weavings of Multiple Sources of Existence...there could be a time when Noah could meet enemies that any attacks they threw at him...may just be nullified!

Just like how the Devouring Worms entirely ignored the weavings of Existential Extremity Authorities, Noah could come across other Sources of Existence that even their highest powered Entities may not be able to hurt him.
It all depended on possibilities.
|Alright, so if an Existence Based Defensive Ability is currently protecting you, we will have to use an ability that counteracts this...|
As he spoke, Noah's pupils began to rotate again.

For anyone else, utilizing the full extent of weavings of a Greater Omniversal Authority would have been a massive issue, but with no cost for Noah and only the major cost of controlling the weavings of Lumen to flow through him...he could activate Existential Eclipse a few more times!
So once more, all light became absent as Noah's eyes seemingly sucked in everything.
|OOOH!|
The Faeburned Existence felt this and bellowed out as it moved, producing new sources of light and heat to counteract this with its immeasurably strong mind as...
|Existential Eclipse.|
The Eyes of his Ascendant Existential Extremity Clone of Entropy appeared above Faeburned X-1165 and continued to devour any newly appearing light as the spear of Piety finally got through.

By the moment it did so, bright white gold lights of Lumen shooting out from the other Ascendant Existential Summons also arrived as Noah reversed the effects of Existential Eclipse- returning back all the power and light he had absorbed from his enemy to course right through his existence!
HUUM!
By the time that light began to return to this Domain...a ruined oasis stabilized as there were no mental weavings to keep the False Oasis stable.

At its center, the eyes of the Paracosm Stage Equivalent Faeburned Existence stood tall with its body frozen, every part of its existence having been burnt by the reversal of Existential Eclipse as alongside it, the white gold scorchings of Lumen could be seen.

Piety's spear was pulled back as the body of this Paracosm Equivalent Faeburned toppled over- its dimming eyes ever present on Noah as if they were sending the scene of his Existence to a far away place!
|You have gained an Ascendant Faeburned Source of Existence from an Existence with a deep association to the Source of the Faesinged Queen.|
|Your image has likely been grasped by the Faesinged Queen as a Warrant of Existence will likely be issued for all different types of Existences within the Var-El Eonic Omniverse Record.|
|The difficulty of the Var-El Eonic Omniverse Record has drastically begun to increase.|
For good or for bad, reality continued to unfold as in front of Noah, a massive singularity of crimson flames appeared that he grasped and began to study.

The advent of a single Existence Based Attack had allowed him to gang up on and defeat a Paracosm Equivalent Existence, so what would happen if he continued to integrate more of the different aspects of Sources of Existence?
His mind was already theorizing many possibilities as he voiced out while rising to the skies again.
He wanted to see if he could come across any of the other types of Existences in the Var-El Eonic Omniverse Record before the single day of the granted safe zone vanished!
